Bava Batra 115a:9-116a:1: Gemara tanu rabbanan: "ben" – en li ella ben; ben habben, o bat habben, o ben bat habben – minnayin? talmud lomar: "en lo" – ayyen alav.
"Bat" – en li ella bat; bat habbat, uven habbat, uvat ben habbat – minnayin? talmud lomar: "en lo" – ayyen alav.
Ha ketzad? nachala memashmeshet veholechet, ad reuven. velema ad yaakov! amar abbaye: gemiri dela kale shivta.

Amar rav huna amar rav: kol haomer tirash bat im bat habben, afillu nasi shebbeyisrael – en shomin lo, sheenan ella maase tzadokin. detanya: bearbaa veesrim betevet tavna ledinana. shehayu tzadokin omrin: tirash habbat im bat habben.

Nitpal lahen rabban yochanan ben zakkay, amar lahem: shotim, minnayin ze lachem? velo haya adam shehechziro davar, chutz mizzaken echad shehaya mefatpet kenegdo, veomer: uma bat beno habbaa mikkoach beno – tirashennu; bitto habbaa mikkocho – lo kol shekken?
Kara alav et hammikra hazze: "elle vene seir hachori yoshve haaretz: lotan veshoval vetzivon vaana", uchetiv: "elle bene tzivon, veayya vaana"! ella melammed shebba tzivon al immo, veholid ana.

Vedilma tere ana havo! amar rabba: amena milleta dela amra shabbur malka; umannu? shemuel. ikka deamri, amar rav pappa: amena milleta dela amra shabbur malka; umannu? rabba. amar kera: "hu ana" – hu ana demeikkara.
Amar leh: rabbi, bechach atta potreni?! amar lo: shote,

Velo tehe tora shelema shellanu, kesicha betela shellachem. ma levat beno – shekken yippa kochah bimkom haachin; tomar bevitto – shehora kochah bimkom achin. venitztzechum, veoto hayyom asauhu yom tov.
Berakhot 26a:17-26b:1: Ibbaya lehu: taa velo hitpallel mincha, mahu sheyyitpallel arvit shetayim? im timtza lomar, taa velo hitpallel arvit mitpallel shacharit shetayim, mishshum dechad yoma hu, dichtiv: "vayhi erev vayhi voker yom echad", aval hacha tefilla bimkom korban hi, vechevan deavar yomo batal korbano. o dilma kevan ditzlota rachame hi, kol emat devae metzalle veazel.
Ta shema deamar rav huna bar yehuda amar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan: taa velo hitpallel mincha — mitpallel arvit shetayim, veen baze mishshum deavar yomo batal korbano.

Metivi. "meuvvat lo yuchal litkon vechesron lo yuchal lehimmanot": "meuvvat lo yuchal litkon" — ze shebbittel keriat shema shel arvit ukeriat shema shel shacharit, o tefilla shel arvit o tefilla shel shacharit. "vechesron lo yuchal lehimmanot" — ze shennimnu chaverav lidvar mitzva, velo nimna immahem.
Amar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan: hacha bemay askinan — shebbittel bemezid.
Amar rav ashe: dayka name, dekatane "bittel", vela katane "taa", shema minna.

Tanu rabbanan: taa velo hitpallel mincha beerev shabbat — mitpallel belel shabbat shetayim. taa velo hitpallel mincha beshabbat — mitpallel bemotzae shabbat shetayim shel chol. mavdil barishona, veeno mavdil bishniyya. veim hivdil bashsheniyya velo hivdil barishona — sheniyya alta lo, rishona lo alta lo.
Chullin 26b:13-18: Gemara hechi tokea? amar rav yehuda: tokea umeria mittoch tekia, verav assi amar: tokea umeria binshima achat. atken rav assi behutzal kishmateh.

Metivi: yom tov shechal lihyot beerev shabbat, tokin velo meriin. may lav lo meriin kelal? la, rav yehuda metaretz letameh verav assi metaretz letameh. rav yehuda metaretz letameh: la meriin bifne atzmah, ella mittoch tekia. verav assi metaretz letameh: la meriin bishte neshimot, ella binshima achat.
Uvemotzae shabbat kulei. hecha amar la? amar rav yehuda: bachatimatah, vechen amar rav nachman: bachatimatah.
Verav sheshet bereh derav idi amar: af biftichatah, velet hilcheta kevavteh.
Rabbi dosa omer: "ben kodesh chamur lekodesh hakkal", velet hilcheta kevavteh.

Amar rabbi zera: yom tov shechal lihyot beemtza shabbat, omer "hammavdil ben kodesh lechol uven or lechoshech uven yisrael laggoyim uven yom hashshevii lesheshet yeme hammaase", may tama? seder havedalot hu mone.
Eruvin 52b:7-12: Gemara amar rabbi chanina: raglo achat betoch hattechum, veraglo achat chutz lattechum — lo yikkanes, dichtiv: "im tashiv mishshabbat raglecha". "raglecha" ketiv.
Vehatanya: raglo achat betoch hattechum veraglo achat chutz lattechum — yikkanes! ha manni? acherim hi, detanya: acherim omrim: limkom sherubbo hu nizkar.
Ikka deamri, amar rabbi chanina: raglo achat betoch hattechum veraglo achat chutz lattechum — yikkanes, dichtiv: "im tashiv mishshabbat raglecha" — "raglecha" karenan.
Vehattanya: lo yikkanes! hu deamar kaacherim, detanya: limkom sherubbo hu nizkar.

Rabbi eliezer omer shetayim yikkanes shalosh lo yikkanes. vehatanya, rabbi eliezer omer: achat — yikkanes, shetayim — lo yikkanes. la kashya: ha daakar chada vekam attarte. ha daakar tarte vekam attelat.
Vehatanya, rabbi eliezer omer: afillu amma achat lo yikkanes! ki tanya hahi lemoded, ditnan: velammoded sheamru notnin lo alpayim amma — afillu sof middato kale bimara.

Ketubot 102b:17-103a:7: Lo yomar harishon. amar rav chisda: zot omeret bat etzel immah.
Mimmay devigdola askinan? dilma biktanna askinan, umishshum maase shehaya.

Detanya: mi shemmet vehinniach ben katan leimmo, yorshe haav omrim: yehe gadel etzlenu, veimmo omeret: yehe beni gadel etzli — mannichin oto etzel immo, veen mannichin oto etzel rauy leyorsho. maase haya ushechatuhu erev happesach!
May limkom sheimmah? shamat minna bat etzel haem, la shena gedola vela shena ketanna.
Hahu gavra deogar leh richya lechavreh litchina. lesof iattar, zeven richya vechamra,
Amar leh: ad haiddana hava tachenna gabbach, hasheta hav li agra. amar leh: mitchan tachenna lach.
Sevar ravina lememar: hayeynu matnitin lo yomru shenehem "hare anu zanin otah keechad", ella echad zanah veechad noten lah deme mezonot.
Amar leh rav avvira: mi dame? hatam, chad keresa it la, tarte keresata let la. hacha matze amar leh: techon vezabben, techon veotev.
Vela amaran ella delet leh techina lerichya, aval it leh techina lerichya — kegon zo kofin oto al middat sedom.
Mishnah Bava Batra 1:3-6:
Hammakkif et chavero mishshelosh ruchotav, vegadar et harishona veet hashsheniyya veet hashshelishit, en mechayyevin oto. rabbi yose omer, im amad vegadar et harviit, megalgelin alav et hakkol: 
Kotel chatzer shennafal, mechayyevin oto livnoto ad arba ammot, bechezkat shennatan, ad sheyyavi reaya shello natan. mearba ammot ulemala, en mechayyevin oto. samach lo chotel acher, af al pi shello natan alav et hattikra, megalgelin alav et hakkol, bechezkat shello natan, ad sheyyavi reaya shennatan: 
Kofin oto livnot bet shaar vedelet lechatzer. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, lo chol hachatzerot reuyot levet shaar. kofin oto livnot lair choma udelatayim uveriach. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, lo chol haayarot reuyot lechoma. kamma yehe vair vihe cheanshe hair, shenem asar chodesh. kana vah bet dira, hare hu cheanshe hair miyyad: 
En cholkin et hechatzer, ad sheyyehe arba ammot laze vearba ammot laze. velo et hassade, ad sheyyehe vah tisha kabbin laze vetisha kabbin laze. rabbi yehuda omer, ad sheyyehe vah tishat chatzae kabbin laze vetishat chatzae kabbin laze. velo et hagginna, ad sheyyehe vah chatzi kav laze vachatzi kav laze. rabbi akiva omer, bet rova. velo et hatteraklin, velo et hammoran, velo et hashshovach, velo et hattallit, velo et hammerchatz, velo et bet habbad, ad sheyyehe vahen kede laze uchede laze. ze hakkelal, kol sheyyechalek ushemo alav, cholkin. veim lav, en cholkin. ematay, bizman sheen shenehem rotzim. aval bizman sheshshenehem rotzim, afillu vefachot mikkan, yachaloku. vechitve hakkodesh, af al pi sheshshenehem rotzim, lo yachaloku:
Mishnah Bava Batra 2:1-4:
Lo yachpor adam bor samuch levoro shel chavero, velo shiach, velo meara, velo ammat hammayim, velo nivrechet kovsin, ella im ken hirchik mikkotel chavero shelosha tefachim, vesad besid. marchikin et haggefet veet hazzevel veet hammelach veet hassid veet hasselaim mikkatlo shel chavero shelosha tefachim, vesad besid. marchikin et hazzeraim, veet hammacharesha, veet me raglayim min hakkotel shelosha tefachim. umarchikin et harechayim shelosha min hashshechev, shehen arbaa min harachev. veet hattanur, shelosha min hakkilya, shehen arbaa min hassafa: 
Lo yaamid adam tannur betoch habbayit, ella im ken yesh al gabbav gova arba ammot. haya maamido vaaliyya, tzarich sheyyehe tachtav maaziva shelosha tefachim. uvakkira, tefach. veim hizzik, meshallem ma shehizzik. rabbi shimon omer, lo amru chol hashshiurin haellu, ella sheim hizzik, patur milleshallem: 
Lo yiftach adam chanut shel nachtomin veshel tzabbain tachat otzaro shel chavero. velo refet bakar. beemet, beyayin hittiru, aval lo refet bakar. chanut shebbechatzer, yachol limchot beyado velomar lo, eni yachol lishon mikkol hannichnasin umikkol hayyotzin. aval ose chelim, yotze umocher betoch hashshuk, aval eno yachol limchot beyado velomar lo, eni yachol lishon, lo mikkol happattish, velo mikkol harechayim, velo mikkol hattinokot: 
Mi shehaya chatlo samuch lechotel chavero, lo yismoch lo chotel acher, ella im ken hirchik mimmennu arba ammot. vehachallonot, millemalan umillemattan, umikkenegdan, arba ammot:
Mishnah Bava Batra 2:14-3:3:
Ilan shehu note lirshut harabbim, kotzetz, kede sheyyehe gamal over verochvo. rabbi yehuda omer, gamal taun pishtan o chavile zemorot. rabbi shimon omer, kol hailan keneged hammishkolet, mippene hattuma: 
Chezkat habbattim vehabborot vehashshichin vehammearot vehashshovachot vehammerchatzaot uvet habbaddin uvet hashshelachin vehaavadim vechol shehu ose ferot tadir, chezkatan shalosh shanim miyyom leyom. sede habbaal, chezkatah shalosh shanim, veenah miyyom leyom, rabbi yishmael omer, shelosha chodashim barishona ushelosha baacharona ushenem asar chodesh vaemtza, hare shemona asar chodesh. rabbi akiva omer, chodesh barishona vechodesh baacharona ushenem asar chodesh baemtza, hare arbaa asar chodesh. amar rabbi yishmael, bamme devarim amurim, bisde lavan. aval bisde ilan, kanas et tevuato, masak et zetav, kanas et ketzo, hare ellu shalosh shanim: 
Shalosh aratzot lachazaka, yehuda veever hayyarden vehaggalil. haya vihuda vehechezik baggalil, baggalil vehechezik bihuda, enah chazaka, ad sheyyehe immo vammedina. amar rabbi yehuda, lo amru shalosh shanim ella chede sheyyehe veaspamya, veyachazik shana, veyelchu veyodiuhu shana, veyavo leshana acheret: 
Kol chazaka sheen immah taana, enah chazaka. ketzad, amar lo, ma atta ose vetoch shelli, vehu amar lo, shello amar li adam davar meolam, enah chazaka. shemmacharta li, shennatatta li vemattana, avicha mecharah li, avicha netanah li vemattana, hare zo chazaka. vehabba mishshum yerushsha, eno tzarich taana. haummanin vehashshuttafim vehaarisin vehaappotroppin, en lahem chazaka. en laish chazaka benichse ishto, velo laishsha chazaka benichse valah, velo laav benichse habben, velo labben benichse haav. bamme devarim amurim, bemachazik, aval benoten mattana, vehaachin shechalku, vehammachazik benichse hagger, naal vegadar ufaratz kol shehu, hare zo chazaka:
Mishnah Bava Batra 2:5-8:
Marchikin et hassullam min hashshovach arba ammot, kede shello tikpotz hannemiyya, veet hakkotel min hammazchila arba ammot, kede sheyyehe zokef et hassullam. marchikin et hashshovach min hair chamishshim amma. velo yaase adam shovach betoch shello, ella im ken yesh lo chamishshim amma lechol ruach. rabbi yehuda omer, bet arbaat korin, melo sheger hayyona. veim lekacho, afillu vet rova, hare hu vechezkato: 
Nippul hannimtza vetoch chamishshim amma, hare hu shel baal hashshovach. chutz mechamishshim amma, hare hu shel motzo. nimtza ven shene shovachot, karov laze, shello. karov laze, shello. mechetza al mechetza, shenehem yachaloku: 
Marchikin et hailan min hair esrim vechamesh amma, uvecharuv uveshikma chamishshim amma. abba shaul omer, kol ilan serak, chamishshim amma. im hair kadma, kotzetz veeno noten damim. veim hailan kadam, kotzetz venoten damim. safek ze kadam, safek ze kadam, kotzetz veeno noten damim: 
Marchikin goren kavua min hair chamishshim amma. lo yaase adam goren kavua betoch shello, ella im ken yesh lo chamishshim amma lechol ruach, umarchik minnetiotav shel chavero uminniro, kede shello yazzik:
Mishnah Bava Batra 2:9-13:
Marchikin et hannevelot veet hakkevarot veet habburseki min hair chamishshim amma. en osin burseki ella lemizrach hair. rabbi akiva omer, lechol ruach hu ose, chutz mimmaaravah, umarchik chamishshim amma: 
Marchikin et hammishra min hayyarak, veet hakkereshin min habbetzalim, veet hachardal min haddevorim. rabbi yose mattir bachardal: 
Marchikin et hailan min habbor esrim vechamesh amma, uvecharuv uveshikma, chamishshim amma, ben milmala ben min hatztzad. im habbor kadam, kotzetz venoten damim. veim ilan kadam, lo yakotz. safek ze kadam, vesafek ze kadam, lo yakotz. rabbi yose omer, af al pi shehabbor kodemet lailan, lo yakotz, shezze chofer betoch shello, veze notea betoch shello: 
Lo yitta adam ilan samuch lisde chavero, ella im ken hirchik mimmennu arba ammot, echad gefanim veechad kol ilan. haya gader bentayim, ze somech laggader mikkan, veze somech laggader mikkan. hayu sharashim yotzin letoch shel chavero, maamik shelosha tefachim, kede shello yeakkev et hammacharesha. haya chofer bor, shiach umeara, kotzetz veyored, vehaetzim shello: 
Ilan shehu note lisde chavero, kotzetz melo hammardea al gabbe hammacharesha. uvecharuv uveshikma, keneged hammishkolet. bet hashshelachin, kol hailan keneged hammishkolet. abba shaul omer, kol ilan serak, keneged hammishkolet:
Mishnah Bava Batra 3:4-7:
Hayu shenayim meidin oto sheachalah shalosh shanim, venimtzeu zommin, meshallemin lo et hakkol. shenayim barishona, ushenayim bashsheniyya, ushenayim bashshelishit, meshalshin benehem. shelosha achim veechad mitztaref immahem, hare ellu shalosh eduyyot, vehen edut achat lahazama: 
Ellu devarim sheyyesh lahem chazaka, veellu devarim sheen lahem chazaka. haya maamid behema vechatzer, tannur, vechirayim, verechayim, umegaddel tarnegolin, venoten zivlo vechatzer, enah chazaka. aval asa mechitztza livhemto gevoha asara tefachim, vechen lattannur, vechen lakkirayim, vechen larechayim, hichnis tarnegolin letoch habbayit, veasa makom lezivlo amok shelosha o gavoah shelosha, hare zo chazaka: 
Hammarzev en lo chazaka, veyesh limkomo chazaka. hammazchila yesh lah chazaka. sullam hammitzri en lo chazaka, velatztzori yesh lo chazaka. challon hammitzrit en lah chazaka, velatztzorit yesh lah chazaka. ezo hi challon hammitzrit, kol sheen rosho shel adam yachol likkanes letochah. rabbi yehuda omer, im yesh lah malben, af al pi sheen rosho shel adam yachol likkanes letochah, hare zo chazaka. hazziz, ad tefach, yesh lo chazaka, veyachol limchot. pachot mittefach, en lo chazaka, veen yachol limchot: 
Lo yiftach adam challonotav lachatzar hashshuttafin. lakach bayit bechatzer acheret, lo yiftechenna lachatzar hashshuttafin. bana aliyya al gabbe veto, lo yiftachenna lachatzar hashshuttafin. ella im ratza, bone et hacheder lifnim mibbeto, uvone aliyya al gabbe veto ufotchah letoch beto. lo yiftach adam lachatzar hashshuttafin petach keneged petach vechallon keneged challon. haya katan, lo yaasennu gadol. echad, lo yaasennu shenayim. aval poteach hu lirshut harabbim petach keneged petach vechallon keneged challon. haya katan, ose oto gadol. echad, ose oto shenayim:
Mishnah Oholot 10:1-4:
Arubba shehi vetoch habbayit veyesh bah poteach tefach, tuma vabbayit, keneged arubba tahor. tuma cheneged arubba, habbayit tahor. hattuma ben babbayit uven keneged arubba, natan et raglo milmalan, erev et hattuma. miktzat tuma vabbayit umiktzatah keneged arubba, habbayit tame, ucheneged hattuma tame: 
En baarubba poteach tefach, tuma vabbayit, keneged arubba tahor. tuma cheneged arubba, habbayit tahor. hattuma vabbayit, natan et raglo milmalan, tahor. hattuma cheneged arubba, natan et raglo milmalan, rabbi meir metamme. vachachamim omrim, im tuma kadma et raglo, tame. im raglo kadma et hattuma, tahor. rabbi shimon omer, shete raglayim, zo al gav zo, shekkadmu et hattuma, mashach harishon et raglo venimtza raglo shel sheni sham, tahor, mippene shekkadma raglo shel rishon et hattuma: 
Miktzat tuma vabbayit umiktzatah keneged arubba, habbayit tame, ucheneged hattuma tame, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, habbayit tame, keneged hattuma tahor. rabbi yose omer, im yesh battuma chede shettechalek utetamme et habbayit utetamme cheneged hattuma, tame. veim lav, habbayit tame, keneged hattuma tahor: 
Arubbot zo al gav zo, veyesh bahen poteach tefach, tuma vabbayit, keneged arubbot tahor. tuma cheneged arubbot, habbayit tahor. hattuma ben babbayit ben keneged arubbot, natan davar shehu mekabbel tuma, ben milmalan ben millemattan, hakkol tame. vedavar sheeno mekabbel tuma, mimmennu ulemattan, tame. mimmennu ulemalan, tahor:
Mishnah Oholot 10:5-11:2:
En baarubbot poteach tefach, tuma vabbayit, keneged arubbot tahor. tuma cheneged arubbot, habbayit tahor. hattuma vabbayit, natan ben davar shehu mekabbel tuma, ben davar sheeno mekabbel tuma, ben milmalan ben millemattan, en tame ella hattachton. hattuma cheneged arubbot, natan davar shehu mekabbel tuma, ben milmalan ben millemattan, hakkol tame. vedavar sheeno mekabbel tuma, ben milmalan ben millemattan, en tame ella tachton: 
Arubba shehi vetoch habbayit ukedera netuna tachteha, sheim taale, en siftoteha nogot baarubba, tuma tachteha, betochah o al gabbah, tuma vokaat veola, bokaat veyoradet. hayta gevoha min haaretz tefach, tuma tachteha, o vabbayit, tachteha vehabbayit, tame. tochah vegabbah, tahor. betochah o al gabbah, hakkol tame: 
Haytah netuna vetzad haaskuppa sheim taale hi nogaat bammashkof poteach tefach, tuma tachteha, betochah o al gabbah, tuma vokaat veola, bokaat veyoradet. hayta gevoha min haaretz tefach, tuma tachteha o vabbayit, tachteha vehabbayit tame, tochah vegabbah tahor. betochah o al gabbah, hakkol tame. sheim taale enah nogaat bashshekof poteach tefach, o mudbeket bashshekof, tuma tachteha, en tame ella tachteha: 
Habbayit shennisdak, tuma vachutz, kelim shebbifnim tehorin. tuma vifnim, kelim shebbachutz, bet shammay omrim, ad sheyyehe vassedek arbaa tefachim. bet hillel omrim, kol shehu. rabbi yose omer mishshum bet hillel, poteach tafach: 
Achsadra shennisdeka, tuma vetzad ze, kelim shebbatztzad hashsheni tehorim. natan et raglo o kane milmalan, erev et hattuma. natan et hakkane vaaretz, eno mevi et hattuma, ad sheyyihye gavoah min haaretz poteach tafach:
Mishnah Oholot 8:6-9:3:
Shete chaviyyot uvahen kishne chatzaye zetim, mukkafot tzamid patil umunnachot betoch habbayit, hen tehorot, vehabbayit tame. niftecha achat mehen, hi vehabbayit temeim vachavertah tehora. vechen shene chadarim shehen petuchin labbayit: 
Kavveret shehi vetoch happetach ufiha lachutz, kazzayit min hammet natun tachteha o al gabbah mibbachutz, kol shehu cheneged hazzayit, tachteha vegabbah tame. vechol sheeno cheneged hazzayit, tochah, vehabbayit, tahor. babbayit, en tame ella habbayit. betochah, hakkol tame: 
Hayta gevoha min haaretz tefach, tuma tachteha o vabbayit o al gabbah, hakkol tame, ella tochah. betochah, hakkol tame: 
Bamme devarim amurim, bizman shehi cheli mechulchalet. hayta fechuta ufekuka vekash o afutza, ezo hi afutza, kol sheen lah tefach mimmakom echad, kazzayit min hammet natun tachteha, kenegdo ad hattehom tame. al gabbah, kenegdo ad harakia tame. babbayit, en tame ella habbayit. betochah, en tame ella tochah:
Mishnah Oholot 9:13-16:
Hayta yoshevet al shuleha vehi cheli, tuma tachteha, betochah, o al gabbah, tuma vokaat veola, bokaat veyoradet. hayta gevoha min haaretz tefach, o mechussa, o chefuya al piha, tuma tachteha, betochah, o al gabbah, hakkol tame: 
Bamme devarim amurim, bizman shehi cheli. hayta fechuta ufekuka vekash, o machazeket arbaim sea kedivre chachamim, tuma tachteha, betochah, o al gabbah, tuma vokaat veola, bokaat veyoradet. rabbi eliezer verabbi shimon omrim, en tuma ola lah, af lo yoredet mimmenna. hayta gevoha min haaretz tefach, tuma tachteha, tachteha tame. betochah, o al gabbah, kenegdo ad harakia tame: 
Aron shehi rechava millemattan vetzara milmalan vehammet betochah, hannogea bah millemattan, tahor. umilmalan, tame. rechava milmalan vetzara millemattan, hannogea bah mikkol makom, tame. hayta shava, hannogea bah mikkol makom, tame, divre rabbi eliezer. verabbi yehoshua omer, mittefach ulemattan, tahor. mittefach ulemalan, tame. haasuya chemin kamtera, hannoge bah mikkol makom, tame. kemin geloskos, hannogea bah mikkol makom, tahor, chutz mimmekom petichatah: 
Chavit shehi yoshevet al shuleha vaavir vechazzayit min hammet natun tachteha o vetochah keneged kurekuratah, tuma vokaat veola, bokaat veyoredet, vehechavit temea. tachat dafnah mibbachutz, tuma bokaat veola, bokaat veyoredet, vehechavit tehora. betochah vetachat dafnah, im yesh baddefanot poteach tefach, hakkol tame, ucheneged piha, tahor. veim lav, tuma vokaat veola, bokaat veyoradet. bamme devarim amurim, bithora. aval im hayta temea o gevoha min haaretz tefach o mechussa o chefuya al piha, tuma tachteha, betochah o al gabbah, hakkol tame:
Mishnah Oholot 9:4-7:
Hayta gevoha min haaretz tefach, tuma tachteha o vabbayit, tachteha vehabbayit tame, tochah vegabbah tahor. betochah, en tame ella tochah. al gabbah, kenegdo ad harakia tame: 
Bamme devarim amurim, bizman sheppiha lachutz. haya fiha lifnim, vechazzayit min hammet natun tachteha o al gabbah mibbachutz, kol shehu cheneged hazzayit, tachteha vegabbah vetochah tame. vechol sheeno cheneged hazzayit, tochah vehabbayit tahor. betochah o vabbayit, hakkol tame: 
Hayta gevoha min haaretz tefach, tuma tachteha o vabbayit o vetochah o al gabbah, hakkol tame: 
Bamme devarim amurim, bizman shehi cheli mechulchalet. hayta fechuta ufekuka vekash o afutza, ezohi afutza, kol sheen lah tefach mimmakom echad, kazzayit min hammet natun tachteha, kenegdo ad hattehom tame. al gabbah, kenegdo ad harakia tame. betochah o vabbayit, tochah vehabbayit temeim:
Mishnah Oholot 9:8-12:
Hayta gevoha min haaretz tefach, tuma tachteha o vabbayit o vetochah, hakkol tame, ella gabbah. al gabbah, kenegdo ad harakia tame: 
Hayta memallea et kol habbayit veen benah leven hakkorot poteach tefach, tuma vetochah, habbayit tame. tuma vabbayit, ma shebbetochah tahor, shedderech tuma latzet veen darkah lehikkanes, ben omedet ben mutta al tziddah, ben achat ben shetayim: 
Hayta omedet betoch happetach veen benah leven hammashkof poteach tefach, tuma vetochah, habbayit tahor. tuma vabbayit, ma shebbetochah tame, shedderech hattuma latzet veen darkah lehikkanes: 
Hayta mutta al tziddah baavir vechazzayit min hammet natun tachteha o al gabbah, kol shehu cheneged hazzayit, tachteha vegabbah, tame. vechol sheeno cheneged hazzayit, tochah, tahor. betochah, hakkol tame: 
Hayta gevoha min haaretz tefach, tuma tachteha o al gabbah, hakkol tame, ella tochah. betochah, hakkol tame. bamme devarim amurim, bizman shehi cheli. hayta fechuta ufekuka vekash, o machazeket arbaim sea, kedivre chachamim, kazzayit min hammet natun tachteha, kenegdo ad hattehom tame. al gabbah, kenegdo ad harakia, tame. betochah, en tame ella tochah. hayta gevoha min haaretz tefach, tuma tachteha, tame. betochah, tochah tame. al gabbah, kenegdo ad harakia tame:
Mishnah Shabbat 10:3-11:1: Hammotzi ben bimino ben bismolo, betoch cheko o al ketefo, chayyav, shekken massa vene kehat. kilachar yado, beraglo, befiv uvemarpeko, beazno uvisaro, uvefundato ufiha lematta, ben pundato lachaluko, uvisfat chaluko, beminalo, besandalo, patur, shello hotzi kederech hammotziin:

Hammitkavven lehotzi lefanav uva lo leacharav, patur, leacharav uva lo lefanav, chayyav. beemet amru, haishsha hachogeret besinar ben millefaneha uven milleachareha chayyevet, shekken rauy lihyot chozer. rabbi yehuda omer, af mekabbele fitkin:

Hammotzi chikkar lirshut harabbim, chayyav. hotziuhu shenayim, peturin. lo yachol echad lehotzio vehotziuhu shenayim, chayyavim. verabbi shimon poter. hammotzi ochalin pachot mikkashshiur bichli, patur af al hakkeli, shehakkeli tefela lo. et hachay bammitta, patur af al hammitta, shehammitta tefela lo. et hammet bammitta, chayyav. vechen kazzayit min hammet vechazzayit min hannevela vechaadasha min hashsheretz, chayyav. verabbi shimon poter:

Hannotel tzipparnav zo vazo, o veshinnav, vechen searo, vechen sefamo, vechen zekano, vechen haggodelet, vechen hakkochelet, vechen happokeset, rabbi eliezer mechayyev, vachachamim osrin mishshum shevut. hattolesh meatzitz nakuv, chayyav, vesheeno nakuv, patur. verabbi shimon poter baze uvaze:
Hazzorek mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim, mershut harabbim lirshut hayyachid, chayyav. mershut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid ureshut harabbim baemtza, rabbi akiva mechayyev, vachachamim potrin:
Mishnah Shabbat 11:2-5:
Ketzad. shete gezuzteraot zo cheneged zo virshut harabbim, hammoshit vehazzorek mizzo lazo, patur. hayu shetehen bidyota achat, hammoshit chayyav, vehazzorek patur, shekkach hayta avodat haleviyyim, shete agalot zo achar zo birshut harabbim, moshitin hakkerashim mizzo lazo, aval lo zorkin. chulyat habbor vehassela shehen gevohin asara verachban arbaa, hannotel mehen vehannoten al gabban, chayyav, pachot mikken, patur: 
Hazzorek arba ammot bakkotel, lemala measara tefachim, kezorek baavir, lematta measara tefachim, kezorek baaretz. hazzorek baaretz arba ammot, chayyav. zarak letoch arba ammot venitgalgel chutz learba ammot, patur. chutz learba ammot, venitgalgel letoch arba ammot, chayyav: 
Hazzorek bayyam arba ammot, patur. im haya rekak mayim ureshut harabbim mehallechet bo, hazzorek letocho arba ammot, chayyav. vechamma hu rekak mayim, pachot measara tefachim. rekak mayim ureshut harabbim mehallechet bo, hazzorek betocho arba ammot, chayyav: 
Hazzorek min hayyam layyabbasha umin hayyabbasha layyam, umin hayyam lassefina umin hassefina layyam, umin hassefina lachavertah, patur. sefinot keshurot zo vazo, metaltelin mizzo lazo. im enan keshurot, af al pi shemmukkafot, en metaltelin mizzo lazo:
Mishnah Shabbat 7:4-8:3:
Hammotzi teven, kimlo fi fara. atza, kimlo fi gamal. amir, kimlo fi tale. asavim, kimlo fi gedi. ale shum vaale vetzalim, lachim, kigrogeret, yeveshim, kimlo fi gedi. veen mitztarfin ze im ze, mippene shello shavu veshiurehen. hammotzi ochalim kigrogeret, chayyav, umitztarfin ze im ze, mippene sheshshavu veshiurehen, chutz mikkelippehen vegarinehen veuktzehen vesubban umursanan. rabbi yehuda omer, chutz mikkelippe adashim shemmitbashshelot immahen: 
Hammotzi yayin, kede mezigat hakkos. chalav, kede gemia. devash, kede litten al hakkatit. shemen, kede lasuch ever katan. mayim, kede lashuf bahem et hakkilor. ushear kol hammashkin, birviit. vechol hashshofachin, birviit. rabbi shimon omer, kullan birviit, velo amru chol hashshiurin hallalu ella lematzniehen: 
Hammotzi chevel, kede laasot ozen lekuppa. gemi, kede laasot telay lenafa velichvara. rabbi yehuda omer, kede littol mimmennu middat minal lekatan. neyar, kede lichtov alav kesher mochsin. vehammotzi kesher mochsin, chayyav. neyar machuk, kede lichroch al pi tzelochit ketanna shel palyaton: 
Or, kede laasot kamea. kelaf, kede lichtov alav parasha ketanna shebbattefillin, shehi shema yisrael. deyo, kede lichtov shete otiyyot. kechol, kede lichchol ayin echat:
Mishnah Shabbat 8:4-9:1:
Devek, kede litten berosh hashshavshevet. zefet vegafrit, kede laasot nekev. shaava, kede litten al pi nekev katan. charsit, kede laasot pi kor shel tzorfe zahav. rabbi yehuda omer, kede laasot pitput. subbin, kede litten al pi kor shel tzorfe zahav. sid, kede lasud ketanna shebbabbanot. rabbi yehuda omer, kede laasot kilkul. rabbi nechemya omer, kede laasot andife: 
Adama, kechotam hammartzufim, divre rabbi akiva. vachachamim omrim, kechotam haiggerot. zevel vechol haddak, kede lezabbel kelach shel keruv, divre rabbi akiva. vachachamim omrim, kede lezabbel keresha. chol haggas, kede litten al melo chaf sid. kane, kede laasot kulmos. veim haya av o merussas, kede levashshel vo vetza kalla shebbabbetzim, terufa unetuna vailpas: 
Etzem, kede laasot tarvad. rabbi yehuda omer, kede laasot mimmennu chaf. zechuchit, kede ligror bo rosh hakkarkar. tzeror o even, kede lizrok beof. rabbi eliezer bar yaakov omer, kede lizrok bivhema: 
Cheres, kede litten ben patztzim lachavero, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer, kede lachtot bo et haur. rabbi yose omer, kede lekabbel bo reviit. amar rabbi meir, af al pi sheen reaya laddavar, zecher laddavar (yeshaya 30), velo yimmatze vimchittato cheres lachtot esh miyyakud. amar lo rabbi yose, mishsham reaya, velachsof mayim miggeve (sham): 
Amar rabbi akiva, minnayin laavoda zara shehi metammea vemassa kannidda, shenneemar (yeshaya 30) tizrem kemo dava, tze tomar lo, ma nidda metammea vemassa, af avoda zara metammea vemassa:
Mishnah Shabbat 9:2-5: Minnayin lisfina shehi tehora, shenneemar (Mishlei 30) derech oniyya velev yam. minnayin laaruga shehi shishsha al shishsha tefachim shezzorin betochah chamishsha zeronin, arbaa vearba ruchot haaruga veechad baemtza, shenneemar (yeshaya 61) ki chaaretz totzi tzimchah ucheganna zerueha tatzmiach, zarah lo neemar, ella zerueha:

Minnayin lefoletet shichvat zera bayyom hashshelishi shehi temea, shenneemar (Shemot 19) heyu nechonim lishloshet yamim. minnayin shemmarchitzin et hammila vayyom hashshelishi shechal lihyot beshabbat, shenneemar (Bereshit led) vayhi vayyom hashshelishi bihyotam koavim. minnayin shekkoshrin lashon shel zehorit berosh sair hammishtalleach, shenneemar (yeshaya 1) im yihyu chataechem kashshanim kashsheleg yalbinu:
Minnayin lesicha shehi chashshetiyya veyom hakkippurim, af al pi sheen reaya laddavar, zecher laddavar, shenneemar (tehillim kat) vattavo chammayim bekirbo vechashshemen beatzmotav:

Hammotzi etzim, kede levashshel betza kalla. tevalin, kede letabbel betza kalla, umitztarfin ze im ze. kelippe egozim, kelippe rimmonim, istis ufua, kede litzboa bahen beged katan bassevacha. me raglayim, neter uvorit, kimmonya veashlag, kede lechabbes bahen beged katan bassevacha. rabbi yehuda omer, kede lehaavir al hakkatem:
Mishnah Shabbat 9:6-10:2: Pilpelet, kol shehu. veitran, kol shehu. mine vesamim umine mattachot, kol shehen. meavne hammizbeach umeafar hammizbeach, mekek sefarim umekek mitpechotehem, kol shehu, shemmatzniin otan leganzan. rabbi yehuda omer, af hammotzi mimmeshammeshe avodat kochavim, kol shehu, shenneemar (Devarim 13) velo yidbak beyadcha meuma min hacherem:

Hammotzi kuppat harochlin, af al pi sheyyesh bah minin harebe, eno chayyav ella chattat echat. zerone ginna, pachot mikkaggerogeret. rabbi yehuda ben betera omer, chamishsha. zera kishshuin, shenayim. zera deluin, shenayim. zera pol hammitzri, shenayim. chagav chay tahor, kol shehu. met, kaggerogeret. tzipporet keramim, ben chayya ben meta, kol shehu, shemmatzniin otah lirfua. rabbi yehuda omer, af hammotzi chagav chay tame, kol shehu, shemmatzniin oto lekatan lischok bo:
Hammatznia lezera uledugma velirfua, vehotzio beshabbat, chayyav bechol shehu. vechol adam en chayyav alav ella cheshiuro. chazar vehichniso, eno chayyav alav ella cheshiuro:

Hammotzi ochalin unetanan al haaskuppa, ben shechazar vehotzian ben shehotzian acher, patur, mippene shello asa melachto bevat echat. kuppa shehi melea ferot unetanah al haaskuppa hachitzona, af al pi sherov happerot mibbachutz, patur, ad sheyyotzi et kol hakkuppa:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 7:7-9:
Echad haose av meavot melachot o tolada min hattoladot bemezid chayyav karet. veim bau edim niskal. beshogeg chayyav chattat kevua. im ken ma hefresh yesh ben haavot vehattoladot. en benehen hefresh ella leinyan hakkarban bilvad. shehaose beshogeg im asa avot harebe behealem echad chayyav chattat achat al kol av veav. veim asa av vetoldotav behealem echad eno chayyav ella chattat achat: 
Ketzad. hare shecharash vezara vekatzar beshabbat behealem echad chayyav shalosh chattaot. vaafillu asa haarbaim chaser achat bishgaga kegon sheshshachach sheellu hammelachot asurot leasot beshabbat chayyav al kol melacha umelacha chattat achat. aval im tachan vechatach hayyarak veshaf lashon shel mattechet behealem echad eno chayyav ella chattat achat. shehare lo asa ella av echad vetoldotav. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Haose melachot harebe meen melacha achat behealem echad eno chayyav ella chattat achat. ketzad. hare shezzara venata vehivrich vehirkiv vezamar behealem echad eno chayyav ella chattat achat shekkullan av echad hen. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 4:1:
Kol hazzevachim tzarich haoved shettihye machshavto leshem hazzevach uleshem bealav bishat zevicha uvishat kabbalat haddam uvishat holachat haddam uvishat zerikato al hammizbeach shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 7 15)</small> "uvesar zevach todat shelamav" shettihye zevicha im shear arba haavodot leshem shelamav. vechen shear hakkarbanot. veim shachat veavad shear avodot setam velo chashav kelal beola uvishlamim hare hen kesherim vealu labbealim:
Vetzarich shettihye machshavto bishat shechitat haola leshem shishsha devarim. leshem hazzevach. uleshem hazzoveach. veshehazzevach lehashshem baruch hu. vesheyyaktiro laishshim. veshehaktarato lereach bilvad. veshereach ze nachat ruach lifne hashshem. veim shachat setam kasher kemo shebbearnu. vehashshochet chattat veasham tzarich shettihye machshavto leshem oto hachet shebba alav:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 4:7:
Kol hazzevachim en shochatin otan lechattechilla ella besakkin mikkele sharet. veim shachat bechol davar sheshshochatin bo hachullin afillu bikrumit shel kane kesherin:
Vechol hazzevachim shekkibbel middamam pachot mikkede hazzaya lo nitkaddesh haddam. vetzarich lehitkavven lekabbel kol haddam. ketzad hu ose. ochez hassimanim beyado umotzian im havveridin letoch hammizrak. veshochet shenayim o rov shenayim kede sheyyitkabbel haddam kullo bichli. umagbiah hassakkin lemala kede shello yered haddam mealeha ella min hatztzavvar. vedam shebbassakkin mekannecho bisfat hammizrak:
Avir hakkeli hare hu kichli. haya mekabbel haddam venifchatu shule hammizrak kodem sheyyaggia haddam laavir hammizrak hannifchat lo nitkaddesh haddam. shehaavir sheen sofo lanuach eno kemunnach:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 5:1:
Kevar bearnu sheshshechitat hakkadashim keshera bezarim umikkabbalat haddam veelach mitzvat kehunna vechol hazzevachim kibbul daman bichli sharet beyad kohen. aval mekom shechitatan umekom kibbul daman eno shave bechullan:
Ketzad. kadshe kadashim en shochatin otan veen mekabbelin et daman ella bitzfon hammizbeach bechol hammakom shebbearnu gevulotav bitchillat sefer ze. vekadashim kallim shechitatan vekibbul daman bechol makom min haazara:
Uminnayin sheen shochatin kadshe kadashim ella batztzafon. shehare neemar beola <small>(Vayikra 1 11)</small> "veshachat oto al yerech hammizbeach tzafona" uvechattat hu omer <small>(Vayikra 6 18)</small> "bimkom asher tishshachet haola tishshachet hachattat". ucheshem shehachattat nikret kodesh kadashim kach haola nikret kodesh kadashim. uveasham hu omer <small>(Vayikra 7 b)</small> "bimkom asher yishchatu et haola yishchatu et haasham". veshalme tzibbur hukkeshu lechattat shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 23 19)</small> "vaasitem seir izzim echad lechattat ushene chevasim bene shana lezevach shelamim" lefichach hen kadshe kadashim kechattat venishchatin bimkom shechitatah. umekom shechita hu mekom hakkabbala:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 5:4:
Uminnayin sheshshochatim kadashim kallim bechol haazara afillu achore hahechol. shehare neemar bishlamim <small>(Vayikra 3 b)</small> "ushechato petach ohel moed" lehacheshir kol haruchot shehare lo yiched lahem ruach. vehu haddin lishar hakkadashim kallim. veim shechatam bahechol kesherim. aval im shechatan begaggo shel hechol pesulin sheen haggaggot reuyot lishchita kelal ella bekarka haazara: 
Shelamim sheshshechatan kodem sheyyippatchu daltot hahechol pesulin shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 3 b)</small> "petach ohel moed" bizman sheppatuach. afillu hayu daltotav muggafot hare ze kenaul. aval happarochet shealav enah poselet:
Haola vehaasham vehashshelamim ben shel yachid ben shel tzibbur zerikat dam shelashtan al gabbe hammizbeach shava leola. vechetzad hu ose. keshellokeach hakkohen haddam bammizrak vezorek mimmennu bammizrak shete zerikot al shete zaviyyot hammizbeach baalachson mechatzi hammizbeach ulematta al keren mizrachit tzefonit veal keren maaravit deromit. umitkavven kesheyyizzarek haddam al hakkeren sheyyihye haddam makkif al hazzaviyyot kemin gam. kede sheyyimmatze haddam shel shete mattanot al arbaa katle hammizbeach lefi shenneemar beola uvishlamim <small>(Vayikra 7 b)</small> <small>(Vayikra 9 18)</small> "saviv" vehu haddin leasham. usheyare haddam nishpachin al hayesod hadderomi: 
Hachattaot hanneechalot daman taun arba mattanot al arba karnot hammizbeach hachitzon mechatzi mizbeach ulemala lefi shenneemar bah <small>(Vayikra 4 25)</small> <small>(Vayikra 4 led)</small> "al karnot hammizbeach". vechetzad hu ose. keshellokeach hakkohen haddam bammizrak molicho etzel hammizbeach vetovel etzbao hayemanit hassemucha laggudal bedam. vesomech beetzbao haggedola mikkan uvaggudal mikkan umechatte veyored keneged chuddah shel keren ad sheyyichle kol haddam shebbeetzbao. vechen hu ose bechol keren vekeren. veim natan samuch lakkeren keamma achat mikkan o mikkan kipper:

Vetzarich litbol etzbao al kol keren vekeren. uchesheggomer hannetina al hakkeren mekanneach etzbao bisfat hammizrak. veachar kach tovel paam sheniyya. sheshsheyare haddam shebbeetzbao pesulin litten mehen al keren acheret:
En bechol hakkarbanot karban shettaun hazzayat dam beetzbao ella chattat bilvad shenneemar bah <small>(Vayikra 9 9)</small> "vetaval etzbao baddam". vetzarich sheyyihye sham dam kede tevila lo sheyyissafeg etzbao middam:
Niddah 20a:23-26: Tanya iddach: uchememe adama — mevi adama shemena mibbikat bet kerem, umetzif aleha mayim kiklippat hashshum, veen shiur lammayim, mishshum deen shiur leafar, veen bodkin otan tzelulin, ella achurin. tzallu — chozer veochran, ucheshehu ochran — en ochran bayyad ella bichli.
Ibbaya lehu: en ochrin otan bayyad ella bichli — dela lirmeye bideh velakerinhu, aval bemana ki achar leh bideh — shappir dame, o dilma dela lakerinhu bideh ella bemana?
Ta shema: keshehu bodkan, en bodkan ella bechos. vaadayin tibbee lach: bedika bechos, achira bemay? teku.
Ki atu lekammeh derabba bar avu, amar lehu: bimkomah shaninu. rabbi chanina pale kureta degargishta uvadek beh, layet aleh rabbi yishmael berabbi yose beaskara.

Zohar, Metzora 12: Ribbi chizkiyya patach veamar, (tehillim 17) shima Adonai tzedek vegomer. kama chaviva keneset yisrael kame kudesha berich hu, divchol zimna dekneset yisrael, atat lekammeh dekudesha berich hu, kudesha berich hu izdeman lokovlah. hada hu dichtiv shima Adonai tzedek hakeshiva rinnati haazina tefillati. amar david, ana itkattarna bikkeneset yisrael. kema dehi ishtechachat lekammach, ana name hachi ishtechachna. uvegin kach shima Adonai tzedek, bekadmita, ulevatar, hakeshiva rinnati haazina tefillati.

Belo sifte mirma. may bela sifte mirma. ella hachi tanenan. kol milla umilla ditzlota, deappik bar nash mippumeh, salka leella uvaka rekiin, vealat laatar dealat, tamman itbechanat hahi milla, i hi milla dechashra i la, i ihi milla dechashra alin lah kame malka kaddisha lemebad reutah. vei lav, satin lah levar, veitar behahi milla rucha ochora.

Veta chaze, ketiv beh beyosef, (Tehillim 105:19) innu vakkevel raglo vegomer. ad ematay, innu vakkevel raglo. ad et bo devaro imrat Adonai tzerafathu. ad et bo devaro deman. ella ad et bo devaro (deyosef, vaatabechayn) hahi milla, hada hu dichtiv, imrat Adonai tzerafathu. keden, shallach melech vayyattirehu moshel ammim vayfattechehu. addehachi hava ata tzafra.

Amar ribbi elazar, ketiv, (Shmuel 1 25:29) vehayta nefesh adoni tzerura bitzror hachayyim. nefesh adoni, setam. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 24:4) asher lo nasa lashav nafshi, ha idana betzafra leitkashshera keneset yisrael uleitchabbera bevalah, zakkain innun tzaddikayya demishtaddelin beorayyta belelya, veatan leitkashshera beh bekudesha berich hu ubbikkeneset yisrael. alayyhu ketiv, (Mishlei 23:25) yismach avicha veimecha vetagel yoladtecha.
Zohar, Metzora 2: Ribbi elazar patach, (Kohelet 9:12) vechatztzipporim haachuzzot bappach kahem yukashim bene haadam. hay kera ha ittemar. aval ta chaze, bene nasha la yadin, vela shamin, vela mistakkele biruta demarehon, vecharoza kol yoma kare kamayyhu, velet man detzayit leh, velet man deyittear rucheh lefulechana demareh.

Beshaata deramash lelya, vetarin setimin, ittear nukeba dithoma rabba, vechamma chavile terikin mishtakkeche bealma. keden appil kudesha berich hu shenata al kol bene alma, vaafillu al kol di behon ittearuta dechayye, veinnun shatan bealma, umodin lehu livne nasha, millin, minnehon kedivan, uminnehon keshot, uvene nasha itketaru beshenata.

Kad ittear rucha detzafon, veitpelig lelya, shalhova nafka uvatash techot gadpoy detarnegola, vekare, vekudesha berich hu al beginta deeden leishtashea im tzaddikayya. ucheden karoza nafik vekare, vechol bene alma mitare bearsayyhu, innun di behon ittearuta dechayye, kayymin lefulechana demarehon, veaske beorayyta uvishvacha dekudesha berich hu ad deate tzafra.
Zohar, Metzora 4: (Vayikra 14:2) zot tihye torat hammetzora. ribbi yitzchak patach, (Kohelet 1:5) vezarach hashshemesh uva hashshamesh vegomer. hay kera ittemar, veokimna leh benishmeta debar nash, beshaata dehi kayyeyma immeh debar nash behay alma, keden, vezarach hashshemesh. uva hashshamesh, bezimna denafik bar nash mehay alma, veishtechach bitshuva, keden el mekomo shoef zoreach hu sham, i zakkaa ihu, kema deat amer, (Vayikra 22:7) uva hashshemesh vetaher, veachar yochal min hakkodashim.

Ta chaze, kol chove alma, kudesha berich hu mechapper alayyhu, bitshuva, bar mehahu lishana bisha, deappik shum bish al chavreh. veha ukemuha, dichtiv, zot tihye torat hammetzora, zot hi torato shel motzi shem ra. ribbi chiyyay amar, kol man deappik lishana bisha, istaavan leh kol shayyfoy, veyitchaze lesagra, begin dehahi milla bisha salleka veittear rucha misava aloy veisteav, ate leistaava mesaavin leh, bemilla diltatta ittear milla ochora.

Patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 1:21) echa hayta lezona kirya neemana vegomer. man dahavat mehemana levalah, ahadrat lezona. meleati mishpat, mishpat, vadday da kudesha berich hu, tzedek, da keneset yisrael, uvegin deattearat milla ochora, istellak minnah kudesha berich hu, vesharya bah rucha dekatule. hada hu dichtiv veatta meratzchim. uma yerushalam karta kaddisha kach, shear bene nasha al achat kamma vechamma. hada hu dichtiv, zot tihye torat hammetzora.

Ribbi yehuda amar, zot tihye vadday lokovleh leitpara minneh, dehahu motzi shem ra, beyom tohorato vehuva el hakkohen, may ka mashma lan. mashma, man deit leh lishana bisha tzeloteh la alat kamme kudesha berich hu, deha ittear aleh rucha misava. kevan deahadar bitshuva vekabbil aleh teshuva, ma ketiv, beyom tohorato vehuva el hakkohen vegomer veraa hakkohen vegomer.

(Vayikra 14:4) vetzivva hakkohen velakach lammittaher shete tzipporim chayyot. ribbi yitzchak veribbi yose havo shechiche kammeh derabbi shimon. yoma chad amar leh, etz erez ha yedia, kema deat amer, (Melachim 1 5:13) min haerez asher ballevanon, deha hahu etz erez, la ishtarshan netioy ella ballevanon, veha ittemar. ezov lamma, umay hu.

Patach veamar, velakach lammittaher shete tzipporim chayyot tehorot veetz erez usheni tolaat veezov. ta chaze, bar nash demishtaddel befulechana demareh, veishtedal beorayyta, kudesha berich hu share aloy ushechinta ishtattefa bahadeh. kevan debar nash ate leistaava, shechinta istalakat minneh, kudesha berich hu itrechik minneh, vechol sitra dikdushsha demareh merachakin mineh, veshari aleh ruach misava vechol sitra dimsaava, ate leitdakkea mesayyeyin leh. batar deitdakke veahdar bitshuva, hahu deistallak minneh ahdar, veshari aloy.
Zohar, Metzora 7: Ribbi yitzchak patach, (Vayikra 1:1) vayikra el moshe vaydabber Adonai elav meohel moed lemor. vayikra alef zeera, amay. ella begin leachazaa man hu hahu dekara, hahu deshare bemakdesha, ucheden zammin lemoshe, keman dezammin ushepiza. hacha 1 zeera, hatam 1 rabbeta, adam shet enosh. (sefer acher adam) da shelimu decholla.

Ta chaze, ma ben moshe leaharon, he minnayyhu illaa. ella moshe illaa, moshe shushevina demalka, aharon shushevina dematronita. metal lemalka dehava leh matronita illaa. ma avad. yahav lah shushevina letakkena lah uleistakkela bemille deveta. veal da, kad ayyil shushevina da lemalka, la ayyil ella im matronita, hada hu dichtiv, bezot yavo aharon vegomer.

Moshe shushevina lemalka, begin kach izdaman keushepiza, ulevatar, vaydabber Adonai elav. aharon hu shushevina lematronita, vechol milloy havo, lefayyeysa lemalka bematronita, veyitpeyays malka bahadah. veal da begin deihu, shushevina lah shavvi madoreh bahadah, letakkena beta uleayyna tadir bemille deveta. veal da ittekkan kegavvna dilella, veikre kohen gadol. mena lan. dichtiv, (Tehillim 110:4) atta chohen leolam al divrati malki tzedek.

Uvegin kach kol ma deitzterich mibbe malka, natil, velet man deyimche bideh. veal da hu kaim ledakkea lechol innun dealin leve matronita, begin dela yishtekach misava beinnun bene hechala. uvegin kach ketiv, velakach lammittaher shete tzipporim vegomer.

Ribbi yehuda patach veamar, (Tehillim 2:4) yoshev bashshamayim yischak Adonai yilag lamo. yoshev bashshamayim yischak, da yitzchak deate missitra dechamra, nahir bekadmita, vechayich, ulevatar zaim vetarich. hada hu dichtiv yoshev bashshamayim vela ketiv, yoshev shamayim. yischak, nahir vechayich. veal da dina nahir vechayich, lehu lerashiayyay.

Ulevatar ma ketiv, az yedabber elemo veappo uvacharono yevahalemo. vechach arche dechayyayvayya, kudesha berich hu nahir lehu behay alma, venahir lon anpin kechamra, denahir bekadmita, ulevatar zaim vekatil. vekudesha berich hu mashich lon lechayyayvayya, i yehadrun lokovleh, yaut, vei la shatze lon mehahu alma deate, velet lon beh chulaka, veyishtetzun mikkolla. attun leitdakkea, mesayyeyin lon. vekudesha berich hu medakke lon vekariv lon legabbeh, vekari alayyhu shalom. hada hu dichtiv (Yeshayahu 57:19) shalom shalom larachok velakkarov vegomer.
Zohar, Yitro 34: (Shemot 20:12) kabbed et avicha veet immecha, bechol zine yekar, lemechode lon beovde dechashraan, kema deat amer (Mishlei 23:24) gil yagil avi tzaddik, veda ihu yekara daavoy udeimmeh.

Raya mehemna kabbed et avicha veet immecha. kabbedehu bichsut nekiyyay, dehayynu kanfe mitztzeva, (Mishlei 3:9) kabbed et Adonai mehonecha, da tora umitztzevot. hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 3:16) orech yamim biminah bismolah vgo. deani lav ihu bar nash, ella min hattora umin hammitztzevot, ishtemoda, devatar deukemuha mare matnitin en ani ella min hattora umin hammitztzevot, deutra devar nash orayyta umitztzevot.

Uvegin da, kabbed et Adonai mehonecha, vla tishtaddel beorayyta, kede lehitgaddel bah. kema deukemuha chavrayyay, veal taasem atara lehitgaddel bahem, velo tomar ekra baavur sheyyikreuni rabbi, ella (tehillim la) gaddelu laAdonai itti. kabbed et Adonai mehonecha, keven deihu chayyayv bikara daavoy veimmeh.

Begin deihu meshuttaf mitteren tippin, deminnehon notztzar bar nash. mitippa deavuha, chivvavru deayynin, vegarmin veevarin. umitippa deimmeh, shachor di beayynin, vesaara umashcha uvisra. verabbiu leh beorayyta, veovadin tavin.

Devar nash chayyayv lelammed beno tora, dichtiv, (Devarim 6:7) veshinnantam levanecha. vei la olif leh orayyta ufikkudin, keillu avid leh pesel, uvegin da lo taase lecha fesel. veatid lihyot ben sorer umore, umevazze avuy veimmeh, vegozel minneh kamma birkan. dehoil vihu am haaretz, chashid ihu al kolla, vafillu al shefichut damim, vegiluy arayot, veavoda zara. deman deihu am haaretz. veazil laatar dela ishtemodun leh, vela yada levarcha, chashdinan leh deihu ovde avoda zara. (ad kan raya mehemana).

Kabbed et avicha kema deat amer kabbed et Adonai mehoncha. mehonecha: mimmamonecha. mehonecha: mechinnecha. bechedva deniguna, lemechode libba, deha da chedva delibba, kegavvna da nigguna dechol alma. ovadin dechashraan dehahu bera, chadde libba deavuha udeimmeh. mehonecha, mimmamonecha lechol ma deitzterichu.

Kegavvna devar nash okir lekudesha berich hu, hachi itzterich leabba uleima, begin deshuttafuta chada it lon bekudesha berich hu aleh. uchema deitzterich lemidchal lekudesha berich hu, hachi itzterich lemidchal leavuha uleimmeh, uleokir lon kachada, bechol zine yekar.

Lemaan yaarichun yamecha, begin deit yomin leella, detalyayn behu chayye bar nash behay alma. veokimna al innun yomin devar nash behahu alma leella, vechullehu kayymin kame kudesha berich hu, uvehu ishtemodan chayye devar nash.
Al haadama asher Adonai elohecha noten lach. avtachuta leithanya beaspakalarya denahara, veraza da al haadama, da aspakalarya denahara, beinnun yomin illain, denaharin miggo mabbua decholla.

May shena, beillen teren pikkudin deorayyta, dichtiv behu lemaan yaarichun yamecha, beda, uveshilluach hakken. ella teren pikkudin illen, kullehu talyayn leella. abba veima, raza dezachor veshamor kachada. uvegine kach ketiv lemaan yaarichun yamecha. uveshilluach hakken, dichtiv, (Devarim 22:7) shallach teshallach et haem veet habbanim tikkach lach lemaan yitav lach vegomer, raza dealma illaa, dela ityeyhiv beh reshu leistakkela, veitzterich leshalleach miggo sheelta veistakkeluta beh.

Veet habbanim tikkach lach, dichtiv, (Devarim 4:32) ki sheal na leyamim rishonim vegomer mikketze hashshamayim vead ketze hashshamayim. aval leella mikketze hashshamayim, shallach teshallach merayonecha lemishal.

Uveda ketiv, lemaan yitav lach vehaarachta yamim, lemaan itav lach la ketiv, ella lemaan yitav lach. veyaarichun yamecha la ketiv, ella vehaarachta yamim. lemaan yitav lach, hahu atar deotiv lecholla, veihu alma desatim veganiz. vehaarachta yamim, kema dichtiv, tikkach lach, birshuta devar nash ihu.

Vei izdaman leh ovada vichavvevn beh, zakkaa ihu. veaf al gav dela mechavven beh, zakkaa ihu, deavid pikkuda demareh. aval la itchashiv keman deavid reuta lishmah, vichavven beh, biruta deistakkeluta bikare demareh, keman dela yada lemisbar sevara, deha biruta talya milla lishmah. uveovada diltatta lishmah, istallak ovada leella, veittakkan kadka yeot.

Kegavvna da, beovada degufa, ittakkan ovada denafsha, behahu reuta. deha kudesha berich hu bae libba, ureuta devar nash. vaafillu hachi, i lav tamman reuta delibba deihu ikara decholla, al da tzalle david veamar, (Tehillim 90:17) umaase yadenu konna alenu vegomer. deha let kol bar nash chakkim, leshavvaa reuta velibba, letakkena kolla veyavid ovada demitzva. al da tzalle tzelota da, umaase yadenu konna alenu.

May konna alenu. konna, veatkin tikkunach leella kadka yeot. alenu, af al gav delet anan yade leshavvaa reuta, ella ovada bilchodoy. maase yadenu konnehu. leman. lehahu darga deitzterich leittakna. konnehu, bechibbura chada baavahan, lemeheve metatkena behon, behay ovada, kedka yeot.

rashi: Vehazzav et zovo. baal shete reiyyot, uvaal shalosh reiyyot, shettoratan meforeshet lemala:
Vehikriv oto leasham. yakrivennu letoch haazara leshem asham lehanif, shehu taun tenufa chay (menachot 62):
Vehenif otam. et haasham veet hallog (sham sefer acher):
Zot tihye torat vegomer. melammed sheen metaharin oto ballayla (sifra):
ohc: Zot tihye torat. kol hakkatuv meyuttar, shello haya lo lomar ella "ki yithar hammetzora vehuva el hakkohen" vegomer. uvetorat kohanim darshu tevat "zot" lemaet taharat hammetzora bevama, shello yihye ella bevet olamim, vetevat "tihye" lerabbot sheyyitharu metzoraim bazzeman hazze, uchemaase rabbi tarfon (yerushalmi fesachim 2:2; torat kohanim pasuk 4) shehera makkel shettiher bo metzoraim bazzeman hazze, vetevat "torat" lomar shehagam shechillek betumat metzora, sheyyesh muchlat biriyyat kohen paam rishona veyesh behesger shavua vechaddome, af al pi chen torat metzora achat hi. vetevat "beyom" lomar sheen taharat metzora ella bayyom velo ballayla. veamru yachol af lekichat tzipporim vechulei, talmud lomar "zot", ad kan.

Hinne tevat "zot" darash mimmenna lemaet taharat metzora bevama, vedarash mimmenna lemaet lekichat tzipporim bayyom. hattaam, letzad shekkadma lezichron hattahara vezichron "beyom" miet bishnehem, sheim lo hayta kavvanat Adonai lemaet ella beachat mehenna haya lo lehasemich hammiut leechad al ze hadderech: "torat hammetzora zot tihye beyom", veaz yihye hammiut al "beyom" velo al torat hammetzora im tzericha bevet olamim. o yomar al ze hadderech: "beyom taharat hammetzora zot tihye torato", veaz haya hammiut al hakkarbanot velo al beyom, veen beseder ze tosefet afillu ot achat.

Uvammidrash darshu (Vayikra Rabba 16:2) miyyittur hakkatuv "zot tihye" – torato shel motzi shem ra. vetzarich ladaat lamma ramaz haddavar bemakom ze bizman tahara. venire ki letzad shebba hakkatuv lomar havaat tzipporim, laze hikdim latet taam, ki letzad shecheto hu bishvil lashon hara, laze tihye torato zot lehavi tzipporim hammetzaftzefim dugemato.

Od nire lefaresh al ze hadderech: leheyot shehatztzaraat kefi hatteva techunato tithavve meippush vezihum hagguf vetigboret hammara asher titgabber baadam veosa roshem bivsaro, vedavar ze yesovvennu haitztzavon vetzarat hallev veshimmon hassechel, veharfua hattivit laze hi harechakot haitztzavon veinyanim hammarchivim libbo shel adam umesammechim oto. vehinne bevo nega tzaraat al haadam yachol adam lomar ki choli tivi hu asher yikre lehaadam, uveemor lo ki hu ze bishvil lashon hara lo yaamin velo yatzdik haddevarim. laze nitchakkem el elyon vetzivva sheyyissager hammetzora, badad yeshev uvegadav yihyu ferumim verosho yihye farua veal safam yate, udevarim ellu hem kefi hatteva negdiyyim lirfuat sibbat hannega, veadrabba yolidu hannega mechadash. vechaasher yire haadam shehagam sheasa devarim ellu shehem negdiyyim, af al pi chen al yede shehirher teshuva vehitvadda chattato ki baavono asher pashat leshono gilla hannega et eno, veyashuv mechattato vitaher leshono veyire ki hafach hannega et eno, baze yeda veyochiach hochacha berura shello ba lo hannega ella letzad sheddibber lashon hara. vehu amro zot tihye torat motzi shem ra, vehakkarat haddavar vehochachato beyom tohorato, shehagam sheasa devarim negdiyyim lechalyo kannizkar af al pi chen nithar, baze yeda ki torat leshono hara hu ze velo mikre hattivi kechoshve machshevot aven, veyishmor piv uleshono. vehu ma sheggamar omer nirpa nega hatztzaraat min hatztzarua, perush, min hatztzarua baa refuato sheshshav verafa lo.

Vehuva vegomer. hutzrach lomar vehuva vegomer, letzad sheamar "beyom tohorato" chash sheyyachshov adam shehakkatuv kerao tahor bema shehusar nigo veen tenay baddavar, laze amar "vehuva" vegomer, perush, chada veod, "tohorato vehuva el" vegomer. verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (torat kohanim) shello yishhe. vetaam amro vehuva velo amar uva, ulay sheyyechayyevuhu bet din o tokfo kohen lavo, uchemo chen ma sheamar hakkatuv "nega tzaraat vegomer vehuva el hakkohen" yechavven lomar sheyyechayyevuhu lavo im nitatztzel.

rashi: Vechol hannogea bechol asher yihye tachtav. shel zav; ba velimmed al hammerkav sheyyehe hannogea bo tame veen taun kibbus begadim, vehu chomer bammishkav mibbammerkav:
Vehannose otam. et kol haamur beinyan hazzav — zovo verukko veshichvat zaro umeme raglav vehammishkav vehammerkav — massaan metamme adam letamme vegadim (80 sifra):
Vechavsa achat. lechattat:
Ushelosha esronim. leniske shelosha chevashim hallalu, shechattato vaashamo shel metzora teunin nesachim (menachot 91):
Velog echad shamen. lehazzot alav sheva, velitten mimmennu al tenuch azno umattan behonot:
El michutz lammachane. chutz lishlosha machanot shennishtalach sham bime chaluto:
Vechi yithar. kesheyyifsok (sham):
Shivat yamim letohorato. shivat yamim tehorim mittumat ziva, shello yire zov, vechullan retzufin (sifra):
Chayyot. perat litrefot:
Tehorot. perat leof tame, lefi shehannegaim bain al lashon hara shehu maase fitpute devarim, lefichach huzkeku letohorato tzipporim shemmefatpetin tamid betziftzuf kol (arachin 16):
Veetz erez. lefi shehannegaim bain al gassut haruach (sham):
Usheni tolaat veezov. ma takkanato veyitrappe? yashpil atzmo miggaavato ketolaat ucheezov:
Etz erez. makkel shel erez:
Shene tolaat. lashon shel tzemer tzavua zehorit:
ohc: Vetzivva hakkohen velakach vegomer. razal betorat kohanim amru: tziuuy bechohen ulekicha bechol adam. vedarshu befasuk sheachar ze "vetzivva hakkohen veshachat" – tziuuy bechohen ushechita bechol adam, divre rabbi yehuda bar rabbi yose. rabbi omer: af shechita bechohen, ad kan. kashe, lamma lo nechleku rabbi yehuda verabbi ella befasuk sheni velo barishon? veim letzad ki "vetzivva velakach" en davar lehalebish batztziuuy levad hallekicha, gam "vetzivva veshachat" en yadua ma yesh batztziuuy levad hashshechita. veadrabba, betziuuy "velakach" yesh lanu lomar sheyyechavven lomar "vetzivva" sheyyaviu lefanav hatztzipporim veyikkachem hu miyyad hammeviim, ushete mitzvot tzerichin lihyot bechohen, ma sheen ken "vetzivva veshachat" – im nomar shehakkohen hu sheyyishchot, bamme nalbish hatztziuuy?

Veraiti levaal karban aharon shekkatav shehammitzva hi sheyyetzav lehavi lefanav hashshete tzipporim, livchor mehem achat hammeyuchedet vehammevoreret. vetaam shello chalak rabbi befasuk rishon hu letzad shello matza bamme yalbish hammitzva, ad kan. veen devarav nirim, ki mitzva zo shel habberera shetztzarich shettihye beyad kohen enah nishmaat meamro "vetzivva", veadrabba yesh lanu lomar shekkavvanat hakkatuv hu lomar sheyyetzavve livror haachat, veyirtze lomar hakkatuv shemmitzvat habberur al yede kohen vehabberur al yede hazzulat vehashshechita bechohen, veal kol panim yachol hu rabbi lefaresh befasuk rishon kederech shepperesh befasuk sheni.

Vehaya nire lefaresh, shettaam shechalak rabbi vesavar shehashshechita gam ken bechohen – lo letzad mashmaut hakkatuv, ella letzad ma shehu hainyan. ki tzivva Adonai shettihye hashshechita el keli cheres al mayim chayyim, ushechita zo enah bechinat shechita levad, shehare yesh immah maase acher sheyyishchot el keli vegomer, veze ikkar hachanat hattahara, velaze amar shetztzarich al yede kohen. ma sheen ken befasuk rishon sheen bilkichat hatztzipporim maase tahara, vehattora masra haddavar lachachamim lehavechin baddevarim.

Od nire lomar, ki al kol panim peshat hakkatuv kesheamar "vetzivva hakkohen velakach vegomer", kavvanato beamro "velakach" hu al hakkohen, ki en tzarich hakkatuv lehazekir hakkohen al kol davar vedavar. ma tomar sheyyomar "vetzivva velakach hakkohen", az hayinu omrim beiyyun nachon sheen hatztziuuy bakkohen lefi sheicher zichrono levassof, ma sheen ken amro "vetzivva hakkohen" shehizkir hakkohen battechilla, kol ma sheyyavo mehammaase achar kach yechavven lammuzekar kodem. umeatta kesheamar hakkatuv harishon "vetzivva hakkohen velakach", peshat hakkatuv hu shehakkohen yetzavve vehu yikkach. ella mimma sheamar hakkatuv achar kach "vetzivva hakkohen veshachat", hare ze mare baetzba ki ma sheamar hakkatuv "velakach" eno chozer el hakkohen, sheim bakkohen medabber hakkatuv ad atta, lamma hutzrach lomar "vetzivva hakkohen" paam sheniyya? halo bakkohen medabber ad atta, velo haya lo lomar ella "vetzivva veshachat" vaani yodea shebbakkohen medabber, ella vadday sheafsekeh acher, veeze hu? "velakach" hakkodem lah shemmedabber bechol adam. laze lechule alma, ben rabbi yehuda ben rabbi, sovrim befasuk rishon "vetzivva hakkohen velakach" kol haadam, ma sheen ken pasuk sheni sheen lanu hechreach, sover rabbi ki mikra omed kifshuto "vetzivva hakkohen veshachat" gam ken hakkohen hassamuch lo.
Verabbi yehuda sover "yaggid alav reo", achar shennitgalla lanu mippasuk rishon sheen chozeret tevat "velakach" el hakkohen hassamuch, kemo chen pasuk sheni yitparesh bekotev rishon.

Ella sheraiti sheddarshu sham betorat kohanim bitchillat happarasha veze leshonam: "torat hammetzora" bechohen vechulei, en li ella taharato vetumato bechohen, minnayin shechitat tzipporim vehazzaot vechulei vetiglachto? talmud lomar "torat hammetzora" bechohen. yachol af lekichat tzipporim veshilluach tzipporim vechibbus vechulei bechohen? talmud lomar "zot", ad kan. hinne mippeshat habbarayta mashma ki en tzorech sheyyihye bechohen ella shelosha peratim harshumim davka, veim ken en tzarich sheyyetzavve hakkohen lo al hallekicha velo al hashshechita, umishshete habbaraytot mashma lehedya dilchulle alma, ben lerabbi yehuda ben lerabbi, tzarich sheyyetzavve hakkohen shene devarim.

Veulay ki lo hizkir hattanna shene hatztziuuyim babbarayta im hashshelosha devarim, letzad shebbidrashat "torat hammetzora" enam nichlalim ella devarim shehem beguf hattahara, shehare miet harebe maasim meamro "zot", vezulat amro "vetzivva hakkohen" hayu hatztziuuyim gam ken mitmaatim. laze lo hizkir ella peratim hannidrashim meamro "torat hammetzora", aval hatztziuuyim en ze mekoman, veyiched lahem hakkatuv haddavar bimkomo veamar "vetzivva hakkohen" vegomer, vesamach hattanna al ma sheatid lefaresh befarashat "vetzivva hakkohen" tziuuy bechohen.

Ella sheraiti larambam (hilchot tumeat tzaraat perek 11 halacha Adonai) katav sheen tzarich bechohen ella shechitat tzipporim vehazzaa vetiglachat, velo hizkir kelal inyan tziuuyim sheyyihye bechohen, veadrabba kalal davar shave veamar ushear haddevarim ben bechohen uven beyisrael. vahagam shebbattosefta beferek 8 dingaim tanya kedivre rambam, sheen tzarich sheyyihye bechohen ella shelosha devarim ushear haddevarim bechol adam, vesham lo hizkir inyan tziuuy bechohen, min hassetam lo naamid hattosefta dela keman, venomar gam ken shehattanna beer haddevarim bemakom acher, vegam shemmevoar hu battora shehatztziuuy hu bechohen velo hutzrach leamro, ma sheen ken rambam shetztzarich hu levaer haddavar, veeno kol kach haddavar mevoar battora shennidchok lomar sheggam rambam lo hutzrach lechatvo, shehare roim anu shehattannaim hutzrechu lidrosh haddavar mehakkatuv.

Veen lomar desover rambam sheppeshat hattosefta sheamra "ushear haddevarim bechol adam" mashma afillu hatztziuuyim, udela kerabbi yehuda verabbi. im nomar ken tikshe od, ki davar pashut hu ki en lachush letosefta kazo sheenah lo kerabbi yehuda velo kerabbi shehuveu divrehem besifra deve rav hammezukkak.

Veefshar lomar shessover rambam mikkoach barayta rishona detorat kohanim, shehizkir devarim hatztzerichin kohen bidrashat pasuk "torat hammetzora" shekkol otam haddevarim hem tora leikkuva. uderashat "vetzivva hakkohen" hi al ze hadderech, shehakkohen hu yetzavve laasot haddevarim, vehu derech kavod sheyyihyu haddevarim naasim al piv uvemaamaro, al derech "veal picha yishshak kol ammi" (Bereshit 41:40), vehu amro hatztziuuy bechohen ligzor al haddavar vaacherim yaasu, umashmaut haddevarim maggidim ken sheen ze leikkuv ella lechavod lechohen. veod kal vachomer haddevarim, uma shilluach hatztzipporim vechulei amar hakkatuv sheeno meakkev, mikkol shekken mitzvat lekicha umitzvat shechita. verabbi sheamar gam hashshechita bechohen, lo mikkoach pasuk "vetzivva hakkohen veshachat", ella mikkoach derashat "torat hammetzora" sheggam hashshechita hi doma lahazzaa vetiglachat, vehu tanna rishon shekkalal hashshechita im hattiglachat vehazzaa.

rashi: Vechilletzu et haavanim. ketargumo: viyishlefun — yittelem mishsham, kemo vechaltza naalo (Devarim 25) — leshon hasara:
El makom tame. makom sheen teharot mishtammeshot sham, limmedcha hakkatuv shehaavanim hallalu metammeot mekoman beodan bo (sifra):
Lehorot beyom hattame. eze yom metaharo veeze yom metammeo (80 sifra):
Veim al hammishkav hiv. hashshochev o hayyoshev al mishkavah o al moshavah afillu lo naga bah, af hiv bedat tuma haamura bamikra haelyon, shettaun kibbus begadim:
Al hakkeli. lerabbot et hammerkav:
Benogo vo. eno medabber ella al hammerkav shennitrabba meal hakkeli":
Benogo vo yitma. veeno taun kibbus begadim, shehammerkav en maggao metamme adam letamme vegadim (kelim 103):
Verachatzu vammayim. gezerat melech hi shettitma haishsha bevia; veen hattaam mishshum nogea beshichvat zera, shehare magga bet hassetarim hu (nidda 41:):
ohc: Verachatzu vammayim. taam zichron rechitzato, amru zichronam livracha (torat kohanim) lehashevot lah mishpat rechitzatah lechol hattenaim harmuzim bedin rechitzato. veim tomar im laze nitkavven happasuk lo haya tzarich, vehayinu lomdim ken meamro "veishsha" betosefet 6 mosif al inyan rishon, lehashevot mishpat shenehem velitten et haamur haelyon battachton, kemo sheddarshu betorat kohanim befarashat vayyikra kol otam dinim shekkatuv bahem vav bitchilla. ulefi ma sheddarshu rabbotenu zichronam livracha betorat kohanim vav "veishsha" lerabbot ketanna bat shalosh shanim veyom echad, lefi ze im lo amar "verachatzu" hayinu dorshim havvav lemishpete harchitza velo yadinan tumea ketanna bat shalosh shanim veyom echad.

Vezulat divrehem haya nire lomar lefi ma sheamru (betorat kohanim) befasuk "asher tetze mimmennu shichvat zera" – ad shettetze tumato chutz livsaro, aval im lo yatzta hagam shehirgish ochez baamma uvolea hatteruma, ma sheen ken haishsha shettemea afillu benogaat shichvat zera bemistareha. laze amar "verachatzu" lomar sheen mashve shenehem ella birchitza, lo bemishpat hattuma. umeatta anu mefarshim amro "veishsha" beVav, ki gam haishsha lifamim yesh bah mishpat shave laish sheenah temea bemistareha lerabbanan im ba aleha shello kedarkah, ulerabbi yehuda bia rishona shel kalla (betorat kohanim kan, yevamot lod:), vediyyeku lah mittevat "otah". umeatta im lo amar "verachatzu" vehayiti ba ladun mishpete harchitza shebbaish laishsha mivvav "veishsha", hayiti dan nammi shemmetamme baish afillu lo yatzta shichvat zera chutz, veyigmor mehaishsha. vehayiti mefaresh amro "tetze" ki akiratah mimmekomo nikret yetzia, o al ze hadderech ki "tetze" leatid, perush kol sheruya latzet hagam shello yatzta tame, uchemo shemmatzinu baishsha. laze amar "verachatzu" legallot lecha shello nitteko beVav shel "veishsha" litten haamur shel ze baze. veim haya omer "verachatzu" belo vav "veishsha", hagam deikka tevat "otah" shemmimmenna dorshim miut lemar shello kedarkah ulemar hakkalla, az lo hayinu dorshim tevat "otah" bederech ze, vehayinu dorshim "otah" lidrasha acheret achar shennitgalla lanu beferush bappasuk shemmetamme bet setira, ma li kalla ma li vechulei. veadrabba haya makom lomar "otah" lerabbot kol setareha, aval meamro "veishsha" beVav hishva otam hakkatuv lishar tumat setarim delo metammeim. ulefi ma sheddarshu betorat kohanim "veishsha" lerabbot bat shalosh shanim veyom echad, gillu datam shessovrim shettevat "otah" meyuchedet hi ledarshah lemiut velo lerabbot, velaze nisheret vav "veishsha" meyutteret vedarshu levat shalosh shanim veyom echad.

rashi: Al tithaddar lifne melech. leheraot kevodcha ulehitgaot lifne melech o laamod lifne mi sheggadol mimmecha, ki tov sheyyomru lecha ale henna mishshettavo belo reshuto veyomru lecha tze:
targum: La tishtavhar kodam malka uveducheta deravreve la tekum:

rashi: Veyashav michutz leoholo. melammed sheasur betashmish hammitta (sham):
ohc: Vechibbes hammittaher vegomer. tzarich ladaat kibbus ze lamma, kevan sheodennu metamme begadim bime safro? vegam lema shepperashti (Vayikra 14:7) ki tuma zo shemmechabbes begadav aleha hi hafesakat hatztzaraat, kemo sheddiyyakti meamro "min hatztzaraat", af al pi chen lo yechabbes begadav veodennu metamme otam. uvetorat kohanim matzati sheamru veze leshonam: "vechibbes" ma ba lelammed? im lelammed shemmetamme begadim bemagga, kal vachomer mibbime safro vechulei, ella echad milletamme mishkav umoshav veechad milletamme bemagga, ad kan. uchefi ze amar vechibbes vegomer lomar sheppaska tumat mishkav umoshav. vehinne ikkar hechreach derashat torat kohanim enah ella mikkoach kushyatenu, velo hutzrechu lefarshah letzad peshitutah, ki zulat kushyatenu en hechreach amro "ma ba lelammed" hechreach, ki mi amar lanu shebba lelammed? dilma ba leatzmo shetztzarich lechabbes begadav yom shennithar mehatztzaraat veyom gemar sefirat shiva yamim, kemo shemmatzinu shetztzivva Adonai legalleach kol searo velirchotz kol besaro beyom shennithar vesof yeme hassefira, kemo chen tzivva Adonai al hakkibbus. ella vadday ikkar kushyato hi shello yechabbes im adayin metamme begadim, velaze behechreach atta omer shello ba ella lelammed davar, velaze amar: ma ba lelammed im lelammed vechulei kal vachomer hu veteretz vechulei.

Veraiti lerabbenu hillel shekkatav limchok girsat "letamme mishkav umoshav" mikkoach hahu sheamru beellu devarim (fesachim 67:) dezav chamur mimmetzora shemmetamme mishkav umoshav, vegorem letamme bevia. velidvarav tzarich limchok kamma baraytot gam ken habbaim sham betorat kohanim dekatane shehammetzora metamme mishkav umoshav. uchevar dacha devarav harav baal karban aharon bidchiyya sheen achareha semicha. uma sheamru beellu devarim shehazzav chamur mimmetzora, ken hu kefi haemet shebbime safro shel zav metamme mishkav umoshav vime safro shel metzora eno metamme mishkav umoshav, vehu haddavar shellamadnu meamro "vechibbes hammittaher" shete peamim, vechen pasku rambam vechol happoskim, verabbenu hillel lo kivven baze el hannachon.

Verachatz bammayim vegomer. betorat kohanim amru veze leshonam: "bammayim" – afillu beme mikve, vahalo din hu: zav sheeno taun hazzayat mayim chayyim taun biat mayim chayyim, metzora shettaun vechulei. talmud lomar "verachatz bammayim" afillu vechulei, ad kan. peshat divrehem hu sheddorshim yittur tevat "bammayim" shello haya tzarich lomar ella "verachatz", vechen peresh baal karban aharon. vekashe, vahalo kevar miet hakkatuv biat mayim chayyim bimtzora befarashat zav, kidtanya sham (Vayikra 15:13) betorat kohanim: "verachatz besaro bemayim chayyim" – hazzav taun mayim chayyim veen hammetzora taun mayim chayyim, vahalo din hu uma im hazzav vechulei, talmud lomar "besaro bemayim chayyim" – hazzav taun vechulei veen hammetzora taun vechulei, ad kan. mashma ki miyyittur tevat "besaro" doresh ken, vechen peresh harav baal karban aharon, im ken lamma hutzrach lomar "bammayim"? veefshar lomar ki ikkar derashat hattanna hu miyyittur tevat "bammayim", mimmenna doresh lerabbot me mikve, vetevat "besaro" itzterich lemaet begadav, kemo sheddarash sham gam ken betorat kohanim, uma shessamach gam ken lah miut mayim chayyim bimtzora, baagav, vesamach al yittur tevat "bammayim", uvaze lo kashya lamma doresh mittevat "besaro" shete derashot. uvaal karban aharon peresh ki doresh mimma shello amar "verachatz hazzav" veamar "besaro", velidvarenu en anu tzerichin laze.

Uma sheddarshu betorat kohanim befarashat tzav befasuk (Vayikra 6:21) "umorak veshuttaf bammayim" haamur bichli shennitbashshela bo chattat, veze leshonam: "veshuttaf" yachol bearbaim sea, talmud lomar "bammayim" kol shehen, "bammayim" velo beyayin velo bemazug, ad kan. en ledammot yittur "bammayim" haamur bechattat leyittur "bammayim" haamur kan, ki sham im lo amar "bammayim" lo hayiti matzricho ella arbaim sea me mikve, sheen lanu tzad lomar shetztzarich mayim chayyim lomar shebba hakkatuv lemaato, umuchrach lomar shebba lemaet gufan shel arbaim sea. ma sheen ken "bammayim" haamur kan, kevan sheyyesh tzad lomar shetztzerichin mayim chayyim uva yittur "bammayim", shadenan leh lemaet mayim chayyim, vehabba lomar shemmemaet arbaim sea alav lehavi reaya minnayin. uma shehosif sham lidrosh "bammayim" velo beyayin vechulei, en ze ella mehammashmaut velo mehayyittur. veayyen pasuk sheachar ze yishshuv hainyan beofen acher.

rashi: Ki yihye zav. yachol zav mikkol makom yehe tame, tal mibbesaro, — velo chol besaro. achar shechillek hakkatuv ben basar levasar zachiti ladin, timme vezav vetimme vezava, ma zava mimmakom shehi mittammea tuma kalla — "nidda" — mittammea tuma chamura — "ziva" — af hazzav mimmakom shemmittamme tuma kalla — "keri" — mittamme tuma chamura — "ziva" (sham):
Zovo tame. limmed al hattippa shehi metammea; zov dome leme vatzek shel seorin, vedachuy, vedome leloven betza hammuzeret, shichvat zera kashur, keloven betza sheenah muzeret:
ohc: Dabberu el bene yisrael vaamartem vegomer. kol ze meyuttar achar sheamar "vaydabber vegomer lemor". veulay sheyyechavven lomar al pi divrehem sheamru (torat kohanim) bene yisrael mittammein beziva veen ummot haolam mittammein beziva. laze amar dabberu, perush leshon koshi shettimtza tuma bahem yoter mehaggoyim, yisrael zav metamme mishkav umoshav veen haggoy zav metamme mishkav umoshav. veamar vaamartem, perush leshon maala, al derech amro (Devarim 26:17) "heemarta" veheemircha", hakkavvana baze shehagam shehu mazkik bahem hattuma yoter, ze hu lemaala lahem, shehem yeshnam betahara, veen ummot haolam betahara, vehu sod "en shote nifga" (shabbat 13:).

Ish ish ki yihye zav vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma kafal lomar ish ish. veulay sheyyodia ma sheamru zichronam livracha bammidrash (451 deve eliyyahu perek 15) raa adam keri shechayyav tevila, veamar: "mi roe oti? en bechach kelum". shuv raa paam sheniyya, amar: "mi roe oti?", paam shelishit, avar al ma shekkatuv "paamayim shalosh im gaver" (Iyov 33:29), hu naase zav vechulei, ad kan. ze hu sheramaz beamro ish ish, perush paam rishona ish, al derech amro (Devarim 23:11) "ish ki lo yihye tahor mikkere layla", veamar paam sheniyya, ish, lirmoz al paam sheniyya, im chazar bo mutav, im lav yihye zav gamur veyitbol letuma chamura.

Zovo tame hu. razal darshu betorat kohanim al ze hadderech: "zovo hu tame" – limmed al hazzov shehu tame. vahalo din hu: hazzav shehu garam lo tuma tame, hazzov shehu gorem tuma eno din vechulei, sair hammishtalleach yochiach vechulei shehu tahor umetamme, talmud lomar "zovo hu tame". vedarshu od al ze hadderech: "hu tame" veen dam hayyotze mehaamma tame. perush, shehayiti dan kal vachomer merukko: uma rok shehu yotze mimmekom tahara tame, dam sheyyotze mimmekom tuma eno din vechulei, talmud lomar "hu". uchederech sheddan hattanna sham kesheratza lehatzerich ribbuy leme raglayim shemmetammeim, vedan kal vachomer merukko vesatar lah middam hayyotze, talmud lomar "vezot" lerabbot me raglayim. uveferek dam nidda (nidda 56.) hikshu: uma raita lerabbot me raglayim ulemaet dam hayyotze? veamar rabbi shimon: merabbe ani me raglayim letuma dedome lerok shemmitaggel veyotze vechozer venivla, ma sheen ken haddam, ad kan.

Vekashe, im ken lo lichtov ella ribbuy "vezot", vaani yoshev vedan ribbuy ze lamma, halo ben me raglayim ben dam hayyotze baim bekal vachomer merukko. umikkoach ze hayiti machriach lomar shello ladun kal vachomer, venomar shebba hakkatuv listor kal vachomer shettechayyevcha lerabbot me raglayim vedam hayyotze, velo ribba ella echad mehem. veleda eze mehem hu hammitrabbe, yadun bedome larok shemmitaggel vechulei kedivre rabbi shimon, velo haya tzarich lichtov miut "hu". veen lidchot sheaz hayiti omer shebba ribbuy "vezot" ledam hayyotze, hagam sheeno mitaggel vechulei, aval me raglayim ate bekal vachomer – ze taut, ki kesheanu baim ladun bekal vachomer meharok sheeno yotze mimmekom tuma, anu danin me raglayim vedam hayyotze keechad bekal vachomer, shehare hem shavim batztzad hechamur, sheyyatzu mimmekom tuma, velo tzarich ribbuy ledam im lo shettomar deata kera listor lakkal vachomer. vetimtza sheggam hattanna sheggamar miut haddam mimmiut "hu", keshebba lilmod me raglayim mikkal vachomer derukko, dacha "dam hayyotze yochiach" sheeno nilmad bekal vachomer, velo dacha pircha zo "ma ledam hayyotze sheeno mitaggel" vechulei. umeatta keshello yihye ella ribbuy "vezot", titchayyev meatzmecha lomar shehattora menaatcha milladun kal vachomer ze kede shello tadun hakkol, vaani yodea ki ma shebba letaher hu dam hayyotze.

Umikkoach ze baniti makom lefaresh, shennitkavven hakkatuv beyittur tevat "hu" lomar, ki en gufo shel zav levad hu hammetamme et bealav, ella hu siman asher yaase Adonai battame letzad maasav haraim, vehodia Adonai ki adam sheyyihye bo siman ze hu lo lesiman ki ish tame hu. vetevat "hu" sheamar hakkatuv chozeret el haadam shettame hu. velaze yetzav Adonai mishpat haadam shehu atzmo av hattuma letamme adam vechelim, vahagam dehattanna derashah lemiut dam, ze haya kodem derashat "vezot", veachar derashat "vezot" nachzor ladun velidrosh. veharebe peamim doresh betorat kohanim bederech ze, vechan hinniach makom ledorshe tora.

rashi: Gam elle mishle shelomo asher hetiku. chazar ledorsham, keshennitmanna chizkiyyahu lemelech vehu hoshiv talmidim bechol ir, kedamrinan beferek chelek (sanhedrin tzad:): badku middan vead beer sheva velo matzu am haaretz:
Hetiku. hecheziku:
targum: Af ilen matloy dishlomo amike dichtavu rachamoy dechizkeya malka dihuda:

rashi: Sefatayim yishshak. reuyim kol sefatayim lenashsheko:
targum: Sifvathon ninsheku deilen dimhappechin mile teritzata:

ohc: Veim tahara mizzovah vesafra vegomer. tzarich ladaat gezerat hakkatuv beeze makom hi, im hassefira haya lo lomar "tispor lah", veim "achar tithar" lo haya lo lomar "veachar". venire al pi ma sheamru betorat kohanim veze leshonam: "veim tahara mizzovah" – keshettifsok mizzovah, ad kan. lefi ze tihye gezerat hakkatuv tevat mizzovah, vehache kaamar veim tahara – teda meeze zeman tikkare tehora mizzovah, meet nifseka zovah nikret tehora lispor shiva yamim, vehu sheamru keshettifsok mizzovah, vehaven. vetimtza shepperesh Rashi beferek kamma dimgilla (Megila 8.) veze leshono: keshettifsok mizzovah lealtar tispor, sheenah tzericha litbol kodem. vehu mechuvvan lema shekkatavti.

Veim tahara perush, nistallek hazzov, shekken hu mashmaut tevat "tahara". velo tachshov shebbehistallek hazzov nistalleka tuma mimmenna, lo chen, shello nistalleka ella tumat hazzov atzmo, vehu amro "mizzovah", aval lo tumat magga zov, veodenna temea vetzarich lispor shiva nekiyyim, vehu amro "vesafra lah vegomer veachar tithar" mikkol.
Chassalat parashat metzora

rashi: Kenega nira li babbayit. sheafillu hu chacham veyodea shehu nega vadday, lo yifsok davar barur lomar "nega nira li", ella "kenega nira li":
ohc: Vehiggid lakkohen lemor. tevat lemor meyutteret. verabbotenu zichronam livracha betorat kohanim darshu: yomar lo hakkohen divre kibbushin, ad kan. veze derech derash, ki hakkatuv medabber divre asher lo habbayit. vehem zichronam livracha derashuha beim eno inyan ledivre baal habbayit tenehu inyan ledivre kohen. uvaal karban aharon peresh al ze hadderech: "vehiggid lakkohen" vehattachlit "lemor" lo hakkohen, ratza lomar divre kibbushin. ulefi ze haya lo lomar tevat "lemor" achar "kenega nira li babbayit", ella vadday shehattanna darash hatteva beim eno inyan.

Vekashe lamma lo amar hakkatuv tevat "lemor" bedivre hakkohen, vetiddaresh hadderasha beyosher, umakom hinnichu lanu lefaresh. vehu al pi divrehem zichronam livracha atzmam shekkatvu sham betorat kohanim veze leshonam: "nega" ma talmud lomar "kenega"? afillu talmid chacham veyodea shehu nega bevadday lo yigzor vechulei, ella yomar "kenega" ad kan. veyesh ladaat mi hichricham zichronam livracha lefaresh ken, dilma taam amro "kenega" velo amar "nega", ki chash hakkatuv lomar "nega" shettavin shello chiyyavto tora lavo etzel hakkohen ulehaggid ella im talmid chacham hu veyada shehu vadday nega, aval im nistappek bo im hu nega o lo, lo yavo lakkohen. laze amar "kenega" sheyyavo al hassafek kevadday. achen derashat hattanna hi shello haya lo lomar ella "vehiggid lakkohen", vehaddavar muvan shehahaggada hi hannega hammuzkar besamuch, velaze darash ki hayyittur ba al haddikduk "kenega" velo "nega", sheafillu talmid chacham vechulei lo yomar "nega" ella "kenega", vechol ze ledaat hattanna.
