Umakom hinnichu lanu gam ken baze lachkor bedivrehem zichronam livracha, halo lefi ma sheddarshu od sham betorat kohanim veze leshono: "nira li" – velo leneri, "babbayit" – lehavi et haaliyya vechulei, vechamma derashot, meatta tzarich hakkatuv lomar "kenega" kede sheyyomar "nira li babbayit" lilmod hammishpatim hahemma, uminnayin lanu lidrosh sheafillu yada vadday shehu nega yomar "kenega"? vahagam shedderech rabbotenu zichronam livracha lidrosh hakketuvim beseder ze, af al pi chen kol od shennuchal leyashshev hadderasha beseder hechrechi hu yoter nachon, uvaze hirvachnu et shellanu, perush tevat "lemor", shennitkavven lomar al ze hadderech lemor kenega, perush hagam shekkefi haemet yada shehu nega veeno kenega ella bemaamaro, af al pi chen yomar ken. veshiur tevat "lemor" hu al ze hadderech: haamira tihye "kenega", umimmotza davar atta mevin sheeno kenega ella bemaamaro velo betzedek haddavar. uvaze gam ken hirvachnu derashat hattanna sheddarash betevat "kenega" sheratza lomar sheafillu talmid chacham vechulei. od yechavven lomar shehattora matteret lemor "kenega", umimmela atta mevin sheeno kenega shehutzrach lehattir. uchevar katavti kamma peamim ki reshut netuna lanu lidrosh happesukim bechamma panim meshunnim middivrehem zichronam livracha, kol shemmityashshevim happesukim al nachon, kol sheen hafekiyyut divre rabbotenu zichronam livracha bahalachot.

Zot torat vegomer asher lo vegomer. kol hakkatuv meyuttar, verabbotenu zichronam livracha darshu (torat kohanim) "zot torat" sheribba havaat karban ashir leani im yirtze. veim tomar lamma tzarich kera, vahalo hassevara notenet ken shello ba hakkatuv ella lehakel mealav, veim yirtze tavo alav birkat tov? venire ki letzad sheratza hakkatuv lemaet ashir im hevi karban ani shello yatza, uchemo shedderashuha meamro "zot" miut, chash hakkatuv lomar shehikpid al hakkol bema shemmiet veamar "zot" – ani beanyo veashir beashro, talmud lomar torat.

Vaadayin en yadua lamma amar hakkatuv asher lo tassig yado vegomer. veulay shechash hakkatuv sheyyavo hechacham veyilmod mishpat hesseg yad haamur bimtzora middin hesseg yad haamur betumat mikdash vekadashav ushevuat haala vechulei (Vayikra 5:7), sheyyeshnam gam ken bekarban dalle dallut, uvimkom shete torim echad ola veechad chattat meviim asirit haefa, veyilmad haamur bammetzora sheggam hu im lo hissiga yado laofot yavi asirit haefa, talmud lomar "zot torat asher vegomer asher lo tassig yado betohorato", perush hagam shello hissiga yado betaharato harshuma shehem bene yona vechulei, af al pi chen yitpallesh beafar veyamut veyavi shete torim o shene bene yona davka.

Uvederech remez efshar sheramaz hakkatuv lema sheamru bazzohar hakkadosh (Tikkunim 22) ki haaniyyut nikret tzaraat, velaze shenehem nikraim metim (nedarim sad.), vehu ma sheramaz beamro asher bo nega tzaraat perush odennu hannega bo, uma hu hannega, peresh veamar asher lo tassig yado betohorato perush shello matza yado letzad anyo lehavi karban hatztzarich letaharato mitztzarato ad shehutzrach lehavi ofot.

rashi: Beorech appayim yefutte katzin. beod shehakkadosh baruch hu maarich appo veeno nifra, yittenu lev hachotim lefattoto bitshuva utefilla:
Velashon rakka. bitfilla vetachanunim:
Tishbar garem. etzem koshi haggezera:
targum: Bingiduta derucha mishtargeg rashana umilta rechichta tavra garma:

rashi: Veish asher yigga bemishkavo. limmed al hammishkav shechamur min hammagga, shezze naase av hattuma letamme adam letamme vegadim, vehammagga sheeno mishkav eno ella velad hattuma, veeno metamme ella ochalin umashkin (80 sifra):
Vechol hammerkav. aappi shello yashav alav, kegon hattefus shel seraga, shekkorin 347, tame mishshum merkav, vehaukkaf shekkorin salevaysh tame tumat moshav (eruvin 27):

Veyadav lo shataf bammayim. beod shello taval mittumato, vaafillu fasak mizzovo vesafar shiva umechussar tevila, metamme vechol tumotav, veze shehotzi hakkatuv tevilat gufo shel zav bilshon shetifat yadayim, lelammedcha sheen bet hassetarim taun biat mayim, ella ever haggaluy kemo hayyadayim (sifra):
Bayyom hashshemini letohorato. shemini letzipporim ulehazzaat etz erez veezov usheni tolaat:
Vehappittita bisfatecha. titpatte lereacha bedibburecha:
targum: La teheve sahada ragala bechavrach uteshargeg besifvatach:

rashi: Uva hakkohen veraa vehinne pasa. yachol lo yehe hachozer tame ella im ken pasa, neemar tzaraat mameret babbattim, veneemar tzaraat mameret bavogodoym, ma lehallan timme et hachozer aappi sheeno fose, af kan timme et hachozer aappi sheeno fose, im ken ma tal vehinne fasa? en kan mekomo shel mikra ze, ella "venatatz et habbayit" haya lo lichtov achar "veim yashuv hannega"; "veraa vehinne pasa" ha lo va lelammed ella al nega haomed beenav beshavua rishon, uva vesof shavua sheni umetzao sheppasa — shello peresh bo hakkatuv lemala chelum beomed beenav beshavua rishon — velimmedcha kan befisyon ze, sheeno medabber ella beomed barishon ufasa vashsheni; uma yaase lo? yachol yittetzennu, kemo shessamach lo "venatatz et habbayit", tal veshav hakkohen, uva hakkohen, nilmad bia mishshiva, ma shiva choletz vekotze vetach venoten lo shavua, af bia choletz vekotze vetach venoten lo shavua, veim chozer notetz, lo chazar tahor. uminnayin sheim amad baze uvaze choletz vekotze vetach venoten lo shavua? talmud lomar veim bo yavo, bamme hakkatuv medabber? im befose barishon, hare chevar amur, im befose vashsheni, hare chevar amur, ha eno omer veim bo yavo ella et shebba vesof shavua rishon uva vesof shavua sheni veraa vehinne lo fasa; ze haomed ma yaase lo? yachol yippater veyelech, kemo shekkatuv kan vetihar et habbayit? tal ki nirpa hannaga — lo tiharti ella harafuy, ma yaase lo? bia amura lemala uvia amura lematta, ma baelyona choletz vekotze vetach venoten lo shavua — degamar lah zehu shiva zehu via — af battachtona chen vechulei, kidita vetorat kohanim. gemaro shel davar en netitza ella benega hachozer achar chalitza vekitztzua veticha, veen hachozer tzarich pisyon. veseder hammikraot kach hiv: veim yashuv, venatatz, vehabba el habbayit, vehaochel babbayit, uva hakkohen veraa vehinne fasa, vedibber hakkatuv baomed barishon shennoten lo shavua sheni lehesgero, uvesof shavua sheni lehesgero ba veraahu sheppasa, uma yaashe lo? choletz vekotze vetach venoten lo shavua, chazar, notetz, lo chazar, taun tzipporim; sheen bannegaim yoter mishshelosha shavuot (80 sifra).

Kol hammishkav. harauy lemishkav; yachol afillu meyuchad limlacha acheret, tal asher yishkav — asher shachav lo neemar ella asher yishkav — hameyuchad tamid lechach, yatza ze sheomrin lo "amod venaase melachtenu":
Asher yeshev. yashav lo neemar ella asher yeshev alav, bamyuchad tamid lechach (shabbat 59):
Al mekom dam haasham. afillu nitkannach haddam; limmed, sheen haddam gorem ella hammakom gorem (sifra):
Vehizzartem. en nezira ella ferisha vechen nazoru achor (Yeshayahu 1), vechen nezir echav (Bereshit 49):
Velo yamutu betumatam. hare hikkaret shel metamme mikdash karuy mita:
Yamim rabbim. shelosha yamim (sifra):
Belo et niddatah. achar sheyyatzu shivat yeme niddatah:
O ki tazuv. et sheloshet hayyamim hallalu:

Al niddatah. muflag minniddatah yom echad, zo hi zava, umishpatah charutz befarasha zo, velo kedat hannidda, shezzo teuna sefirat shiva nekiyyim vekarban, vehannidda enah teuna sefirat nekiyyim, ella shivat yamim tihye veniddatah ben roa ben sheenah roa. vedarshu befarasha zo 11 yom ben sof nidda litchillat nidda, shekkol sheloshet retzufin shettire veachad asar yom hallalu tehe zava:
Kol yeme hisgir oto. velo yamim shekkalaf et nigo; yachol sheani motzi hammuchlat shekkalaf et nigo, tal kol yeme:

Yitma ad haarev. melammed sheen metamme vegadim; yachol afilu shaha vichde achilat peras, tal vehaochel babbayit yechabbes et begadav, en li ella ochel, shochev minnayin? tal vehashshochev, en li ella ochel veshochev, lo ochel velo shochev minnayin? tal yechabbes yechabbes ribba; im ken lamma neemar ochel veshochev? litten shiur lashshochev kede achilat peras (sham):
Hachen bachutz. ze mikra:
Veattedah bassade. zo mishna:

Achar uvanita vetecha. zo gemara (sota 44.). davar acher: kemashmao, battechilla kach lecha sadot ucheramim, veachar kach veattedah, leshon "attudim" (Bereshit 31:10) – sim lecha behemot bassade, vachar uvanita vetecha. tikkach ishsha:
targum: Atken levara avidtach veatteda lach vechakla uvatar ken bene vetach:

rashi: Et kol searo vegomer. kelal uferat uchelal, lehavi kol mekom kinnus sear venire (sota 16):
ohc: Verachatz et besaro bammayim – tzarich ladaat lamma amar "besaro", lefi ma shemmatzinu sheddarshu zichronam livracha bema shekkatuv bezav (Vayikra 15:13): "verachatz besaro", lamma amar "besaro"? vedarshu lemaet metzora ulemaet begadav. shete derashot hallalu lo yutzdeku beyittur "besaro" haamur kan. gam lamma amar "bammayim" yetera, vechan lo yutzdak ma sheddarshu befasuk rishon, mishshum ki betahara rishona haya lanu litot lehatzericho mayim chayyim mimma sheyyesh behazzaato mayim chayyim, uvetahara sheniyya en lanu makom ladun bah mayim chayyim. veim bata lomar shekkol taharat hammetzora inyan echad hu, im ken hare kevar miet mayim chayyim afillu betahara sheyyesh bah lehedya mayim chayyim.

Veyesh lomar, mishshum shehaya makom levaal haddin lachlok velomar: lo miet hakkatuv biat mayim chayyim mehammetzora ella letahara rishona sheen ole bah mittumato kezav shennithar lachalutin mittumato, aval tahara sheniyya sheole bah mittumato lachalutin ketaharat zav, adayin ani dan bimkomo shello yigra mehazzav vetzarich biat mayim chayyim. vahagam shebbetahara zo en bah hazzaat mayim chayyim shehu koach hakkal vachomer, af al pi chen taharat hammetzora inyan echad hu kullah, talmud lomar bammayim paam sheniyya lomar sheafillu battahara hammaalehu mikkol tuma en tzarich biat mayim chayyim kezav.

Vedikdek lomar besaro shealav ba hammishpat bezav shetztzarich biat mayim chayyim, vezulat zichron "besaro" kan hayiti omer shello miet mayim chayyim ella lechelav, aval besaro odennu niddon bekal vachomer mehazzav. vahagam shekkelav enam baim bekal vachomer mehazzav sheyyutzrach hakkatuv lemaatam, ucheshennavo ladun kal vachomer mehazzav nomar dayyo labba min haddin lihyot kanniddon, ma hanniddon gufo velo kelav vechulei, af al pi chen adayin yesh makom lachush labba lisbor velomar, kevan shemmatzinu shehitzrich behazzaato mayim chayyim, gam kelav tzerichin mayim chayyim. talmud lomar verachatz besaro bammayim, "bammayim" yetera lomar sheole beme mikve afillu besaro.

Veim tomar, yomar hakkatuv "verachatz besaro bammayim" velo yitzrach lomar "bammayim" befasuk acher. mishshum shehayiti omer lo miet hakkatuv biat mayim chayyim ella betahara sheniyya sheen bah mishpat hazzaat mayim chayyim, ma sheen ken tevila rishona shemmatzinu shehitzrich hazzaat mayim chayyim, adayin ani dan kal vachomer mizzav – talmud lomar "bammayim". veen lehakeshot al ze, ki en anu yecholin lomar shello ba hammiut ella betahara sheniyya mishshum sheen bah hazzaat mayim chayyim, shehare en atta matzrich hammiut lemaet bah mayim chayyim ella mishshum kal vachomer, vehakkal vachomer eno chal ella im tomar kol taharat hammetzora achat hi, umishpat mayim chayyim sheamar hakkatuv bimtzora betahara rishona yesovev ladun kal vachomer afillu al tahara sheniyya, veim ken keshebba hammiut betahara sheniyya keillu ba gam betahara rishona velo haya tzarich. zo enah kushya, shehayiti omer ki mimma shello miet hakkatuv ella betahara sheniyya velo betahara rishona, baze akar li sevara shehayiti omer shekkol taharat hammetzora achat hi, vehayiti matzrich bimtzora biat mayim chayyim bishte tevilot. talmud lomar "besaro bammayim" bitvila sheniyya, lemaet biat mayim chayyim, vehinniach hakkal vachomer meyuchad litvila rishona davka. talmud lomar "bammayim" bitvila rishona, sheafillu tevila rishona sheyyesh bah hazzaat mayim chayyim en tzericha biat mayim chayyim. ella adayin yesh lanu lomar shebbitvila sheniyya hu shemmemaet "besaro", aval tevila rishona lo miet lehedya "besaro", uchemo shepperashti im lo haya omer "besaro" befasuk sheni, veyadayim mochichot al haddavar mimma sheddikdek hakkatuv lomar "besaro" betahara sheniyya velo betahara rishona, hare ze mare baetzba ki betahara rishona tzarich biat mayim chayyim livsaro. umeatta banu lema shehutzrechu lidrosh mibbesaro" sheamar hakkatuv bezav shebba lemaet besaro shel metzora, vehikshenu lamma hutzrach, vahalo kevar nitmaet mittevat "bammayim", meatta en kushya, ki tzarich miut ze gam ken lemaet gam tevilat gufo. uma shekkava hattanna hammiut shel gufo mittevat "bammayim", ikkar derashato hu mibbesaro" haamura baze, vekava hattanna ikkar haddin bimkomo, vehaven.

Uvederech remez tirmoz happarasha al galut yisrael, al derech amro besefer hazzohar ki ummot haolam leyisrael hem bechinat hatztzaraat, veyishletu vahem letzad hattaam atzmo sheyyesovev hatztzaraat. vetimtza gam ken sheamru zichronam livracha shello nigalu yisrael mimmitzrayim ella letzad shello haya vahem baale lashon hara, dichtiv "veshaala ishsha" vegomer (Shemot 3:22), vedavar ze haya beyadam shenem asar chodesh vechulei. gam en lecha davar shemmarchik haadam min kono kelashon hara, velaze amra hattora zot tihye torat hammetzora shehu am bene yisrael shennitztara benige bene adam hattemeim, beyom tohorato sheyyetaher leshono uderachav, vehuva el hakkohen ki Adonai baruch hu yitkanne beshem kohen, kaamur besefer hazzohar befasuk "vehuva el hakkohen". veamar "vehuva" letzad shennitrachek, achshav yitkarev uva el hakkohen, vetechef umiyyad "ki mi goy gadol vegomer elohim kerovim elav". veamar "vehuva", perush, meatzmo yitkarev ki maasav yekarvuhu veyikkare karov, dichtiv "shalom vegomer velakkarov" (Yeshayahu 57:19), veaz "veyatza Adonai venilcham" vegomer (Zecharya 14:3). vehu amro veyatza hakkohen el michutz lammachane shehi chutz lemachane shechinato lechutza laaretz makom tame, sheshsham baavonotenu hem golim bene yisrael, veraa vehinne nirpa hannega shebbaado ba hatztzaraat, shechazru bitshuva venitharu.

Vetzivva hakkohen velakach lammittaher shete tzipporim chayyot tehorot – hem shene meshichim, venikra tzippor ki chen yitkannu neshamot haelyonot kayyadua. veod matzinu sheyyitkanne haggoel letzippor, veze lecha leshon hazzohar befarashat balak (Bamidbar 24:17): umehahu mearta yisge chad ofa ravreva illaa deyishlot bealma veleh yityehiv malchuta vechulei ad kan. umatzinu sheamru zichronam livracha sheshshene meshiche yisrael hem mashiach ben efrayim umashiach ben david, uvattechilla yitgalle mashiach ben efrayim veyamut, veachar kach yitgalle mashiach ben david. ucheneged shene ellu amar "velakach lammittaher shete tzipporim chayyot tehorot", kol ellu hakkinnuyim hem maalot hakkedushsha kayyadua leyode daat.

Veamro veetz erez usheni tolaat veezov – remez lizchut shelosha avot: etz erez hu avraham shehu haadam haggadol baanakim, usheni tolaat yaakov al derech amro "al tiri tolaat yaakov" (Yeshayahu 41:14), veezov hu yitzchak shehu bechinat haggevura, shetztzarich tzeruf zechut shelashtan.

Veamar veshachat, kan ramaz laharigat mashiach ben efrayim, kemaamaro yitbarach el keli cheres al mayim chayyim, perush, bishvil kapparat haam pidyon nafsham. vechinna otam keli cheres al derech "vayyitzer Adonai et haadam afar min haadama" (Bereshit 2:7) shehu keli cheres. vehakkavvana baze, letzad shennisharu kichli cheres sheomed lishvira, letzad geron hattora hammityacheset lemayim chayyim, al sibbat mayim chayyim sheen beyisrael tora, veal ze tishshachet hatztzippor haachat. gam beemtzaut davar ze yilbash Adonai bigde nakam hefech middotav harachamim, veyaase kala laggoyim hammereim. umimmotza davar atta yodea sheim yihye bahem tora lo yamut hatztzaddik. vetimtza shekkatav haari zichrono livracha shetztzarich lechavven battefilla hakkevua lehitpallel al ze hatztzaddik shello yamut, perush, ki beemtzaut hattefilla yitrabbe zechuto veyoomad chay vetitbattel gezerat mavet mimmennu.

Veamar et hatztzippor hachayya shehu mashiach ben david, yikkach otah hakkadosh baruch hu vitzaref immo zechut haavot, vitzaref nikmat hatztzaddik shenneherag. vehu amro "yikkach otah veet etz vegomer vetaval otam bedam hatztzippor hashshechuta", veyitgabberu harachamim mizzechut haavot umimmashiach hanneherag, veyitkapperu kol haderagot hattumot umeniot devekut yisrael. vehu ma sheramaz hakkatuv kan beamro vehizza al hammittaher, perush, inyan kappara, ki lemaan zechut haavot ulemaan eshkol hanneherag hu kofer vichapper al bene yisrael. veamar shiva keneged shiva haderagot hattuma asher yittammeu bahem bet yisrael, ki hem shiva kayyadua, vehen henna harmuzim betumat met vetumat nidda dichtiv "ketumat hannidda" vegomer. uvaze vetiharo, veaz veshillach et hatztzippor hachayya, keamro besefer hazzohar befarashat balak veze leshono: umehahi mearta yisge chad ofa ravreva illaa deyishlot bechol alma veleh yityehiv malchuta vechulei. vehu amro al pene hassade shehu olam hazze shettihye sholetet bechol haolam. veaz vechibbes hammittaher shehem yisrael et begadav hem begadim hatztzoim shehayu melubbashim benishmato, kederech amro (Zecharya 3:4) "hasiru habbegadim hatztzoim". vegillach et kol searo shehem bechinat tzimche hachomer heachur, verachatz bammayim hu hattora bah yetaher machshevotav, veachar yavo el hammachane ze machane shechina, yerushalayim hayyoredet benuya milmala.

Veamar veyashav michutz leoholo, ki lo yikrevu lehizdavveg lashshechina ad sheyyeshvu shiva nekiyyim lachashash tuma, uvayyom hashshevii yihyu reuyim lekabbalat hearat hakkedushsha. kayyotze baze timtza sheamar bichezkel (Yechezkel 43:26): "shivat yamim yechapperu et hammizbeach vetiharu oto". nimtzeta omer shete teharot: tahara harishona harechakat hattuma, vehashsheniyya hi hakeravat hakkedushsha.

rashi: Veet hammincha. minchat nesachim shel behema:
Zot torat hazzav. baal reiyya achat, umahu torato?
Vaasher tetze mimmennu shichvat zera — hare hu kevaal keri, tame tumat erev:
Asher rau enecha. sheddavar ze emet:
targum: Metul detav denemar lach suk hacha man demashpilach kodam shalita man dechazyan aynach:

rashi: Hago sigim mikkasef. mashuch, kemo "kaasher hoga min hammesilla" (Shmuel 2 20:13); keshem sheen hakkeli shel kesef yotze limlechet tzoref ad sheyyotziu mimmennu sigim shel nechoshet shebbo, kach en tzibbur niftarin meonesh ad sheyyotziu mittocham harshaim veyaasu bahem din:
targum: Gevu suleana min suma denippuk man min tzarfa:

rashi: Vehayyoshev al hakkeli. afillu lo naga — afilu ashara chelim ze al ze — kullan metammein mishshum moshav, vechen bemishkav:
Veissaron solet echad. lecheves ze shehu echad, yavi issaron echad linsachav:
Velog shamen. latet mimmennu al habbehonot; veshemen shel niske hammincha lo huzkak hakkatuv lefaresh:
ohc: Veim dal hu veen yado masseget. tzarich ladaat lamma kafal? veulay shennitkavven al derech ma sheamru beferek batra dichretot (27:) veze leshon hammishna: hifrish lechisba o lisira, heeni yavi of vechulei, ad kan. uvaggemara (sham) lamdu haddavar mimma sheamar hakkatuv bekarban ole veyored "mechattato asher chata", mashma mimmiktzat haddavar shehifrish lechattato, ad kan. vehinne derasha zo yeshnah beole veyored sheyyeshno bedalle dallut, ki sham hizkir hakkatuv "mechattato" shemmimmenna darshu. aval metzora yesh levaal haddin lachlok velomar: keshem shello matzinu bo sheyyuchal lehavi karban dalle dallut vehechmir bo hakkatuv, gam nachmir bo im hifrish keves vechisba lechattato veolato vehutzrach lahem, shello yavi miktzat haddavar shehifrish lechattato lehavi bimkoman shete torim o shene bene yona. talmud lomar veen yado masseget, shehagam shello haya dal vehifrish meosher, im en yado masseget yachol hu lehotzi hammaot hammufrashim lechullin veyavi kapparat hassagat yad. vetimtza shello chilleku razal ben ole veyored shel metzora leole veyored shel tumat mikdash vechulei ushevuat bittuy vechulei.

O yirtze al derech ma sheamru besof keretot (keritut koach.) beotah sheheveti besamuch, veze leshonam: hifrish laasirit haefa veheeshir yavi of, heeshir yavi kisba, ad kan, veamru sham sheddarshu chen middichtiv "al chattato". vechan ramaz haddavar beamro dal hu veen yado vegomer, perush veodennu en yado masseget, aval im hissiga yado hagam shehifrish bihyoto dal yavi karban ashir, ushene derachim ellu yuseblu yachad bemashmaut hakkatuv al ze hadderech, veodennu en yado masseget ben lechumera ben lekula kannizkar.

Uvetorat kohanim amru, veze leshonam: "dal hu" – shomea ani dal mimma shehaya ben mea mane venaasa ben chamishshim, talmud lomar "veen yado" vegomer, o "veen yado" vegomer – yesh lo veen motze likkach, talmud lomar "dal" ad kan. vetzarich ladaat kavvanat "veen motze", im en motze kol ikkar kemo shehayu bayyamim shehayta yerushalayim bammatzor, vadday shemmevi karban ani, vahare hu kechasre mamon, ki ma li en lo mamon o yesh lo veeno shave kelum beerech hakkarban kevan sheeno massigo bemamon, ella vadday shekkavvanat hattanna hi sheenah metzuya bekinyan haragil vetzarich hu lehafelig keniyyatah bemamon rav.

Venire shello yitchayyev ella im beshiur shello yihye hu chaser lema shetztzarich leatzmo, shehare afillu yarad anu omrim sheyyavi karban ani veyichye mehannishar. uferush ze shel divre razal eno soter devarenu, veellu vaellu divre elohim chayyim. veteda sheim lo hayta kavvanat hattora bechefel haddavar ella lomar divre razal haya lo lichtov "veim lo taggia yado de se vechisba vehevi" vegomer kemo sheamar bekarban tumat mikdash vehashshevuot (Vayikra 5:7), ella nitkavven gam ken lema shepperashnu:

Uma sheddarshu od betorat kohanim befarasha zo (Vayikra Rabba 14:30-lo) bishlosha mikraot hameyuttarim behassagat yad, vehem asher tassig yado, measher tassig yado, et asher tassig yado, uderashum al ze hadderech: "asher tassig" ba lehaya ashir kodem uveet havaat hakkarban heeni sheyyavi gam ken karban ani, umeasher tassig yado ba lemi shehaya ashir vehitchil gam ken lehavi ashamo vehu adayin ashir veheeni sheyyavi gam ken karban ani. vet asher tassig yado ba lehitchil lehavi karbano shehu haasham bizman shehaya ani veheeshir shetztzarich lehavi beosher, aval im hevi chattat beoni lo yavi ola beosher im heeshir, velamdu sham davar ze mimma sheamar hakkatuv echad lechattat veechad leola shetztzarich sheyyihyu shenehem min echad. mikkol ellu hadderashot en lilmod ma sheddarashnu mikkefel amro "dal veen yado" vegomer, sheafillu achar kol derashot sheddarshu adayin tzerichin anu lishte hadderashot sheddarashnu, sheachar shehifrish karban ashir yavi karban ani, veachar shehifrish karban ani yavi karban ashir, ki lo bau shene devarim ellu badderashot hannizkarot.

rashi: Nezem zahav vachali chatem. adi kevutzat zahav, kemo "vattaad nizmah vechelyatah" (Hoshea 2:15), kemo "chalaim" (Shir HaShirim 7:2):
Ketem. leshon tachshit zahav, vechen "ketem paz" (Shir HaShirim 5:11):
targum: Kadashe dedahava umane dizmargeda machsenuta dechakkima al udena deshama:

rashi: Lifne Adonai. beshaar nikkanor, velo vaazara atzmah, lefi shehu mechussar kippurim (kelim 81):
ohc: Veheemid hakkohen. yitbaer al derech ma sheamru bitchillat massechet kelim (81 48) shemmechussar kippurim asur likkanes leezrat yisrael, ad kan. vehinne kan tzivva Adonai shehammittaher yaamod befetach haazara shehu shaar nikanor, keamram beferek kamma desota (7.) dichtiv "lifne Adonai", veamar hakkatuv sheal hakkohen shemirato lehaamido shello yifrotz, letzad shehu befetach haazara umachnis yado lifnim lismoch al karbano, keamram betorat kohanim, umachnis rosho litten al tenuch vegomer, yesh lachush shemma yimmashech veyikkanes lifnim, laze hittil hakkatuv haddavar al hakkohen lehaamido.

Hakkohen hametaher. hutzrach lomar hakkohen hametaher velo hispik beechad mehem, im haya omer hakkohen velo haya omer hametaher lo hayiti yodea shehammitzva bakkohen hametaher shettiharo min hatztzaraat, laze amar hametaher ki mitzvato bakkohen hametaher min hatztzaraat. veim haya omer hametaher velo amar hakkohen, letzad sheyyesh betaharat hammetzora devarim hannaasim al yede yisrael, tavo hassevara lomar sheggam hazzar yikkare hametaher shehare ose gam ken taharotav, talmud lomar "hakkohen".

Haish hammittaher vegomer. hutzrach lomar haish hammittaher velo hispik lomar haish levad, letzad shello tite lomar shebba lemaet hakkatan sheeno bichlal dinim ellu, hagam sheyyeshno betumat tzaraat. laze amar "hammittaher", velo hispik lomar "hammittaher" velo yomar "haish", mishshum letzad sheyyesh bemishpat ze gam hakketannim kannizkar, tavo hassevara lomar shello tzivva Adonai lakkohen lehaamid hammetzora lifne Adonai shehu chutz leezrat yisrael, ella mi shehu katan shemmin hassetam eno yodea sheen likkanes leezrat yisrael kodem hakeravat taharato, aval gadol nomar en chova al hakkohen lehaamido letzad sheyyodea hu. talmud lomar "veheemid haish", hagam shehu ish, al hakkohen hammitzva lehaamido chutz laazara.

Uvetorat kohanim darshu taam amro "haish" milla yetera lemaet chattat veola mittenufa, veachar kach amar hakkatuv miut acher dichtiv "oto laasham" lemaet gam et haish sheeno taun tenufa ella asham velog hashshemen levad. veim tomar im haish hu memuat mittenufa meamro "oto laasham vehenif" velo haish, ech yavo lemaet acherim bedavar sheen bo? ze eno kushya, ki yavo hammiut bahem beim eno inyan. velaze timtza sheddikdek hattanna babbarayta (torat kohanim kan) veze leshono: talmud lomar "haish" – lo chattat velo ola, velo amar zichron hattenufa, nitkavven baze lomar shettevat "haish" baa lemaet chattat veola middin echad, vahagam sheen haddavar shennitmaet mimmennu baish, haddavar masur lachachamim leda mahu. uvaze taskil mashmaut barayta zo betorat kohanim shehi kasha hahavana. vedivre baal karban aharon dechukim beenay.

rashi: Ish atzel. sheeno chozer al girsat talmudo:
targum: Al chakle degavra atla avaret veal karmi devar nasha chasar raayana:

rashi: Nesiim veruach vegomer. kaasher yihye tochelet shav keshehashshamayim mitkashsherim beavim veharuach menashshevet veadam metzappe sheyyavo geshem velo va, vehem mitztaarim vechalot enehem, kach ish mitpaer lomar: kach vechach tzedaka etten leyad gabbay, vehu meshakker, vechalot ene aniyyim lemattenato veenah baa:
targum: Leyoma daanane verucha demitra lait midame gavra demishtabbehar bemahuveta deshikra:

rashi: Rar. leshon rir — shezzav besaro et zovo kemo rir, sheyyotze tzalul:

O hechtim. sheyyotze av, vesotem et pi haamma, venistam besaro mittippat zovo, zehu peshuto; umidrasho: mana hakkatuv harishon reiyyot shetayim ukerao tame, shenneemar zav mibbesaro zovo tame hiv, umana hakkatuv hashsheni reiyyot shalosh ukerao tame, shenneemar tumato bezovo rar besaro et zovo o hechtim besaro mizzovo tumato hiv, ha chetzad? shetayim letuma, vehashshelishit mazkikattu lekarban (nidda 43: Megila 8.):
ohc: Tumato bezovo. betorat kohanim amru: "tumato bezovo" – lemaet sheeno metamme beodem ad kan. perush, vezulat miut ze, hagam sheamar kera "zovo tame hiv" vedarshu betorat kohanim shebba lemaet odem hayyotze sheeno metamme, lo darshu chen ella letzad sheachar haemet miet hakkatuv sheeno metamme hazzav baodem. aval im lo haya miut tumat haodem, az haya nichlal gam haodem bichlal amro "zovo tame", ki shenehem nikraim zovo, velo hayinu yecholin lemaet haodem, vehayinu muchrachin lefaresh miut hiv al tumat hazzav sheeno metamme beodem, velo haya lanu makom lemaet dam hayyotze sheeno metamme, vahava ate bekal vachomer merukko kaamur sham. o hayinu mitchakkemim lemaato mimma sheyyutzrach leribbuy "vezot" kemo shekkatavnu lemala.

Tumato hiv. betorat kohanim darshu: uma hazzav sheeno metamme beodem metamme beloven, zava shemmetammea beodem eno din shemmetammea beloven? talmud lomar "tumato hiv". perush, shello haya tzarich lomar "tumato", ella ba lemaet zava – "tumato" velo tumatah. velo mittevat "hiv" memaet hazzava kedivre baal karban aharon, ki keshennavo ledayyek mimmashmaut miut hammitdayyek mittevat "hiv" yihye hammiut battuma velo bannitma, vehaven.

Uma sheyyesh lefaresh bivrayta zo shehitzrich lemaet zava shello titma beloven shello tadun bekal vachomer mizzav, uverosh berayta zo memaet hazzav shello yitma beodem shello yadun bekal vachomer mizzav, vehem shene kal vachomer hassotrim ze et ze, kevar heerachti befarasha zo befasuk "vehizza al hammittaher" (Vayikra 14:7), ulederech shekkatavti sham yityashshevu gam ken divrehem zichronam livracha bemakom ze, ki yesh benidda chumera, sheddamah metamme lach veyavesh (nidda ned:) ma sheen ken zovo shel zav sheeno metamme ella lach, gam metamme mishkav umoshav biriyya achat ma sheen ken hazzav, velaze yesh lehagedil tumat haddam. veyesh chumera bezav sheeno tzarich yamim ella reiyyot, vegam shessofer shiva lishte reiyyot ma sheen ken hazzava, veim ken yesh tzedadim lehagedil tumat halloven, vechash hakkatuv lemi sheyyigdal beenav chumera zo ladun kal vachomer bederech ze, ulemi sheyyigdal beenav chumera zo sheyyadun bederech ze, vehaven.

Vetaam amro tevat "hi", nire shechash hakkatuv sheyyomar haomer: lo miet hakkatuv loven bezava ella lemaet shello yetamme bechumerot haodem, dehaynu letamme mishkav umoshav biriyya achat, shello lomar dun minah veoke beatra, aval letamme betumato shel zav adayin ani omer shekken hiv. talmud lomar miut sheni "hi", perush shehammiut ba al metziut atzmah shel tumat hazzav sheenah ella bo, veshiur haddevarim hem al ze hadderech: tuma zo kammishpat asher bo hiv, dehaynu shemmetammeim bishtayim veshalosh reiyyot, enah ella bezav, kammuvan meamro "tumato" velo shel zava.

rashi: Pen ma taase. pen tavo lide lo teda ma laasot beacharitah:
targum: La tippuk bedina mesarhavait dela tedun beacharaytah kad yachamitz yatach chavrach:

rashi: Ucheli cheres asher yigga bo hazzav. yachol afillu naga bo meachorav vechulei, kidita vetorat kohanim ad "maggao shehu chechullo heve omer ze hesseto":

Bimkom asher yishchat vegomer. al yerech hammizbeach batztzafon, uma talmud lomar? vahalo chevar neemar betorat asham vefarashat tzav et aharon shehaasham taun shechita vatztzafon? lefi sheyyatza ze mikkelal ashamot liddon behaamada, yachol tehe shechitato bimkom haamadato, lechach neemar "veshachat … bimkom asher yishchat vegomer" (sifra):

Ki kachattat. ki kechol hachattaot haasham hazze hu lakkohen — bechol avodot hatteluyot bakkohen hushva asham ze lechattat. shello tomar hoil veyatza damo mikkelal shear ashamot linnaten al tenuch uvehonot, lo yehe taun mattan damim veemurim legabbe mizbeach, lechach neemar ki kachattat haasham hu lakkohen yachol yehe damo nittan lemala kachattat, talmud lomar vechulei betorat kohanim:
Ketzinnat sheleg. kekor yeme sheleg sheadam mitavve lo bime katzir, velo sheleg mammash, shehashsheleg lo tov hu bishat katzir:
targum: Ech keriruta detalga beyoma dechatzda hechna izgada mehemna limshadroy venafsheh demareh mehappech:

rashi: Kevod elohim haseter davar. kegon maase merkava (Yechezkel 1) umaase vereshit (Bereshit 1):

Uchevod melachim chakor davar. kesheatta doresh bichvod melachim o bichvod chachamim sheasu seyagim lattora uvaggezerot sheggazru bahem, yesh lecha lachakor velidrosh velishol taam laddavar. aval keshettidrosh bemaase merkava uvemaase vereshit uvachukkim hakketuvim battora, kegon chukkim udevarim shehassatan mekatreg alehem umeshiv alehem, baachilat chazir vechile kerem veshaatnez, en lecha lachakor rak lehasetir, velomar: gezerat melech hu:
targum: Yekara deelaha man dematshe milta vikara demalche man devatze milta:

rashi: Al mayim chayyim. noten otam techilla bichli, kede sheyyehe dam tzippor nikkar bahem, vechamma hem? reviit (sota 16):

Venatatti nega tzaraat. besora hi lahem shehannegaim baim alehem; lefi shehitminu emoriyyim matmoniyyot shel zahav bekirot battehem kol arbaim shana shehayu yishorael bammidbar, veal yede hannega notetz habbayit umotzan (Vayikra Rabba 17):
ohc: Ki tavou vegomer venatatti vegomer. vechi besora hi zo, velo haya lo lomar ella "ki yihye nega bekirot bet achuzzatchem" vegomer, kederech shehizkir benige bene adam. verabbotenu zichronam livracha hirgishu mizze veamru (Vayikra Rabba 97) ki lefi sheshshamu hakkenaanim sheyyisrael baim leartzam vehitminu kol vechulei ad kan, veze derech derash. veal pi ma sheamru bammidrash (sham) veze leshonam: amar rabbi levi en baal harachamim nogea bannefashot techilla vechulei bitchilla hannegaim baim al beto vechulei ad kan, yitbaer al nachon. vehu letzad shehikdim lomar nige bene adam, vehu hefech haamur bevaal harachamim, laze amar ma shehikdamti nige bene adam hu letzad sheadayin lo batem el haaretz veen battim lingoa bahem, aval ki tavou el haaretz az lo etten hannega baadam techilla ella "venatatti nega bevet eretz" vegomer techilla.

Vetaam shello sidder hakkatuv nega habbayit kodem, letzad shennige adam yeshnam techef umiyyad mehaddibbur veelach nohagim, venige habbayit hu ki yavou, laze hikdim hatztzarich techef umiyyad. veim tomar im ken haya lo lehakedim nige begadim lenige adam sheshshenehem yeshnam miyyad, velahem rauy lehakedim keseder middat baal harachamim. venire ki bachar Adonai lesadder nige begadim ben nige adam venige battim, letzad sheyyesh bahem devarim shehem shavim bahem lenige adam veyesh devarim sheshshavim lenige battim, ki beshiur hatztzaraat shavim ledin nige adam bigris, velo ketzaraat habbattim shehu bishne gerisin. uvaggevanim shavim lenige battim, yerakrak o adamdam, velo begaven lavan kenega adam.

Od nire behair lamma sidder hakkatuv dine nige habbeged kodem shehishlim kol dine nige bene adam, tumato vetaharato, shehaya lo lehametin ad sheyyigmor kol mishpat tzaraat adam veachar kach yesadder mishpat habbegadim. veen lomar shennitkavven hakkatuv lesadder dine hattuma bifne atzman vedine taharatam bifne atzmam, sheim ken lamma lo shafat ken gam betzaraat habbayit shehaya lo gam ken lehakedim tumat nega habbayit kodem mishpat taharat nige adam uvegadav. ella vadday shehera hakkatuv baze shehikdim nega habbeged kodem lenega adam vekodem amro "zot tihye torat hammetzora" shebbo ramaz siman avon hatztzaraat ki piv ana vo kemo shepperashnu bitchillat happarasha, katav nige vegadim, vechavvanato hu lomar shehabbegadim lokim techilla. uma shehitchil bedin havaat hannega baadam velo hitchil babbegadim, baze nitchakkem hakkatuv lechazzek haddevarim shennige habbegadim gam ken baim bechet haadam kemo nige adam, velaze hitchil benige adam vesamuch lahem amar nige begadim veamar achar shenehem "zot tihye torat hammetzora" – torato shel motzi shem ra. hareta ladaat ki gam al nige begadim chozrim haddevarim, ma shello haya muvan ken im haya mesadder nige vegadim, vehaven.

Od nire shechash hakkatuv lehakedim nega habbeged veachar kach nige adam, sheaz hayiti omer ki nega habbeged ba al avon kal venega adam ba al avon chamur, velo al avon atzmo sheyyitchayyev lavo nega al haadam ba al habbegadim letzad harachamim, velaze hikdim hakkatuv veamar nige adam lomar ki gam tzaraat hatztzericha lavo laadam baal harachamim meviah babbegadim ulay yashuv verafa lo mibbo alav. vaadayin ani omer dilma al avon chamur baim nige adam veal avon kal baim nige begadim, vehattora siddera hechamur techilla shehem nige adam veachar kach hakkal shehem nige begadim, im ken haya lo lesadder mishpat habbegadim achar mishpat adam vetaharatam uchemo shekkatavti lemala, vehaven.

rashi: Hiktzot. leshon heasot, vechen hittoach, aval chilletz et haavanim musav hallashon el haadam shechilletzan, vehu mishkal leshon kaved, kemo kipper, dibber:
Veim yashuv hannega vegomer. yachol chazar bo vayyom yehe tame, tal "veshav hakkohen" "veim yashuv", ma shiva haamur lehallan lesof shavua, af shiva haamura kan besof shavua (sifra):

Et hatztzippor hachayya yikkach otah. melammed sheeno ogdah immahem, ella mafrishah leatzmah, aval haetz vehaezov keruchin yachad bilshon hazzehorit, kainyan shenneemar veet etz haerez veet sheni hattolaat veet haezov — kicha achat lishlashtan; yachol keshem sheenah bichlal agudda, kach lo tehe vichlal tevila, tal vetaval otam veet hatztzippor hachayya — hechezir et hatztzippor lichlal tevila (sifra):
Shekaarurot. shokot bemarehen (sham):
ohc: Veraa vegomer bekirot habbayit vegomer. parasha zo ramza mifalot Adonai behanehagato im harshaim asher yivcharu bematamme yetzer hara, shehu yikkare nige bene adam. veamru bazzohar (chelek 1 187.) ki hakkadosh baruch hu noten hannefesh beguf haadam, matzlachat, ma tov, veim lav hu okro mishsham vechozer veshotlah bemakom acher. vehu ma sheramaz kan benige habbayit, ki habbayit yirmoz el guf haadam shehu bet hannefesh, vehakkohen haramuz kan hu habbore, shemmatzinu lerazal besefer hazzohar sheddarshu ken befasuk "vehuva el hakkohen" vegomer. veamar ki kesheyyire hakkadosh baruch hu ki hannega bekirot habbayit, perush, nishtakka bechinat hara betochiyyot mahut hagguf, venitav habbayit, vehu ma sheramaz beamro "shekaarurot", teva zo murkevet mishshetayim "sheka rurot", veot ha nivlaat bammivta, ucheillu amar "sheka arurot", shennishka bo bechinat hayyetzer hara shennikra arur. ulefi sheyyesh harebe bechinot berisho amar "arurot". veamro "yerakrakkot" remez lesiman haavera, al derech amram zichrono livracha (shabbat log.) siman laavera hidrokan. gam amar "adamdammot" romez lishfichut damim hammeyuchas livchinat hara rachamana litztzelan. yetzav Adonai lisgor habbayit, perush shello yushpa mishshefa haelohi, vehu sod nidduy harshaim leval yechesu betzilla dimhemnuta. im haadam hirgish baddavar veshav, ma tov, veim lo, yetzav Adonai lehavi alav yissurin lirchotz ketamav unegaav, vehu sod chillutz avanim vechulei. veim adayin masriach maasav hare hu met, vehu amro "venatatz et habbayit et avanav" vegomer.

rashi: En cheker. lerum shamayim uleomek haaretz ulelev melachim en cheker, shekkamma dinim baim lifnehem vechamma milchamot, utzerichim latet lev lechullam. veim kol halleshonot medabberim vechol hayyadayim kotvin, enan yecholin lichtov chalalah shel reshut:
targum: Shemaya ramin veara amika velibba demalche la mitbetze:

rashi: Kimmesonim. chochim:
Kassu. nichsu:
Charullim. gedolim mikkimmesonim, vahare hem chaddim kekotzim:

Vegeder avanav neherasa. kach mi sheeno chozer al talmudo, mittechilla meshakkeach rashe ferakim, vesof mechallef divre chachamim mizze laze (avot derabbi natan kad,6), sheomer al tahor tame veal tame tahor, vehu machariv et haolam:
targum: Veha selek kuleh yaare vechasiu appoy churele vesayga dechefoy itakar:

rashi: Tenuch. gader emtzai shebbaozen, uleshon tenuch lo noda li, vehappotrim korim lo tanedarevam:
Bohen. gudal:
Ki tihye zava. yachol meechad mikkol evareha, tal vehi gilleta et mekor dameha — en dam metamme ella habba min hammakor:
Dam yihye zava bivsarah. en zovah karuy zov letamme ella im ken hu adom (sham 19):
Veniddatah. kemo umittevel yenidduhu (Iyov 18) — shehi menudda mimmagga kol adam:
Tihye veniddatah. afillu lo raata ella reiyya rishona (sifra):
Vechi yarok hazzav battahor. venaga bo o nesao, sheharok metamme vemassa (80 nidda 55):

ohc: Vehizza al hammittaher min hatztzaraat vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar min hatztzaraat achar shebbo medabber hakkatuv. veulay ki letzad shehazzaa zo enah metaheret oto behechlet, ella keyom sheppaska zava middam zovah, vaadayin tzarich hu lisfirat shiva yamim kedin tumat zav, vetimtza shekkol yeme safro adayin hu av hattuma, laze amar hammittaher min hatztzaraat perush, migguf hatztzaraat velo min tumat hatztzaraat, velaze amar levassof "vehaya vayyom hashshevii vegomer vechibbes et begadav", ha lamadta shebbime safro haya metamme begadim, vehinne hu av hattuma, velaze hodiacha ki eno nithar ella miggufo shel tzaraat veachar shennithar mehatztzaraat tzarich leshev betumato shiva yamim.

Uvetorat kohanim darshu: lamma hutzrach lomar "min hatztzaraat" kevan shebbo medabber hakkatuv? veamru ki hutzrach lomar "min hatztzaraat" lemaet teme met shello yiton sheva peamim, mishshum shehayiti dan kal vachomer mimmetzora sheeno taun shelosha veshiva veaf al pi chen taun sheva peamim, teme met shettaun shelosha veshiva eno din sheyyihye taun sheva peamim, talmud lomar "min hatztzaraat" velo mittumeat met. vedarshu od besof otah barayta "vetiharo" – ma shehutzrach lomar "vetiharo" ki ba lemaet hammetzora mitteinat shelosha veshiva, shezzulat ze hayiti dan kal vachomer mitteme met sheeno taun shiva veaf al ken taun shelosha veshiva, metzora shettaun shiva eno din sheyyihye taun shelosha veshiva, talmud lomar "vetiharo" perush, baze yaspik letaharo, ad kan.

Vekashya li: achar sheamar hakkatuv "min hatztzaraat" vedarashnu lemaet min tumat met, hinne lo yutzdak lemaet ella letzad shehaya ba min haddin, vedin ze eno ella keshennomar shehammetzora en bo shelosha veshiva shebbaze yavo kal vachomer uma metzora vechulei kaamur bedivre habbarayta. im ken, meamro "min hatztzaraat" hechzik hakkatuv daat zo vechatam aleha ki hammetzora en bo shelosha veshiva, umeatta lamma hutzrach lomar "vetiharo" lemaato mishshelosha veshiva? hare kevar nitchayyeva mehakkatuv lomar sheen bo shelosha veshiva meamro "min hatztzaraat". o haya lo lomar "vetiharo" sheen tzarich hammetzora shelosha veshiva velo haya tzarich lomar "min hatztzaraat", vaani yodea ki teme met en tzarich sheva peamim mimma shehutzrach lomar "vetiharo" listor hakkal vachomer habba mitteme met lehazzaat shelosha veshiva, veen kal vachomer ba ella im tomar sheen ba bammelammed ella echad, vehaven.

Venire lefaresh, ki leheyot sherainu she tzivva betumat met hazzaat shelosha veshiva (Bamidbar 19:18-19) velo hizkir kamma hazzaot, vehizkir betumat tzaraat sheva peamim velo hizkir shelosha veshiva, yesh sevara lomar ki taharat ribbuy hahazzaot hi tahara gedola yoter mehazzaat shelosha veshiva, letzad heyotam sheva peamim, ma sheen ken hazzaot shelosha veshiva sheenam ella shete peamim. uchefi ze hitzrich hakkatuv tikkun letaharat metzora yoter mittikkun taharat tumat met. veyesh sevara lomar taharat mispar hayyamim hi yoter gedola shello yom echad bilvad yaspik letaher, veim ken ma shemmatzinu she hitzrich bitme met shelosha veshiva hi haderaga gedola mehazzaat sheva peamim. ushete sevarot ellu yitchalleku bedeot chachamim, veyihye chacham sheyyachshov, gadol hanneemar betaharat hammetzora yoter mehanneemar betaharat teme met, veyihye chacham sheyyachshov lehefech. vehinne lehachoshev ki taharat shelosha veshiva yoter, yavo ladun kal vachomer mehammetzora lehatzerich bitme met sheva peamim. ulehachoshev ki taharat sheva peamim chamura, yilmad lammetzora shelosha veshiva mitteme met mikkal vachomer. umeatta yitchayyev hakkatuv lomar shene hammiutim lehasir taut kol sevara usevara. veim lo haya omer ella echad, kegon sheyyomar "min hatztzaraat" lemaet teme met sheeno tzarich sheva peamim, tavo sevarat hassover lomar ki baze hesir hakkatuv taut shekkenegdo vehitzdik lomar ki hazzaat sheva peamim hi yoter gedola veyeshnah bammetzora velo bitme met, vechozer ani vedan lehavi lo shelosha veshiva mitteme met, vechen im haya omer "vetiharo" vegomer.

Uchede shello yarchik datecha derech ze lomar ech yavo hakkatuv lemaet sevara sheenah amittit, halo timtza sheamru (berachot 47:1) bechamma mekomot "alecha amar kera", perush hagam sheen dato kach, hare shehattanna yevaer hakkatuv shebba lisvara sheen dato maskemet lah sheyyachush hakkatuv lassover ken, vehaven:

Veraiti leharav hammufla 215 rozanish 233 bassefer hannichbad mishne lammelech (hilchot chametz umitztza 86 hei) shehevi barayta achat doma lema shellefanenu, detanya betorat kohanim perek 11 veze leshonam: "hazze chag hammatztzot" – yom ze taun matztza veen chag hassukkot taun matztza, shehaya bedin, uma im ze sheeno taun sukka taun matztza, ze shettaun sukka eno din sheyyiton matztza, talmud lomar "hazze chag hammatztzot" taun matztza vechulei, vesham beferek 14 tanya veze leshonam: "hazze chag hassukkot" – ze taun sukka veen chag hammatztzot taun sukka, shehaya bedin, uma ze sheeno taun matztza taun sukka, chag hammatztzot shehu taun matztza eno din sheyyiton sukka, talmud lomar "hazze" – ze taun sukka veen vechulei. vehiksha harav hakkushyot atzmam shekkatavnu bevaraytot taharat metzora, dirshu meal sefer harav ma shetteretz baze. udevarav zichrono livracha ketzat dechukim, uvifrat lechat happoskim (282 veod) shessovrim desafek deorayta shemmuttar min hattora, lo yaamdu divre harav alav hashshalom lammeayyen bidvarav.

Uledati yitbaaru habbaraytot badderech atzmo shebbearnu lemala, vehu ki letzad sheyyesh pirsum nes yetziat mitzrayim bassukka bivchina achat yoter mippirsum nes sheyyesh baachilat matztza, ki harebe peamim adam ochel pitto matztza, ma sheen ken maase sukka sheyyesh pirsum gadol. uvefesach gam ken bechina acheret yesh bo shehu yoter pirsum hannes beitto uvizmanno, shehu betv benisan, veyavo chacham shettihye lo hassevara lehagedil pirsum nes sukka shehu gadol mippirsum achilat matztza, veyadun kal vachomer lesukka shetteuna matztza, veyomar: "uma chag hammatztzot shello hitzrich bo Adonai kol kach pirsum, al kol panim chiyyevo bematztza letzad shehu davar hatztzarich al kol panim, sukka sherainu shehu pirsum gadol eno din shetztzarich matztza?" talmud lomar "hazze chag hammatztzot". vetavo sevara acheret shettadun behefech, veyomar ki dideh natzach, vedacha sevara shekkenegdo mimma shemmiet sukka sheen bah matztza veikkar happirsum hu hammatztza, veyadun lechayyev sukka befesach bekal vachomer missukka shello hitzrich bah Adonai matztza veaf al pi chen hitzrich sukka, talmud lomar "[hazze] chag hassukkot". veteda shehattanna doresh hammiutin lishte hassevarot, behair bekal vachomer rishon sheasa hattanna, ech hotzi mippiv kal vachomer vaadayin eno yodea im eno taun ella echad o shenayim, uvema shepperashti yavo al nachon. uma shekkatav harav haggadol baal mishne lammelech shello hayinu yodim beeze makom neemar hakkal vachomer umissefeka hayinu omrim shechag hammatztzot taun sukka vechag hassukkot taun matztza, ad kan, en devarav zichrono livracha muchrachim, ki kevan sheen atta yachol ladun kal vachomer letzad sheencha yachol lomar "uma ze sheeno taun ella ze" ki mi amar lecha sheeno taun ella ze, vedilma tadun hakkal vachomer lehefech veyihye taun 2, vechen latztzad haacher en ani yachol laasot hakkal vachomer mehattaam atzmo, umeatta yaamod kol echad beshello velo tadun kal vachomer, im lo shettomar sheyyesh pan lomar kal vachomer mitztzad echad veyesh pan lomar hakkal vachomer mitztzad acher vechash hakkatuv lishne hatztzedadin, vehu hadderech shepperashti.

rashi: Lifne Adonai. keneged bet kadshe hakkodashim (sifra):
Tappuche zahav. keen kaftorin metzuyyarin al maskiyyot kasef. maskiyyot kelim hametzuppin bechesef, kemo "vesakkoti chappi" (Shemot 33:22):

Davar davur al afnav. al kanno, vedugemato "nasati emecha afuna" (tehillim 88:16) – mevusseset umeyushshevet bekirbi. veen ze miggizrat 'ofan vegalgal (Yeshayahu 28:27-28), sheillu ken, haya nakud pattach tachat happe kemo "haofannim" (Melachim 1 7:32), velo yippol bo nekuddat chataf kamatz:
targum: Chizure dedahava bingode desama milta demalel pesiyait:

rashi: Utehi niddatah alav. yachol yaale leraglah — sheim ba aleha vachamishi leniddatah lo yitma ella shelosha yamim kemotah — tal vetame shivat yamim, uma tal utehi niddatah alav? ma hi metammea adam uchele cheres, af hu metamme adam uchele cheres (sifra; nidda 33):

Rivcha riv et reecha. veim al karchacha atta tzarich lariv ulehochiach im reecha, mikkol makom, sod acher al tegal. lo tazkir lo dofi avotav shemmetu, sheen hakkol yodin oto veatta megallehu (sanhedrin 44:):
targum: Dinach dun im chavrach (beachrayta) veraza ocharana la tegale:

rashi: Beterem yavo hakkohen vegomer. shekkol zeman sheen kohen nizkak lo, en sham torat tuma:

Velo yitma kol asher babbayit. sheim lo yefannehu, veyavo hakkohen veyire hannega nizkak lehesger vechol ma shebbetocho yitma; veal ma chasa tora? im al kele shetef, yatbilem veyitharu, veim al ochalin umashkin, yochlem bime tumato, ha lo chasa tora ella al kele cheres, sheen lahem tohora bammikve (sifra):
ohc: Beterem yavo hakkohen. taam shehutzrach lomar hakkohen, mishshum shezzulatah haya nishma ki beterem yavo yetzavve, uchefi ze en chiyyuv lakkohen lehitakkev ad sheyyeda sheppinnu vadday et kol asher babbayit, umeamro "hakkohen", hera ki tevat "beterem" en lah kesher im zichron hakkohen sheetzel "vetzivva" ukeshura hi im "ufinnu", vehaven:

Kol asher babbayit. perush, kol asher babbayit lo yitma ella yatztzilu hakkol vaafillu pakkim ketannim, ki chas Adonai afillu al mamon habbazuy shel yisrael. uvaze natan taam hakkatuv lamma tzivva Adonai lefannot kodem, halo afillu achar biat hakkohen veroe hannega en habbayit tame ella achar sheyyetze hakkohen veyasgirennu, umeatta en tzorech lehakedim lefannot kodem bo hakkohen vicholin lefannot achar shebba hakkohen kodem sheyyasgir. laze amar velo yitma kol asher vegomer, perush ki letzad shekkesheyyire hakkohen hannega shetztzarich lehasegir en reshut lehitakkev millehasgir kol ikkar, umitztzad ze yemaharu lefannot uletzad hammehirut yishkechu mamon habbazuy, laze hikpid Adonai lefannot kodem, shebbaze lo yitma mikkol asher babbayit.

Verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (negaim 12:5, uvetorat kohanim) shello chas hakkadosh baruch hu ella al kele cheres, ki shear kelim uvegadim yesh lahem takkana bammikve. uledarkenu hosafnu lefaresh shechas hakkadosh baruch hu afillu al kele cheres hakketannim sheen adam machshiv otam.

rashi: Veim bo yavo. lesof shavua sheni:

Veraa vehinne lo fasa. mikra ze ba lelammed baomed beenav barishon uvashsheni uma yaase lo, yachol yetaharennu, kemashmao shel mikra "vetihar hakkohen et habbayit", tal ki nirpa hannaga — lo tiharti ella et harafuy; veen rafuy ella habbayit shehuktza vehutach velo chazar hannega — aval ze taun chalitza vekitztzuy veticha veshavua shelishi; vechen hammikra nidrash: veim bo yavo vashsheni, veraa vehinne lo fasa, yetichennu — veen ticha belo chillutz vekitztzuy — veachare hittoach et habbayit vetihar hakkohen et habbayit, im lo chazar lesof hashshavua, ki nirpa hannaga, veim chazar, kevar peresh al hachozer shettaun netitza:
Yaktzia. 430 belaaz, uvilshon mishna yesh harebe:
Mibbayit. mibbifnim:
Saviv. sevivot hannega; betokko nidrash ken — sheyyiklof hattiach shesseviv avne hannega:
Hiktzu. leshon katze — asher kitztzeu viktzot hannega saviv:
Pen yechassedcha shomea. "cherpat mitzrayim" (Yehoshua 5:9) metargeminan: "chasuda demitzrae", pen yechassedcha, hashshomea veyikraacha motzi dibba:
targum: Dela nechsedach man deshamea vetivach la hafich:
Vekamu vekivla lemeal lemashiryat aram vaato ad seyafe mashiryat aram veha let taman enash:

rashi: Ki reevim anachnu. uteevim latzet el hashalal veel hammazon.
targum: Vekam malka belelya vaamar leavdohi achave chean lechon yat daavadu lana enash aram yadin are chefanin anachna unefaku min mashrita leitamara vechakla lememar im yafkun min karta venichudunun kad chayin ulekarta neol:
Vedabbaru teren richve susin ushelach malka batar mashiryat aram lememar ezilu vachazo:
Deyemar lerashia tzadik ant yelituneh amme veyivruneh umata:

rashi: Vearbaa anashim. gechazi uvanav.
Petach hashaar. kemo shenneemar: badad yeshev michutz lammachane moshavo.
targum: Vearbaa gavrin havo segirin yatvin bemaalana detara vaamaru gevar lechavreh ma anachna yatvin ka ad dinmut:
Vekamat itteta vaavadat kefitgama dinviya dayya vaazalat hi veenash betah veittotavat beara felishtae sheva shenin:

rashi: Kaasher hemma. kemo shehayu meleim mittechillatam, lo hotziu ma shebbetocham.
targum: Vaato ukero lenatre tera karta vechaviu lehon lememar atina lemashiryat aram veha let taman gevar vekal enash elahen susevan asirin vachamarin asirin umashkenin kema deinun:

rashi: Bechofzam. bemaharam lanus.
targum: Vaazalu vatrehon ad yardena veha chol orcha malya levushin umanin dirmo enash aram beitbautehon lemerak vetavu izgadaya vechaviu lemalka:
Umalka malel im gechazi talmida dinviya dayya lememar ishtae chean li yat kol ravrevata daavad elisha:
Vaamar malka lachazael sav bidach tikruveta vaazel lokodamut neviya dayya vetitba yat pitgama dayya mineh lememar haeche mimare den:
La temar hech daavad li ken ebad leh veahafech leh hech ovadoy:
Kalel tenum kalel tidmuch kalel tesim yedayich al chadyach vetidmuch:
Ukera natre tara vechaviu bet malka legav:
Ulemachsane yivsam vaalehon teta birketa tavta:

rashi: Asher nishan al yado. etmol keshebba levet elisha.
targum: Umalka mane yat gibbara dismich al yedohi al tara vedashuhi ama betara umit kema demalel neviya dayya demalel kad nechat malka levateh:
Vekamu vaaraku vekivla ushevaku yat mashkenehon veyat susevathon veyat chamarehon bemashrita kema dehi vaaraku leshezava nafshehon:
Vahava kad malel neviya dayya im malka lememar satan seorin besila usea suleta besila yihe keidana haden mechar vetara deshomron:
Vahava leh ken vedashu yateh ama betara umit:

rashi: El betah veel sada. shehecheziku vah gazlanim.
targum: Vahava misof sheva shenin vetavat itteta meara felishtae unefakat lemikbal kodam malka al betah veal chaklah:

Vaato segiraya hailen ad seyafe mashrita vaalu lemashkena chad vaachalu ushetiu unesivu mittaman kaspa vedahava ulevushin vaazalu veatmaru vetavu vaalu lemashkena ocharana unesivu mittaman vaazalu veatmaru:
Vaatev gibbara yat neviya dayya vaamar veilu Adonai patach kavin umachit tuva min shemaya hayehe kefitgama haden vaamar ha at chaze beenach umittaman la techul:
Im nemar neol lekarta vechafna vekarta unemut taman veim nitev hacha unemut uchean eto venishtema lemashiryat aram im yechayunana venechi im yiktelunana venitkatel:

rashi: Hishmia et machane aram. nidma lahem keillu shomein.
targum: Umin kodam Adonai ishtema lemashiryat aram kal retichin kal susevan kal mashiryan sagiin vaamaru gevar lechavreh ha agar alana malka deyisrael yat malche chittae veyat malche mitzrae lemete alana:

rashi: Veelisha dibber el haisha. ze sheva shanim.
Ki kara Adonai laraav. hu haraav asher haya bime yoel ben petuel.
targum: Veelisha malel im itteta deachye yat berah lememar kumi veezilu at veenash betech vedayri baatar dechashar lemedar are zamin Adonai kafna veaf atid lemete al ara sheva shenin:
Vachazet ana veshamet libbi vachamet vekabbelet marduta:
Vahava hu mishtae lemalka yat deachye yat mita veha itteta deachye yat berah kavla kodam malka al betah veal chaklah vaamar gechazi ribboni malka da itteta veden berah deachye elisha:
Nitterid rashia min kodam malka veyittakan betzidketa kureseh:

rashi: Asher nisharu vah. betoch hair, shello metu baraav.

Hinnam kechol hamon yisrael asher nisharu vah. im yomru mesukkanin hem shello yahargem aram, hare hinnam bair hazzot besakkanat haraav kishar kol hamon yisrael asher nisharu vah, veim yamutu hinnam kechol hamon yisrael, asher tammu baraav.
targum: Vaatev chad meavdohi vaamar veyidberun kean chamsha min susevata min shaara deishtaaru vah ha inun kechol hamona deyisrael deishtaaru vah im yevdun ha inun kechol hamona deyisrael desafu venishlach venechze:

rashi: Umetzaanu avon. mitchayyevin anu lammalchut.
targum: Vaamaru gevar lechavreh la chashar ma daanachna avdin yoma haden yom besora hu veilu anachna shatkin umorvin ad nehor tzafra viarinana chova uchean itu venitmete unechave bet malka:
Unefak ama uvezo yat mashiryat aram vahava sea suleta besila vesatan seorin besila kefitgama dayay:
Usheel malka leitteta veishteiat leh umane lah malka gevaza chad lememar atev yat kol dilah veyat kol allat chakla mioma deshavkat yat ara vead kean:

rashi: Vayyavo elisha dammesek. lehachazir et gechazi bitshuva.
targum: Vaata elisha damesek uvar hadad malka daaram mera veitchava leh lememar ata neviya dayya ad halecha:

bart: Hayta gevoha min haaretz tefach. deachshav yesh tachteha ohel tefach:

Hakkol tame. dimvia tuma labbayit kevan digvoha tefach, vechelim sheal gabbah afillu shello keneged hattuma nammi temein vaafillu bachutz, detachteha keman demalya tuma. veen matztzelet al gabbah, deen keli matztzil. vechen im tuma babbayit nammi hakkol tame mehay taama, deohel habbayit mevi tuma letachteha veen matztzelet al gabbah. veim tuma al gabbah, kevan deen matztzelet al ma shettachteha, roim tachteha keman demalya tuma, hilkach ma shebbabbayit uma shettachteha uma sheal gabbah hakkol tame:
Ella tochah. kelomar hakkol tame chutz mimma shebbetochah shettahor:
Hotziuhu shenayim peturim. kidyalfinan (Vayikra 4) baasotah achat mikkol mitzvot Adonai, haose et kullah velo haose miktzatah:
Verabbi shimon poter. desavar afillu kesheen yachid yachol laasotah im asauha shenayim peturim. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Et hachay bammitta. al hachay lo michayyav behotzaato im eno kafut, lefi shehu nose et atzmo. vehane mille adam, aval behema chayya veof lo, dichman dichfutin damu:

Vechen kazzayit min hammet. chayyav im hotzio, dehoil umetamme, hotzaa chashuva hi lehatztzil atzmo min hattuma. vechen kazzayit min hannevela vechaadasha min hashsheretz, dehachi have shiuran letuma:

Verabbi shimon poter. afillu bemet shalem, dahave melacha sheenah tzericha legufah, dechol sheeno ella lesalleko mealav haveya melacha sheenah tzericha legufah velav melechet machashevet hi. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Pilpelet kol shehu. dechazya lereach happe, veen ze pilpel hammatzuy benenu:
Itran kol shehu. shemmerappeim bo mi sheyyesh lo keev chatzi harosh:
Mine vesamim kol shehen. lereach tov:
Mine mattachot kol shehen. sherauy laasot mehen darban katan:
Mekek. rekev hannofel missefarim o mimmitpachot shebbalu, leshon hamek besaro (Zecharya 14):
Shemmatzniim oto leganzo. shekkol davar kadosh taun geniza:
Meuma. alma achsheveh kera leissureh. vetikkun gadol hu ose keshemmotzi avoda zara mibbeto. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Hayta memallea et kol habbayit. shekkullah betoch habbayit lifnim veyoshevet al shuleha ufiha maggia lishme kora, sheen benah lattikra poteach tefach:
Tuma vetochah habbayit tame tuma babbayit ma shebbetochah tahor. midi dahava abbiv shehu kamur tachat habbayit sheyyesh bo poteach tefach veen bitziato poteach tefach ditnan leel beferek 3:
Ben omedet. kelomar, din ze noheg ben omedet umaggaat lakkorot ben mutta al tziddah veen ben piha ledofen habbayit poteach tefach:
Ben achat ben shetayim. zo al zo veen ben pi hashsheniyya lakkorot poteach tefach, vechen en ben shule hashsheniyya lefiha shel rishona poteach tefach:

En mechayyevin oto. deha lo ahane leh mide, sheadayin karka shello petucha. aval im gadar et harviit, dehashta vadday ahane leh, mechayyevin oto leshallem machatzit deme kanim bezol. aval lo chatzi yetziotav, deamar leh ledidi saggi li bimchitztza shel kanim vei efshi bitzia shel geder avanim:

Megalgelin alav et hakkol. machatzit yetziotav kefi ma sheggadar. vehayenu deikka ben tanna kamma lerabbi yose. vahalacha kerabbi yose. veen tzarich lomar im hannikkaf hu sheggadar ruach reviit, degalle dateh denicha leh bema sheggadar chavero, shemmegalgelin alav et hakkol umeshallem lachavero chatzi yetziotav:

Beyayin hittiru. sheheashan hayyotze min hachanut shel nachtomin veshel tzabbain eno kashe layyayin, shehachom mashbiach layyayin shebbeeretz yisrael. uvemakom sheyyadua shehachom mazzik layyayin, af tachat otzar shel yayin lo yiftach chanut shel tzabbaim veshel nachtomin:
Chanut shebbechatzer. echad mibbene chatzer shebba liftoach chanut bechatzer, bene hechatzer meakkevin alav:

Velo mikkol hattinokot. shel bet rabban. veaf al gav dekol habba mechamat acherim hu, lo matze machi, mishshum yagdil tora veyadir. veim eno melammed hattinokot tora, ella ummanut o cheshbon o tishboret, matze machi velomar lo eni yachol lishan mippene hattinokot shennichnasim veyotzim:
Hammishra. makom sheshshorim bo pishtan. umafsid et hayerakot hassemuchot lo:
Veet hakkereshin. karti bilshon talmud. vehem mazzikin labbetzalim hassemuchim lahem:
Veet hachardal min haddevorim. shehu mafsid haddevash veose oto charif vachad:
Rabbi yose mattir bachardal. sheyyachol lomar lo ad sheatta omer li harechek chardalcha min devoray, harechek devorecha mechardali, mippene shebbaot veochlot pirche chardali. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Bizman shehi cheli. hecha deomedet baavir en shayyach lehazekir mechulchelet, umishshum hachi lo tana hacha o afutza kidtane leel, deen shayyach afutza ella bimchulchelet:
O machazeket arbaim sea kedivre chachamim. diflige attanna kamma vesavre demachzeket arbaim sea, kenifchata venitbattela mittorat keli damya, umatztzelet attachteha veattochah veal gabbah:
Kazzayit min hammet natun tachteha. dinah kenifchata veenah gevoha ufiha lachutz ditnan leel:
Hayta gevoha min haaretz tefach. hach nammi dinah kedin kavveret sheppiha lachutz ufechuta ufekuka ugevoha tefach ditnan leel:
Tarvad. kaf:
Chaf. shen mishshinne hammafteach sheppotchim bah haddelatot. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Karkar. shel orgin, umaaviro al hashsheti keshehu matuach lefanav veshovet bo hachutin:
Kede lizrok bivhema. delo tarach eynash lemishkal tzeror mishshum of lehavericho, divkala bealma saggi leh:
Hammatznia. kodem hashshabbat:
Lezera uledugma. lehareot sheyyesh lo sammanim veyiknu mimmennu:
Velirfua. veshachach beshabbat lema hitznia, vehotzio setam, chayyav alav bechol shehu, sheal daat harishona hotzio, veha achsheveh:
Ella cheshiuro. kol echad shiur hammeforash bo:
Chazar vehichniso. ze shehitznia pachot mikkeshiur vehotzio, im nimlach bo shello lezaro vechazar vehichniso:
Eno chayyav. behachenasa zo ella im ken yesh bo shiur shalem, dechevan denimlach shello lezaro batla machshavto vahare hu kechol adam:
Betza kalla. betzat tarnegolet shehi kalla levashshel yoter mikkol shear betzim, velo kede levashshel kullah ella kigrogeret mimmenna, terufa unetuna bailpas:
Umitztarfin. kol mine tevalin ze im ze:
Istis. 90 bilshon aravi, vetzivo dome litchelet:
Ufua. sharshe esev shetztzovin bahem adom, uvaaravi 122:
Bassevacha. berosh hassevacha sheasuya kiklia notnim meat beged:
Neter. min adama hu, umazhir, vekorim lo 77 belaaz:
Borit. min tzemach shemmenakke umetaher:
Kimmonya. esev shemmenakkim baafaro et hayyadayim lehaavir et hazzuhama, uvilshon talmud karuy shelof dutz, uvaaravi korin lo 171:
Veashlag. lo itparesh li ma hu:
Al hakkatem. hannimtza babbeged, veen yadua im dam nidda hu im lav, maavirin alav shiva devarim livdok oto bahem. umikkelalam arbaa sammanin hallalu. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Hazzorek arba ammot bakkotel. mittechillat arba lesof arba venach bakkotel hassamuch lirshut harabbim, lemala measara tefachim, kegon shehayta devela shemena venidbeka bakkotel lemala measara baavir reshut harabbim, patur, dechol lemala measara birshut harabbim mekom petor hu:

Lematta measara kezorek baaretz. mittechillat arba lesof arba birshut harabbim, vechayyav af al pi sheen mimmekom akirat hachefetz lakkotel ella arba ammot metzumtzamot, lo amrinan deovi haddevela memaet bearba ammot veen kan mittechillat arba lesof arba, dechevan sheeno mevattel et haddevela bakkotel en avyah memaet kelum:
Venitgalgel chutz learba ammot patur. shehare lo nitkavven lizrika shel chiyyuv:
Venitgalgel letoch arba ammot chayyav. vehu denach mashshehu chutz learba ammot kodem shennitgalgel lifnim:
Achsadra shennisdeka. tikrat haachsadra shennechleka lishnayim:
Kelim shebbatztzad hashsheni tehorim. sheavir hassedek mafsik, vegorem sheen hattuma overet latztzad hashsheni:
Erev et hattuma. lefi shennistam haavir:
Baaretz. beritzpat haachsadra keneged hassedek shebbattikra:

Goren kavua. goren sheyyesh bo keri gadol shezzorim oto berachat, karuy goren kavua. vesheen hakkeri gadol veen bo lizrot hammotz berachat ella haruach menashshevet bakkeri vehammotz niddaf meelav, karuy goren sheeno kavua:
Chamishshim amma. mippene hammotz shemmazzik et bene hair. keshehu zore:
Uminniro. shel chavero. nir, hi charisha shechorshim bimot hakkayitz kede sheyyamutu sharshe hakkotzim vehaasavim:

Kede shello yazzik. ma taam kaamar, ma taam marchik minnetiotav shel chavero uminniro chamishshim amma, kede shello yazzik hammotz lintiotav uleniro, shehu naase zevel umekalkel hannir umeyabbesh hannetiot:
Ketzad. rabbanan kaamre leh:

Shete gezuzteraot. vehen nesarim yotzim mikkotel haaliyya velachutz al reshut harabbim, vehaggezuzetraot atzman hen reshut hayyachid, ucheshehen zo keneged zo bishne tzidde reshut harabbim hammoshit vehazzorek mizzo lezo fatur, shello matzinu zerika vehoshata bimlechet hammishkan mershut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid verochav reshut harabbim mafsik benehen:
Hayu shetehen bidyota achat. kelomar baaliyya achat beorech reshut harabbim, veyesh hefsek reshut harabbim benehen:

Hazzorek patur. hoil ulemala measara hu, velo matzinu zerika mershut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid derech reshut harabbim bammishkan, vehammoshit chayyav, veaf al pi shemmoshit lemala measara, shemmatzinu hoshata kayyotze bah bammishkan mershut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid veorech reshut harabbim mafsik benehen:

Shekken hayta avodat haleviyyim. moshitim mizze laze lemala measara veorech reshut harabbim baemtza, ketzad, [shete] agalot zo achar zo birshut harabbim, uforke hammishkan hayu moshitin leotam sheal haagalot sheetzlan hen semuchot ukerovot, vehen moshitin leellu shellifnehem, vechol achat mehaagalot reshut hayyachid hen:
Aval lo zorkim. sheen hakkerashim nizrakin mippene kavdan:
Chulyat habbor. afar shemmotziin mechafirat habbor regilin litten sevivot pi habbor kemin choma lehekkef, veashmeinan devor vechulyato mitztarfin laasara, vetane bor leamko vetane sela legavho:
Hannotel mehen. umeniach birshut harabbim, o hannotel mershut harabbim venoten al gabban, chayyav:
Hayta fechuta. shennifchata uvatla mittorat keli:
Kedivre chachamim. diflige attanna kamma umashvu machzeket arbaim sea lifchuta ufekuka vekash:
En tuma ola lah. bizman shehattuma tachteha enah ola letochah:
Af lo yoredet mimmenna. bizman shehattuma letochah enah yoredet tachteha:
Tachteha tame. vetochah vegabbah tahor:
Kenegdo ad harakia tame. aval tachteha tahor:
Minnayin lesicha shehi chashshetiyya. lo kishtiyya mammash lechiyyuve ala karet, ella shehi asura:
Kol chazaka sheen immah taana. sheyyiton lamma machazik beshel chavero, enah chazaka:
Vehabba mechamat yerushsha. shehechezik bah shalosh shanim mikkoach yerushshat aviv, shehayta shel aviv beyom moto:
En tzarich taana. levarer ech baa leyad aviv. umihu reaya bae sherau aviv dar bo yom echad:
Haummanim. shemmetakkenim kelim.

En lahem chazaka. im hem muchzakim bechelim shel acherim en yecholim liton lekuchim hem beyadi, vaafillu hem kelim sheen asuyin lehasheil ulehaskir. vehane mille keshehakkeli matzuy befanenu beyad haumman. aval im lo nimtza hakkeli befanenu beyad haumman ella shebba echad min hashshuk vetaan laumman keli yesh li etzlecha shennatatti lecha letakken, hachazirehu li, vetaan haumman emet shehu etzli aval atta macharta li, neeman haumman bishvua, bemiggo dei bae amar lo haya devarim meolam o hechezarti lecha. vechen taan haumman kach pasakta li bischar tikkuno, vehalla omer lo pasakti ella pachot. im hakkeli matzuy befanenu beyad haumman baal hakkeli neeman. veim en hakkeli matzuy befanenu beyad haumman hare haumman neeman bishvua vaafillu masar lo beedim, bemiggo dei bae amar hechezartiv lecha.

Vehashshuttafim. sheyyesh lahen karka beshuttafut veachal echad mehen shalosh shanim kol happerot, enah chazaka. vehane mille, deen bakkarka din chalukka. aval im yesh bakkarka din chalukka vaachalah echad mehen shalosh shanim, have chazaka:

Vehaarisim. sheyyordim lakkarka lemechetza lishlish velirvia, veachal kol happerot shalosh shanim, enah chazaka. vedavka baarise batte avot, shehu kemo appotroppos al habben, aval haaris shehorido baal hakkarka atzmo veachal kol happerot shalosh shanim, yesh lo chazaka:

Veen laish chazaka benichse ishto. vaafillu katav lah beodah arusa din udevarim en li binchasayich velo beferotehen, dehashta eno ochel perot min haddin, veachar kach hevi reaya sheachal perot shalosh shanim, lo haveya chazaka, deorcha deitteta lehaniach levalah sheyyochal perot nechaseha ben kaddin ben shello kaddin:

Veen laishsha chazaka benichse valah. vaafillu yiched lah karka limzonoteha veachla perot mikkarka acheret shel balah shalosh shanim, afillu hachi lo haveya chazaka, shedderech haish lehaniach leishto shettochal binchasav afillu bedavar sheen lah bo zechut:
Velo laav benichse habben velo labben vechulei. lefi shehem keappotroppesim ze al ze:
Bamme devarim amurim. deenah chazaka:
Bemachazik. bachazaka sheyyesh aleha irur, shechavero toen gezula hi beyadcha:

Aval hannoten mattana. befanenu, veamar limkabbel hammattana lech chazek ukene, kol hanach deamrinan leel bematnitin deen lahem chazaka, mishshehecheziku kishar mekabbele mattana, kanu, veen hannoten yachol lachazor bo. vehaishsha shennatna o shemmachra levalah nichse melog shellah, mishshehechezik bahen habbaal kana, veenah yechola lomar nachat ruach asiti levaali. dedavka benichse tzon barzel o bekarka sheyyiched lah balah bichtubbatah amrinan sheen michrah mecher veen mattenatah mattana mippene sheyyechola lomar nachat ruach asiti levaali, mippene sheyyesh levalah shayyachut bahen. aval benichse melug sheen levalah beikkaran shum shayyachut, enah yechola lomar nachat ruach asiti levaali. vechen haish shemmachar leishto minnechasav, im hammaot shekkanta bahen haishsha otan nechasim lo hayu temunim etzlah, hammecher kayyam, veyihyu otan hannechasim laishsha vehabbaal ochel perot. veim hayu otan maot temunim etzlah, hammecher batel, deamar, liggeluye zuze shehayu temunim etzlah amarti sheani mocher lah:
Vehaachin shechalku. vehechezik kol echad mehen bechelko, en yecholim lachazor:
Vehammachazik benichse hagger. shemmet veen lo yorshim, vechol hakkodem lehachazik binchasav zacha:
Naal. sheasa delet:
Vegadar. o sheasa choma:
Ufaratz. o shepparatz bah pirtza:
Ben patztzim lachavero. keshemmesadderin patztzimin veammudin vekorot veosin shurot shel korot al haaretz veyesh chalal ben zo lezo somcho tachtav shello yitakkem:
Zecher laddavar. dechashev cheres bachatiyyat haur:
Lachsof. lidlot:
Miggeve. gumma ketanna shehammayim nikbatzim bah, alma chashev cheres nammi bekabbalat hammayim. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Kotzetz. haanafim ad gova melo mardea, shello yeakkevuhu milleholich machareshato sham:
Mardea. malmad habbakar:
Hecharuv vehashshikma. shetztzillan merubbe vekashe lassade:
Keneged hammishkolet. kotzetz kol ma shennote letoch sadehu. mishkolet, chut shebbone hachoma tolim bah mishkolet shel avar:
Veim bet hashshelachin hi. eretz tzemea lemayim:
Kol hailan keneged hammishkolet. afillu eno charuv veshikma, kotzetz keneged hammishkolet. shehatztzel ra levet hashshelachin:

Abba shaul omer kulei. aresha kae, deamar tanna kamma kotzetz melo mardea vaafillu hi ilan serak, chutz mecharuv veshikma, veamar leh abba shaul kol ilan serak sheeno ose perot kotzetz keneged hammishkolet. veen halacha keabba shaul:
Habbayit tahor. shehammashkof yored vesotem et pi hakkavveret. uvechavveret sheenah mechulchelet ayre. dei vimchulchelet, derech hachilchul hayta tuma yotza labbayit kechol hane dilel:

Tuma vabbayit ma shebbetochah tahor. garsinan. shehattuma yotza lachutz veenah nichneset lakkavveret. uverov sefarim gorsin, ma shebbetochah tame, lefi shehattuma yotza min habbayit derech pitchah umetamme ma shebbakkavveret, vehi omedet betoch happetach:
Et hannevelot veet hakkevarot. mishshum reach ra:
Habburseki. mekom ibbud haorot:
Ella lemizrach hair. sheen ruach mizrachit kasha ella im ken baa lefuranut. aval keshehi baa kedarkah hi chamma umenashshevet benachat, lefichach enah mevia hareach lair:

Chutz mimmaaravah. lechol ruach hu ose umarchik chamishshim amma, chutz meruach maaravit sheeno ose kol ikkar, mippene shemmitpallelim leotah haruach, sheshshechina bammaarav. veen halacha kerabbi akiva:

En cholkin et hechatzer. en echad min hashshuttafin yachol lachof et chavero lachlok hechatzer ad sheyyehe bo arba ammot lechol echad min hashshuttafin chutz min happetachim, shekkol bayit shebbechatzer tzarich sheyyihye lifne pitcho arba ammot lefarek massao meal chamoro, vechutz meotan arba ammot tzarich sheyyihye bechatzer arba ammot acherot lechol echad min hashshuttafin lishar tashmishim, veaz yihye bechatzer din chalukka:
Rabbi yehuda omer tisha chatzae kabbin. mar ki atreh umar ki atreh. velo pelige. beatreh derabbi yehuda hayta osa tevua sade bat tisha chatzae kabbin kesade bat tisha kabbin beatrayhu derabbanan:

Bet rova. makom lizroa bo rova hakkav. ufesak hahalacha, en din chalukka bekarkaot haomdot lacharisha velizria ella im ken yishshaer lechol echad min hashshuttafim karka kede avodat yom echad bacharisha [o bizria] vechayyotze vahen:
Moran uteraklin. mine pelatin hen:

Kede laze uchede laze. kedimfaresh veazil shelleachar sheyyachaloku veyittol kol echad chelko yihye bechelek kol echad mehem makom rauy sheyyikkare teraklin o moran, sheyyishshaer biktzato hashshem shehaya bechullo:
Bizman sheen shenehem rotzin. en yachol haechad lachof et chavero lachlok al karcho. aval yachol lechofo leinyan god o egod, kelomar, kene chelki o mechor li chelkecha bema shehu shave:
Vechitve hakkodesh. tora neviim uchetuvim:
Lo yachaloku. vedavka keshehem becherech echad. aval bichrachim harebe kol sefer bifne atzmo, im ratzu cholkim:
En tame ella hattachton. dechevan detuma babbayit shello cheneged arubba, en tuma yotza befachot mittefach, utehora haaliyya af al pi shearubba shel aliyya setuma:
Hakkol tame. dechevan detuma cheneged arubbot vedavar tame eno chotzetz, roin oto cheillu hu natun befi haarubba haelyona veerev et hattuma:
Kofin oto. et ben hechatzer sheeno rotze lesayyea livne hechatzer:
Livnot. lechatzer bet shaar lihyot shomer happetach yoshev sham batztzel umarchik et bene reshut harabbim millehatzitz bechatzer:
Vedelet. leshaar hechatzer:

Lo chol hachatzerot reuyot levet shaar. chatzer sheenah semucha lirshut harabbim enah reuya levet shaar. veen halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel. daafillu sheenah semucha lirshut harabbim zimnin dedachke rabbim veaylu veatu:

Lo chol haayarot reuyot lechoma. ir sheenah semucha ligvul haoyvim enah tzericha lechoma. veen halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel. daafillu enah semucha ligvul haoyvim tzericha lechoma, dezimnin demikru veatu geyasot:
Vihe cheanshe hair. laset immahem baol:
Shenem asar chodesh. vehaidna denayde, nahug alma sheloshim yom:

Hammotzi yayin kede mezigat hakkos. shel birkat hammazon, shehu rova reviit yayin chay, kede sheyyimzegennu lecheshbon al chad shel yayin telata mimmayim veyaamod al reviit hallog shehu shiur kos shel beracha:
Kede gemia. ma sheadam bolea bevat achat, vachalev behema temea delo chaze lishtiyya shiuro kede lichchol ayin achat:

Al hakkatit. makka sheal gabbe hassusim vehachamorim mechamat hammasseoy. umatzati katuv sheshshechin hayyotze beor habbasar, keshemmaggia lehitbashshel hu ose rosh lemala vekaruy pi katit. veaf al pi shehaddevash ikkaro laachila, kevan sherfuato metzuya, vehu mashshehu, azlinan batar shiura zutera lechumra:
Ever katan. shel tinok ben yomo, vehu etzba ketanna shebbaregel:
Lashuf. leshafshef velimchot bahen:
Kilor. shennotnin al haayin:
Ushear kol hammashkin. sheen osin mehem refua:
Shofachin. mayim seruchin, vachazu legabbel bahen et hattit:

Kullan birviit. af hayyayin vehechalav vehaddevash, delo neemru shiurin bammishna ella lematzniehen, aval shear kol adam en chayyavin ella birviit. usevira leh lerabbi shimon dematznia atzmo bae shiura zuta, uvevatzir mehay shiura lo michayyav, delet leh lerabbi shimon kol sheen kasher lehatzenia veen matzniin kamohu sheyyitchayyev alav matznio bechol shehu, veen halacha kerabbi shimon:

Bizman shehi cheli mechulchalet. bechinnam nakat mechulchelet, delo mahane mechulchelet ella befiha lachutz leinyan hotzaat tuma mittochah labbayit, vehacha defiha lifnim hare yotza derech piha. ella ayde detana resha mechulchelet bahade cheli nakteh nammi hacha:
Kenegdo ad hattehom tame. vehashshear tahor. uvesheenah gevoha min haaretz tefach ayre:
Betochah o vabbayit tochah vehabbayit temeim. mishshum defiha lifnim. aval leel defiha lachutz katane tuma babbayit en tame ella habbayit vehashshear tahor:
Kishne chatzae zetim. chatzi zayit bezo vachatzi vezo:

Habbayit tame. deen tzamid patil matztzil al hattuma shettachtav shello tetamme habbayit, veaf al pi shehen bishte chaviyyot, hoil ushetehen babbayit mitztarfim lechashshiur letamme habbayit. vehechaviyyot tehorot, deen tumat chatzi zayit shebbachavertah nichneset letochah hoil umukkefet tzamid patil:

Vechen shene chadarim shehen petuchim labbayit. vedaltotehen neulot, vachatzi zayit becheder ze vachatzi zayit becheder ze. habbayit tame, desof tuma latzet. vachadarim tehorim, deen derech tuma likkanes:
Lachatzar hashshuttafim. lechatzer sheyyesh lo shuttafut bah, vechol shekken lachatzar chavero. mishshum hezzek reiyya:
Lakach bayit bechatzer acheret. hassemucha lechatzer zo sheyyesh lo bah shuttafut. lo yiftach lo petach lechatzer zo. shemmarbe alehem derisat haregel middayyare oto bayit:
Bone cheder lifnim mibbeto. sheeno mosif kelum ella cholek beto lishnayim. divlav hachi yachol lemalleot beto diyyurin im yirtze:
Petach keneged petach. deamar kera (Bamidbar 24) vayyissa bilam et enav vayyar et yisrael shochen lishvatav. ma raa, raa shello hayu pitchehen mechuvvanim ze keneged ze:
Katan lo yaasennu gadol. deamar leh befitcha zuta matzina leitztannue minnach, befitcha rabba lo matzina leitztannue minnach:
Echad lo yaasennu shenayim. deamar leh bechad pitcha matzina leitztannue, bitre pitche lo matzina leitztannue:
Aval poteach hu lirshut harabbim. deamar leh, sof sof ka baet leitztannue mibbene reshut harabbim:

Haya fiha lifnim. shehayta mutta al tziddah veshuleha lachutz ufiha bifnim. vehasheta mayre bizman shehi keli mechulchelet veenah gevoha min haaretz tefach. veen chilluk ben piha lachutz lefiha lifnim, ella defiha lachutz katane leel babbayit en tame ella habbayit, vehacha defiha lifnim katane hakkol tame, mishshum denichneset tuma derech piha:
Kavveret. sheyyesh lah shulayim, umachzeket arbaim sea belach shehen korayim beyavesh sheenah mekabbelet tuma, umutta al tziddah betoch happetach umiktzatah bachutz umiktzatah babbayit:
Ufiha lachutz. veshuleha lifnim:
Kazzayit min hammet natun tachteha. mibbachutz:
Kol shehu cheneged hazzayit. im hazzayit tachteha vechelim al gabbah kenegdo, o hazzayit al gabbah vechelim tachteha chenegdo:

Tachteha vegabbah tame. aval ma shebbetochah tahor. deaf al pi shehakkavveret matztzelet al ma shebbetochah, enah matztzelet al ma shettachteha vegabbah keneged hazzayit shel tuma. deal ma shebbetochah din hu shettatztzil, daafillu munnachat beohel hammet matztzelet betzamid patil, kevan sheenah mekabbelet tuma, aval ma shettachteha vesheal gabbah enah matztzelet kevan dichli hi, keditnan leel perek 6‏ adam vechelim naasim ohalim letamme aval lo letaher:

Vechol sheeno cheneged hazzayit tochah vehabbayit tahor. hachi kaamar, kelim shettachteha vegabbah sheenan keneged hazzayit shel tuma, vetochah kelomar kelim shebbetochah vaafillu hen keneged hazzayit, vechelim nammi shebbabbayit, hakkol tahor:
Babbayit en tame ella habbayit. im hakkazzayit babbayit en tame ella habbayit, aval hakkelim shebbetoch hakkavveret tehorim, defiha lachutz:

Betochah hakkol tame. im hakkazzayit betoch hakkavveret, hakkol tame. divchavveret shehi nekuva min haddefanot befoteach tefach askinan, kidvainan lememar lekamman [mishna 3], ella shehannekavim pekukim bekash veen hassetima mehuddeket, vederech hannekavim yotza hattuma labbayit kevan delo mihaddeke, vaafillu kelim shettachteha vesheal gabbah mibbachutz temeim, dechevan shehazzayit betochah roin otah keillu hi melea tuma, veen keli matztzil al ma shettachtav veal gabbav. aval keshehattuma babbayit, amaran leel deen tame ella habbayit, sheen hattuma nichneset bakkavveret derech nekavim af al pi sheyyesh bahen poteach tefach, hoil vehen pekukim, vederech piha enah nichneset shehare piha lachutz:
Habbayit shennisdak. gag habbayit shennechelak al pene chullo lishne chalakim:
Tuma vachutz. latztzad hachitzon shebbo happetach:
Kelim shebbifnim tehorim. sheen derech tuma likkanes ella latzet:
Uvet hillel omrim kol shehu. battosefta mefaresh kol shehu devet hillel uvilvad sheyyehe kechut hammishkolet. vahalacha kevet hillel:

Hayta yoshevet al shuleha vechulei‏ tuma tachteha o vetochah o al gabbah. kol al gabbah sheshshaninu gabbe kavveret keshehi yoshevet al shuleha ufiha lemala, hayenu shehattuma maahil chutza [lah] lemala mippiha:

Bokaat veola. af al gav dilel bemutta al tziddah vetuma tachteha o al gabbah matztzelet al ma shebbetochah, hacha defiha lemala meachar deen matztzelet al ma shechutza lah en matztzelet al ma shebbetochah, kevan deen hefsek ben avir shebbetochah laavir shel mala bechutza lah. vedavka cheneged hazzayit tame velo min hatztzedadim, kevan difchuta veen gevoha tefach, sheen sham ohel lehavi et hattuma latztzedadin.
Aval hayta gevoha tefach o mechussa. af al pi sheenah gevoha tefach.
