O chefaah al piha. sheyyesh ohel lehavi tuma:

Hakkol tame. veen hakkissuy chashuv lehafesik ben avir tochah laavir shellemala, delo dame chelal lemutta al tziddah. vedavka dimchussa vichfisha o vishar keli af al pi sheeno mekabbel tuma, aval mechussa veneser, af al pi shettuma al gabbah en hattuma bokaat et hanneser, keditnan leel perek Adonai‏ [mishna 6] gabbe chavveret shehi betoch habbayit:

Amar rabbi akiva minnayin laavodat kochavim shemmetammea vemassa. ayde deayre leel beasmachta gabbe cheres, nakat nammi lehane kerae deasmachta. ukera detizrem kemo dava hu samuch likra delo yimmatze vimchittato cheres deayte leel. i nammi mishshum devae lemitna minnayin shemmarchitzin et hammila vechulei‏ tana lehanach minnayin dedamu la:

Metammea vemassa. hannose otah yechabbes begadav vaafillu lo naga bah, kegon shehayta bekuppa vechayyotze bah. veifligu rabbanan aleh derabbi akiva veamre eno mittamme ella bemagga kesheretz. vahalacha kachachamim:
Tizrem kemo (ishsha) dava. kelomar yehi beenecha kezarim, kemo dava, keishsha nidda, kedichtiv (Vayikra 15) vehaddava beniddatah, uvaavodat kochavim mishtae kera:
Vechen searo. hattolesh sear rosho beyado:
Vechen haggodelet. sear roshah vekolaat oto, targum avot (Shemot 28) gedilu:
Hakkochelet. notenet kachal beeneha:
Happokeset. mechalleket sear shebbeemtza harosh mikkan umikkan etzel hatztzedaayim:
Rabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat. kochelet mishshum kotevet, godelet ufokeset mishshum bona:

Vachachamim osrim mishshum shevut. desavre en derech ketiva bechach veen derech binyan bechach, vahalacha kachachamim. vedavka hannotel tzipparnav usearo beyadav hu defatri rabbanan mechattat umissekila, aval hannotel searo o tzipparnav bichli modim chachamim dechayyav chattat. umikki natal shete searot chayyav. vehannotel sear rosh chavero afillu bayyad chayyav. vetzipporen shepparsha rubbah o sear shennitlash rubbo umetzaer oto, muttar littelo bayyad lechattechilla:
Hattolesh meatzitz nakuv chayyav. dahave kimchubbar, deyonek min hakkarka al yede hannekev, shemmeriach lachluchit hakkarka, vaafillu hannekev betziddo. veshiur hannekev kede shoresh katan:
Verabbi shimon poter baze uvaze. delo chashev leh kimchubbar lechayyevo sekila. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Bizman shehi cheli. shello nifchata velo nitbattela mittorat keli:

Mechulchalet. shehaddefanot nekuvot befoteach tefach. shergilim laasot nekavim bedafnot hakkavveret kede sheyyikkansu haddevorim veyetzu, ufeamim shehannekavim pekukim bekash, ella dehappekak lo mihaddak:
Hayta fechuta. shennifchata venitbattela mittorat keli:
Ufekuka vekash. bimkom happechita. vedafnoteha shelemot sheenah mechulchelet:
O afutza. o afillu en dafnoteha shelemot ella sheafutza, kelomar setuma bammakom shehi mechulchelet veen bah chilchul tefach:
Kenegdo ad hattehom tame. vechol hashshear tahor. dechevan delav keli hu chashuv keohel lehatztzil tochah veal gabbah:
Al gabbah. im kazzayit min hammet natun al gabbah:
Kenegdo ad harakia tame. vechol hashshear tahor, dematztzelet tochah vetachteha. kevan delav keli hi:
Babbayit. im kazzayit min hammet babbayit:
En tame ella habbayit. vechol hashshear tahor, defiha lachutz:
Betochah. im kazzayit min hammet babbayit:
En tame ella tochah. vechol hashshear tahor. deen tuma nichneset labbayit kevan deenah mechulchelet ufiha lachutz. umatztzelet nammi al ma shettachteha veal gabbah, kevan delav keli hi:
Arubba shehi vetoch habbayit. umegulla laavir, sheen aleha gag millemala:
Keneged arubba tahor. kelim hammunnachim lematta baaretz keneged haarubba veroim pene harakia, tehorim:
Milmalan. al pi haarubba:
Erev et hattuma. vehakkol tame. habbayit tame vehannoten raglo gam ken tame:
Ucheneged hattuma tame. shehazzayit nimshach lechan ulechan:
Atza. teven shel mine kitniyyot:
Kimlo fi gamal. shiuro gadol mimmelo fi fara, vechimlo fi fara lo michayyav beatza, deha lo chazya lefara:
Amir. kashshin shel shibbalin:
Pi tale. nafish mippi gedi, hilkach amir delo chaze ligdi lo michayyav kimlo pi gedi ad deikka melo pi tale, aval asavim hoil vechaze ligdi uletale michayyav afillu kimlo fi gedi:
Lachin. haruyin laadam:
Kigrogeret. deze shiur lechol maachal adam beshabbat, aval kimlo fi gedi lo, delachim lo chazu ligdi:
Umitztarfin. kol achle adam ze im ze:
Chutz mikkelippehen. sheenan ochel veen mashlimin hashshiur:
Veuktzehen. zenav happeri dehu etz bealma:
Vesubban. kelippat hachittim hannosheret mechamat hakketisha:
Umursanan. hannishar bannafa. verambam peresh ippecha, demursan hu ave vegarua missubbin:
Chutz mikkelippe adashim. [shemmitztarfin]:

Shehen mitbashshelot immahen. laafoke hakkelippot hachitzonot shehen noshrot kesheose mehem goren. ukelippe happolin bizman shehen lachim umitbashlin im kelippatan, lerabbi yehuda mitztarfin im hoochalin leshiur gerogeret, aval yeveshim lo, sheenan neechalin biklippatan lefi shehen nirin kizvuvin bakkeara. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Gova arba ammot. chalal mippi hattannur ad hattikra, kede shello yochaz haur battikra:
Ad sheyyehe tachtav maaziva. tiach shel tit shelosha tefachim, shello tivar tikra tachtona shel aliyya. veal gabbav gova arba ammot:
Uvakkira. sheshshoftin kedera al chalalah veen osin betochah hessek gadol kemo sheosin lattannur:
Veim hizzik. achar shehayu sham kol hashshiurim hallalu:
Meshallem ma shehizzik. veaf al pi chen meakkevin alav bechol hashshiurim hallalu, shemma yadlik battehem veen lo ma leshallem. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Shehi tehora. sheenah mekabbelet tuma:
Belev yam. ufeshita dooniyya belev yam hi, ella leashmoinan disfina hare hi keyam, ma yam tahor, af sefina tehora, vaafillu hi shel cheres, vaafillu teanuha bayyabbasha vehoriduha layyam:
Shezzorim bah chamishsha zeronim. veyesh bah kede lehaferish benehen hefresh harauy velo have irbuv:

Arbaa vearba ruchot haaruga. memalle et kol haruach ad samuch lakkeren, uvaemtza eno zorea ella garin echad, kede sheyyihye haggarin shebbeemtza rachok shelosha tefachim min hazzarua shebbechol ruach, deshiur yenikat kol zera tefach umechetza, veaf al pi sheetzel hakkeranot shebbaruchot hazzeraim kerovim ze laze veen benehem harechaka shelosha tefachim veyonkin ze mizze, en kan bet mechosh, deakkilayim bilvad kafed kera delo leheve irbuv, veliynika lo chayshinan, keditnan (bava batra 82 52) haya gader bentayim ze somech laggader mikkan veze somech laggader mikkan, veaf al gav deyanke mittattae. vechan yesh hekker gadol, sheruach zo zerua tzafon vedarom, veruach zo zerua mizrach umaarav, aval ben zera haemtzai lezerone haruchot en hekker, vei mekarve have irbuv, hilkach tzarich herchek kede yenika:

Shenneemar ki chaaretz totzi tzimchah. totzi chad, tzimchah chad, zerueha tere, tatzmiach chad, hare chamishsha. veshishsha tefachim lekka lemelaf mikkera, ella kim lehu lerabbanan dachamishsha zeronim beshishsha tefachim lo yanke haruchot min haemtzai, velo haemtzai min haruchot, deshiur yenikat kol zera tefach umechetza, hilkach ki ramiz likra chamishsha zeronim, baaruga bat shishsha tefachim kaamar. uvemassechet kilayim perashti hilchot aruga uferatoteha vedikdukeha, vechan kitztzarti:
Uvecharuv uveshikma. sharshehen merubbin:
Ben milmala. shehaechad mehen millemala begova shippua har vehashsheni beshippulo:
Ben min hatztzad. bekarka shava:
Venoten damim. dechevan devirshut nata, sheeno mazzik ad zeman gadol, lo chiyyevuhu chachamim lakotz belo damim bishvil hezzeka deyachid:
Rabbi yose omer vechulei. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Adama. tit adom:
Martzufin. sakkin gedolot shennosin bahem perakmatya bassefinot, vechotmin otam kederech shechotmim haiggerot. veshiureh derabbanan zutar midderabbi akiva. vahalacha kachachamim:
Kede lezabbel keresha. karti. veshiureh zutar mikkelach shel keruv. vahalacha kachachamim:
Melo chaf sid. kaf shel sayyadin:
Kede laasot kulmos. hammaggia lakkesharin shel emtza etzbeotav:
Av. sheeno rauy lichtiva:
Merussas. merotzatz veshavur:
Betza kalla. betzat tarnegolet. veammay kare la betza kalla, shekkalla lehitbashshel yoter mishshear betzim. vehashshiur hu kede levashshel kigrogeret mimmenna:
Terufa. meorevet beshemen:
Unetuna vailpas. shehucham kevar, shehi memaheret lehitbashshel:

Baavir. bechatzer o veginna sheen sham ohel, vedinah kedin kavveret shehi letoch happetach ufiha lachutz keditnan beresh pirkin. vechen nammi gevoha tefach dehacha chigvoha tefach deresh pirkin, ella dechan en shayyach lehazekir bayit, divomedet tachat haavir askinan:
Meshalleshin benehem. kol kat yitten hashshelish. shehare hen shalosh kittot leshalosh shanim:
Shelosha achim. lechol shana ach echad veacher im haach, sheoto acher meid im kullan:
Hare kan shalosh eduyyot. demay demashed hay lo mashed hay, ulechach edutan keshera:
Vehen edut achat. leinyan hazama, sheim huzemu meshalleshin benehen, veen naasim zommin ad sheyyuzemu kullan:
Kotel chatzer. shel shuttafin:
Ad arba ammot. divhachi saggi leh lehezzek reiyya:

Bechezkat shennatan. keshezze tovo chatzi hayetzia veze omer kevar natatti chelki, neeman, ad sheyyavi hattovea edim shettevao velo natan. demishpat ze galuy lakkol shechova alav lesayyeo, velo haya ze bonehu mishshello ella haya mevio levet din:

Samach lo chotel acher. leachar shebbana haechad lemala mearba ammot harebe velo ratza lesayyeo behagebahato, samach hashsheni kotel acher keneged kotel ze kede lesakkech velatet tikra mikkotel lechotel, af al pi shello natan alav adayin hattikra: megalgelin alav et hakkol. degalle dateh denicha leh bahagebaha dehaich:

Bechezkat shello natan. im ba harishon utevao laddin leachar shessamach et katlo lechotel rishon, veomer lo ten chelkecha bema shehigbahti oto, veze omer natatti chelki, eno neeman ella beedim. sheen mishpat ze galuy, vead shechiyyevuhu bet din eno asuy litten:
Hayta netuna. akkedera kae:

Betzad haaskuppa. shehayta munnachat al haaskuppa mibbachutz umeshucha lifnim kol kach sheim taale yesh mimmenna tefach tachat hammashkof. uchegon shehakkedera rechava millematta harebe vetzara millemala chelappe piha, dechi kayma tefach tachat hammashkof adayin kol piha lachutz:
Tuma tachteha. birtzutza ayre:
Bokaat veola. vehabbayit tahor. uchegon shehattuma min hammashkof velachutz, dei vetefach hammashuch lifnim haya habbayit tame:
Tachteha vehabbayit tame. kevan deikka tefach mimmenna lifnim shemmevi et hattuma labbayit:
Tochah vegabbah tahor. denitztzolet im dofen habbayit:
Hakkol tame. denitmea hakkedera veenah chotzetzet, veroin et hattuma cheillu hi tachteha, vehabbayit tame:
O mudbeket. sheen hakkedera tachat hammashkof kelal ella lemala devuka vetzad hammashkof, veen rochav devikatah tefach:
En tame ella tachteha. kevan delekka tefach tachat hammashkof en mevi tuma labbayit, vehabbayit vetochah vegabbah hakkol tahor:
Hashshavshevet. hatztzayyadin moshivin neser katan berosh hakkane venotnim alav devek, vehaof yoshev alav venidbak bo, vetzarich latet alav devek harebe kede sheyyehe haof nidbak bo:
[Kede] laasot bo nekev katan. keli shemmesimin bo kesef chay vesotem piv bezefet o begafrit, veose bassetima nekev katan lehotzi mimmennu hakkesef chay:
Charsit. levena ketusha:
Laasot pi chur. shehammappuach nichnas bo:
Pitput. regel limkom moshav hakkur, shemmoshivin oto al kan uvasis heasuy lechach:
Subbin kede litten al pi hakkur shel tzorfe zahav. bemakom sheen pechamin tzorfin hazzahav beesh shel subbin. perush acher shergilim latet subbin al pi hakkur keshemmattichim hazzahav:

Lasud ketanna shebbabbanot. banot shehiggiu lefirkan velo ba lahen haorach, benot aniyyim toflot otan besid vehaorach memaher lavo umashshir nammi et hassear, uvenot ashirim toflot besolet, uvenot melachim beshemen zayit shello hevi shelish:
Kilkul. hatztzedaayin, vesadin otan besid lehashekiv et hassear:
Andife. lematta min hatztzedaayin meat, shekkorin bat tzida. veen halacha lo kerabbi yehuda velo kerabbi nechemya:
Shehi temea. deyom hashshelishi akkatti lo masrecha shichvat zera, ureuya liklot velihyot valad notzar mimmenna, vekarinan bah shichvat zera harauy lehazeria:

Lishloshet yamim. dehikpid hakkatuv al temee keri bemattan tora, lechach hifrishan shelosha yamim, velo chash im yaflitu achar kach beyom revii lahaferasha, demasriach veeno rauy lehazeria. ufesak hahalacha shehappoletet bayyom hashshelishi tehora, umatnitin meshabbashta hi, vetane minnayin lefoletet shichvat zera bayyom hashshelishi shehi tehora shenneemar heyu nechonim lishloshet yamim, velishloshet yamim deamar kera hayenu layyom hashshelishi, divyom shelishi lahaferasha nittena tora. i nammi lo meshabbashta hi ella [rabbanan derabbi] elazar ben azarya hi, disvira [lehu] happoletet bayyom hashshelishi temea, velet hilcheta [kevatayhu]:
Minnayin shemmarchitzin vechulei. afillu bechammin shehuchemu beshabbat, deaf beyom shelishi mesukkan hu, vechol shekken rishon vesheni. vehammayim chammin machzikin leguf hattinok umavriin oto:

Lashon shel zehorit. kemin lashon shel tzemer adom, hayu koshrin chetzyo berosh hassair hammishtalleach laazazel vechetzyo batztzuk, ucheshehaya doche hassair lematta haya hallashon hahu malbin veyodin shennitkapperu avonotehem:
Hazzorek bayyam. mittechillat arba lesof arba patur, decharmelit hu:
Rekak mayim. sheenam gevohim min haaretz veyesh bahem refesh vatit nikraim rekak:
Ureshut harabbim mehallechet bo. sherabbim mehallechim bo:
Vechamma hu rekak. kamma hu amko denema akkatti reshut harabbim hu velo naasa karmelit:

Urekak mayim ureshut harabbim mehallechet bo. hay dechafleh tanna lemilleteh leashmoinan daafillu rekak rachav arbaa hoil vehu pachot measara niddon kirshut harabbim. vechafal nammi ureshut harabbim mehallechet bo, leashmeinan deaf al gav deen mehallechim bo rabbim ella al yede haddechak, hilluch al yede haddechak shemeh hilluch:
Harochlin. mochre vesamim lekishshute nashim, veyesh lahem kuppot ketannot litzrorot habbesamim:
Eno chayyav ella chattat echat. dechullan chada hotzaa hi:

Pachot mikkaggerogaret. af al gav dechol hoochalin shiuran kigrogeret, hane kevan delizria kayyeme, afillu befachot mikkaggerogeret nammi michayyav. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda ben betera sheomer chamishsha:
Zera kishshuin. chashuv mishshear zerone ginna, vechen zera deluin, vezera pol hammitzri, vehu shekkorin lo 181 belaaz:
Chagav chay kol shehu. shemmatzniin oto lekatan lesachek bo:
Met kaggerogeret. kedin shear ochalin:
Tzipporet keramim. of shemmatzuy ben haddekalin habbachurim:
Ben chayya ben meta kol shehu. sheosim mimmennu refua lifkoach ulehachkim:
Chagav chay tame kol shehu. vetanna kamma savar tame en matzniin oto lattinok, dilma mayet veachel leh. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Ozen lekuppa. leochazah bah:
Telay. litloto bo, uvatzir mishshiur ozen lekuppa:
Middat minal. lehareot laumman kemidda zo ani tzarich, veshiureh batzir mittelay:
Neyar. measavim osin oto:

Kesher shel mochsin. peamim sheadam noten meches berosh hannahar mizze, vehu moser lo chotam lehareot lammoches shebbaever haacher min hannahar lehareoto shekkevar para hammeches, vedarko lichtov shete otiyyot gedolot lesiman, vehen gedolot mishshete otiyyot shellanu:
Neyar machuk. shuv eno rauy lichtov, lefichach tzarich shiur gadol lichroch al pi tzelochit:
Sheyyesh lahem chazaka. im hechezik bekarka chavero leinyan ze shalosh shanim haveya chazaka:

Haya maamid behemto bechatzer. hay tanna bachatzar hashshuttafim ka mayre, delo kafde ahadade ahaamadat behema vechayyotze bah, umishshum hachi lo haveya chazaka afillu ki hechezik lehay milleta shalosh shanim:

Aval im asa mechitztza vechulei. divchi hay gavna vadday kafde, i shatik lah shalosh shanim velo micha, vadday haveya chazaka. verabbenu moshe bar maymoni peresh, divshuttaf dekafed aasiyyat mechitztza, im asa shuttafo mechitztza velo micha lealtar haveya chazaka. aval eynash dealma af al pi sheasa mechitztza velo micha lo haveya chazaka ad leachar shalosh shanim:
Lo yachpor. bor. agol:
Shiach. aroch vekatzar:
Meara. mekora bekeruy:
Nivrechet hakkovsin. chafira merubbaat ume geshamim mitkabbetzim bah. asuya lechabbes begadim:

Ella im ken hirchik mikkatlo. mikkotel boro kaamar. vechotel habbor en avyo pachot mishshelosha tefachim. nimtza mechalal boro lachalal bor shel chavero shishsha tefachim. veasur laadam lismoch echad min hannezakim lesof hammetzar shello beshave ella im ken hirchik hashshiur harauy, veaf al pi sheen lachavero sham kotel, shemma yimmalech chavero veyivne betzad hammetzar shello venimtza ze mazziko:
Vesad besid. et katle chafirato:
Haggefet. pesolet hazzetim leachar shenneetzru bevet habbad:
Hasselaim. avanim shehaur yotze mehen. shekkol ellu kashim lachoma umerappin et hakkotel. velo bechotel devor kae hasheta:
Zeraim. kashim lakkotel, shemmachlidim et hakkarka umaalin afar tichoach:
Veet hammacharesha. af al pi sheen zeraim, kegon shechoresh lailanot, kashe lakkotel:

Me raglayim. memasmesim et hallevenim shehem shel tit yavesh. lechach hammattil mayim samuch lechotel asuy millevenim tzarich leharechik shelosha tefachim. uvechotel shel avanim marchik tefach. veshel even kasha kegon tzunema, eno tzarich leharechik kelal:
Harechayim. kashim lakkotel, shemmenidim et hakkarka begilgul chavitatan:
Min hashshechev. hi harechayim hattachtona:
Harachev. hi haelyona harochevet al zo. vehi ketzara tefach min hattachtona:

Shelosha min hakkilya. basis shebbonim mittit vaavanim shemmoshivim hattannur alav, vehu rachav millematta vetzar millemala, vesafa haelyona shel kilya shealeha hattannur yoshev hi kemiddat hattannur. vetzarich sheyyarchik basis ze min hakkotel shelosha tefachim mittachtito, shehen arbaa missefato haelyona, lefi shehevel hattannur mazzik lakkotel:
Ilan hannote lirshut harabbim. kotzetz et haanafim kede sheyyehe haggamal over verochvo:
Gamal taun pishtan. veen tzarich lakotz kede gamal verochvo, derochev gachen vechalef tuteh:
Mippene hattuma. shemma yaahilu haanafim al kazzayit min hammet vechayyotze bah veyittamma haadam haover sham. vahalacha kattanna kamma bilvad:
Tachteha vehabbayit tame. dimviin tuma mizze laze:
Tochah tahor. ma shebbifnim, kevan defiha lachutz. vegabbah nammi tahor, dematztzelet al ma shebbachutz kevan delav keli hi:
Betochah. im hattuma vetochah:
En tame ella tochah. vechol hashshear tahor:

Chezkat habbattim. mi sheavad shetaro vehevi edim shehechezik shalosh shanim bechol hanach dichtive bematnitin, neeman lomar shehem lekuchim beyado, velo amrinan leh ayte shetar mechira shemmecharuha lecha, dead telat shanim mizdehar eynish bishtareh, tefe mittelat shanim lo mizdehar, veamrinan lichshennegdo, im ita delo zevantah haya lecha limchot velomar bifne shenayim deu sheppeloni achel lah learai begazlanuta, vehaya haddavar maggia leaznav vehaya nizhar bishtaro, dachaverach chavra it leh, vechavra dachaverach chavra it leh, umiddelo machit at hu deafsadt:
Shovachot. shemmegaddelim bahem yonim:
Bet habbaddim. sheotzrim bahem zetim laasot shemen:
Bet hashshelachin. mittoch shemmayan betocho shemmashkin oto mimmennu tamid, ose perot tadir. vechol davar sheose perot tadir chezkato shalosh shanim miyyom leyom:

Vehaavadim. veaf al gav dekayma lan haggodrot en lahem chazaka, kelomar hatztzon, milleshon gidrot tzon, en lahem chazaka, vehu haddin lechol baale chayyim, hayenu chazaka lealtar hu deen lahem, sheim hayu hatztzon vehaeved yeduim shehem shel adam echad venichnesu beveto shel adam acher vetaan ze shennichnesu beveto lekuchim hem beyadi vahare ani muchzak bahem, en zo chazaka, shekken darkam lalechet mibbayit levayit. aval im hechezik haeved shalosh shanim haveya chazaka veen tzarich lishtar mechira:
Sede habbaal. hammistappeket mimme geshamim, enah osa perot ella paam achat beshana:
Chezkatah shalosh shanim. veenah tzericha miyyom leyom:
Rabbi yishmael omer shelosha chodashim vechulei. sheyyesh tevua gedela lishlosha chodashim, kegon seorim veshibbolet shual vaadashim, venimtza ochel shalosh tevuot bishmona asar chodesh:

Rabbi akiva omer. yesh davar sheggadel lishloshim yom, kegon shachat virakot. lefichach im achla arbaa asar chodesh haveya chazaka. verabbi yishmael savar, devaachilat shachat virakot lo haveya chazaka, ella baachilat tevua uferot gemurim:
Bamme devarim amurim. shetztzarich shemona asar chodesh lisde habbaal:
Bisde hallavan. shekkol peroteha nilkatin beferek echad, lefichach tzarich shalosh shanim:
Aval bisde hailan. shepperoteha nilkatim lifrakim, anavim beferek echad, vezetim beferek echad, uteenim beferek echad:
Kanas et tevuato. yayin shel gefanim:
Masak et zetav vechanas et ketzo. likket teenim veyibbeshan vehichnisan leveto, hare zo chazaka keillu hen shalosh shanim. veen halacha lo kerabbi akiva velo kerabbi yishmael:

Marchikin et hassullam. mi sheyyesh lo shovach shel yonim bachatzero samuch lechotel shebben shete chatzerot, uva chavero lehaamid sullam etzel hakkotel, tzarich leharechik hassullam min hashshovach arba ammot:
Kede shello tikpotz hannemiyya. hi chayya ketanna, min hassullam lashshovach, vetaharog et hayyonim:

Mazchila. hu tzinnor gadol hammunnach al orech hakkotel umeme haggag zavim letocho. veim katlo mehallech al pene chatzar chavero umazchila alav, tzarich leharechik mimmenna im ba livnot kotel betziddah:
Arba ammot kede sheyyehe zokef sham sullam. laalot uletakken mazchilato lenakkotah meafar umitztzerorot hannoflim bah umeakkevim et killuach hammayim:
Marchikim et hashshovach min hair. shehayyonim mafsidim zerone haggaggot:
Ella im ken yesh lo chamishshim amma. shello yafsidu hayyonim bisde chavero:
Bet arbaat korin. bet kor lechol ruach, vehakkor sheloshim sein. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Melo sheger hayyonim. merutzat perichatan befaam achat:
Veim lekacho. kemot shehu im hakkarka, afillu en lo kol sevivav ella bet rova hakkav:
Hare hu vechezkato. shehare huchzak bo harishon kach:
Hayta gevoha. leel defiha lachutz katane tuma tachteha o vabbayit [o al gabbah, hakkol tame ella tochah], vehacha defiha lifnim, hakkol tame:
Ella gabbah. vetochah tame keshehattumia babbayit, mishshum defiha lifnim. aval leel defiha lachutz, tochah vegabbah tahor:
Marchikin et hailan min hair. lefi shennoy hu lair kesheyyesh merchav panuy lefaneha:
Charuv veshikma. anfehen merubbim:
Ilan serak. genay hu lair:
Venoten damim. mi shehair shello:
Safek vechulei‏ kotzetz veeno noten damim. dechevan dedina have deven ze kadam uven ze kadam kotzetz, leachar shekkatzatz amrinan leh levaal hailan ayte reaya shehailan kadam ushekol:
Hammarzev. tzinnor katan shennotnim oto besof tzinnor haggadol haholech al pene kol haggag:

En lo chazaka veyesh limkomo chazaka. im haya sham marzev uva baal hechatzer leakro legamre shello yishshafchu me haggag letoch chatzero, eno yachol, shekkevar yesh lo chazaka laze sheyyihyu meme gaggo shofchim derech oto marzev. aval im ba lehafcho, shehaya munnach leruach deromi uva latet oto leruach tzefoni, en baal hammarzev yachol leakkev alav, delav mide afsedeh, veen lo chazaka sheyyihye tamid omed beruach zo:
Marzev. makom shehattippa shel geshamim zava mimmennu. mar, tippa. kemo hen goyim kemar middeli (yeshaya 40):
Mazchila. tzinnor gadol hammachazik kol orech haggag. vehave milleta dikviuta, lechach yesh lo chazaka:
Sullam hammitzri. katan veeno kavua, velo kafed aleh im noten oto letoch chatzar chavero kede laalot bo legaggo uleshovacho, lechach en lo chazaka:
Challon hammitzrit. challon katan sheen rosho shel adam nichnas bo:

En lo chazaka. vei bae baal hechatzer livnot keneged hachallon ulesatmo, lo matze baal hachallon lomar kevar hechezakti bo veencha yachol listom, deamar leh hiach, lo nitpayyasti ella lefi shello haya li bo hezzek. vaafillu hachi i hava bae meikkara kesheppetacho have matze meakkev alav shello yiftechennu, vaafillu haya gavoah yoter mearba ammot, dematze amar leh shemma tasim safsal samuch lachallon vetabbit bi, veachar shehinnicho nammi ufatach, en lo chazaka:

Velatztzorit yesh lo chazaka. challon sherosho shel adam nichnas bo, vaafillu hu lemala mearba ammot. o challon heasuy leora, vaafillu hu katan meod. o challon shehu lematta mearba ammot. kol echad mishshelosha challonot hallalu im hinnicho ufatach, yesh lo chazaka veshuv en yachol livnot kenegdo ulesatmo, deyesh chazaka linzakin. chutz meashan veavak uvet hakkisse kelomar reach ra, sheellu hashshelosha en lahem chazaka afillu hechezik bahem kamma shanim. aval hezzek reiyya yesh lah chazaka. velo bae chazaka linzakin shalosh shanim, ella mikki kae nizka kede sheyyuchal lomar lannizzak kevar yadata bannezek velo machita, haveya chazaka:
Malben. binyan mibbachutz keen mashkof millemala veaskuppa millematta:
Ziz. etz o even hayyotze mikkatlo laavir chatzar chavero, im yesh bo tefach o yoter, yesh lo chazaka veen yachol baal hechatzer livnot kenegdo listom hazziz, meachar shehechezik bo:
Veyachol limchot bo. keshebba baal hakkotel lehotzi hazziz sheyyesh bo tefach o yoter, yachol baal hechatzer limchot bo shello yotziennu:
Pachot mittefach. lo have mide dikviuta, lechach lo have chazaka veyachol livnot kenegdo ulesatmo, ucheshebba baal hakkotel lehotzio lechattechilla, en baal hechatzer yachol leakkev alav:
Arubbot zo al gav zo. kegon sheyyesh arubba ben bayit laaliyya veyesh od arubba acheret begag haaliyya mechuvvenet kenegdah, uvechol achat veachat poteach tefach:
Ben milmalan. baarubba haelyona:
Ben millemattan. baarubba hattachtona:

Hakkol tame. afillu ma shebbaaliyya, af al pi shennatan battachtona velo baelyona. dechevan dedavar hamekabbel tuma hu veen chotzetz bifne hattuma shebbabbayit, roin oto cheillu hu natun befi haarubba haelyona veerev et hattuma:
Mimmennu ulemattan tame. denaasa ohel satum vechol ma shebbetocho tame:
Mimmennu ulemalan tahor. dechotzetz bifne hattuma:
Lefanav uva lo leacharav patur. denitkavven lishmira meulla vealta beyado shemira pechuta:
Leacharav uva lo lefanav chayyav. denitkavven lishmira pechuta vealta beyado shemira meulla:
Sinar. keen michnasayim ketannim chogrot otan litzniut, veim talta bahen shum davar lehotzi uva lah letzad acher chayyevet:
Shekken rauy lihyot chozer. darko lihyot chozer vesovev sevivoteha, umittechilla yada shessofo lehithappech:

Rabbi yehuda omer af mekabbele fitkin. shel melech. haratzim hannosim iggerot notnim otam beetzim chalulim kidmut kanim vetolim betzavvaram, vederech oto kane lihyot chozer vesovev millefanav umeacharav saviv letzavvaro, veyodea haya shessofo lehithappech. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Keneged arubba. baarubba sheen bah poteach tefach:
Ucheneged hattuma tame. hayenu hammaahil al hattuma:
Kede shettechalek. sheyyihye bemiktzat hattuma shiur kede letamme beohel, dehaynu chesheyyihye vechullah shene zetim o yoter. vahalacha kerabbi yose:

Shalosh aratzot lachazaka. shalosh aratzot beeretz yisrael chalukot zo mizzo leinyan chazaka, sheim hechezik beechad meellu haaratzot vehaya baal hakkarka beacheret, en chezkato chazaka, lefi sheen sheyarot metzuyot mizzo lazo. veaf al pi sheenan sheat cherum umilchama, kishat cherum dami, veim haya baal hakkarka moche lo haya mi sheyyodia leze hammachazik, lefichach haya rauy leze hammachazik lizzaher bishtaro, vechevan shello nizhar hifsid:

Ad sheyyehe immo vammedina. sheyyihyu shenehem bihuda o shenehem beever hayyarden, veaf al pi shezze beir achat veze beir acheret, dechevan dishyarot metzuyot haya lo limchot, vechevan delo micha hifsid:

Amar rabbi yehuda vechulei. kasavar rabbi yehuda tama dachazaka lav mishshum dead telat shenin mizdehar eynash bishtareh, tefe lo mizdehar, ella tama dachazaka ledideh, mishshum delo shavik eynish deachle ara dideh afillu shaa achat veshatek, vehay dehirchiku telat shenin kede sheim haya beaspamya vechulei, aval im haya immo bair, lealtar have chazaka. uveshalosh aratzot hallalu sheen sheyarot metzuyot, bitlat shenin miha have chazaka. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Aron shehi rechava. hay aron hu shen sela shebbolet min hahar, venechtzav bo kever rachav millematta vetzar millemala ufiv lemala:
Hannogea bah millemattan tahor. dema shekkeneged piv nechshav kearon, aval shebbatztzedadim lo:

Rachav millemala vetzar millematta. o shehaya shave, hannogea bo mikkol makom tame, divre rabbi eliezer. shehakkissuy mevakkea hattuma vechullo, shehattuma ola ad hakkissuy vechozeret veyoredet al pene chullah:
Rabbi yehoshua metaher mittefach ulematta. deen nechshav kearon ella tefach hassamuch lachalal haaron, hilkach enah bokaat mittefach ulematta:
Haasuya chemin kamtera. hu cheli shekkissuyo mechasse ovi haddefanot. targum laasher al hammeltacha (Melachim 2 10), ledimmanna al kumterayya:
Hannogea bah mikkol makom tame. dechol shekkeneged hakkissuy tame, vechissuyo mechasse et kullo:
Kemin geloskos hannogea bah mikkol makom tahor. en kissuy shello ella cheneged chalalo, keyated hattachuv benekev bedochak:
Chutz mimmekom petichatah. bakkissuy shekkeneged chalalah:
Nippul. gozal:
Hannimtza vetoch chamishshim amma. shel shovach:
Ben shene shovachot. betoch chamishshim lishnehem:
Min hayyam layyabbasha. mikkarmelit lirshut harabbim:
Min hayyam lassefina. mikkarmelit lirshut hayyachid:
Metaltelin mizzo lazo. im hen shel shene bene adam metaltelim al yede eruv dahave lehu kishte chatzerot:
Mukkafot. semuchot zo lezo, kemo en makkifin bevue (chullin 46 amud bet):
En metaltelin mizzo lazo. dechi mafreshi mehadade, karmelit mafseket benehen uvatel haeruv:
Shekken massa vene kehat. bakkatef yissau, vimin usemol vechek orcha deara:
Marpeko. happerek haemtzai shebbazzeroa, uvaaravi kach shemo 420:
Baafunedato. ezor chalul:

Piha lematta. en derech hotzaa bechach. aval piha lemala derech hotzaa bechach. perush acher, afunedato beged shellovesh samuch livsaro lekabbel hazzea, uregilin laasot bo keen kisin, ucheshemmehappechim oto millematta lemala nimtza pi hakkis lematta:
Sefat chaluko. hassafa hattachtona shel chaluk:
Arubba. shehi roa et haavir:
Ukedera netuna tachteha. baaretz keneged haarubba. veenah rechava kol kach sheim taale cheneged haarubba sheyyihyu siftoteha nogot baarubba, ella yotzet venichneset berevach:

Tuma vokaat veola. vehabbayit tahor, vechol hammaahil aleha shello cheneged hattuma tahor. aval keneged hattuma tame, deaf al gav deen keli cheres mittamme miggabbo, hacha detuma bokaat tochah nammi tame, af al gav detuma tachteha. vechol ma shebbakkedera tame vaafillu shello cheneged hattuma:
Tachteha vehabbayit tame. shehakkedera maahelet al hattuma, hoil ugevoha tefach:
Tochah vegabbah tahor. shehakkedera chotzetzet bifne hattuma umatztzelet im dafnot ohalim:
Betochah o al gabbah hakkol tame. tochah vegabbah vetachteha vehabbayit. detuma sheal gabbah bokaat tachteha, vahare gevoha tefach, veshuv en matztzelet kevan dikdera temea:
Samuch lisde chavero. ben sede lavan ben sede ilan:

Ella im ken hirchik mimmennu arba ammot. kede avodat hakkerem. shekkesheyyacharosh et ilanotav lo yehe tzarich lehachenis machareshato letoch shel chavero. vehane mille beeretz yisrael vechayyotze bah shemmachareshatan arukka. aval bevavel uvishar aratzot shemmachareshatan ketzara, beharechakat shete ammot saggi. vedavka bigfanim ligfanim veilanot leilanot hu desaggi bishte ammot, aval habba litta sede ilan samuch laggefanim, afillu bevavel vechayyotze bah tzarich leharechik arba ammot:
Maamik shelosha tefachim. baal hassade sheyyatzu sharshe ilanot chavero letoch sadehu, kotztzan beomek shelosha tefachim veeno choshesh:

Vehaetzim shello. shel baal hassade. vehu sheyyihye hammakom shechofer rachok meilan chavero shesh esre amma o yoter. aval pachot mikken, haetzim levaal hailan. dead shesh esre amma minnak yanke, tefe lo yanke:
Laasot bo kamea. lechassot bo et hakkamea:
Kelaf kede lichtov alav parasha ketanna. deayde dedamav yekarin lo avad minneh kesher mochsin ella tefillin umezuzot, velo michayyav beshiura zuta:
Deyo kede lichtov shete otiyyot. lirshom al shete chulyot shel keli o al shene kerashim lezavvegan:
Kede lichchol ayin echat. shekken tzenuot haholchot meuttafot en megallot ella ayin achat vechochalot otah:
Chavit shehi yoshevet. chaviyyot shellahen tzarot lemala letzad pihen, ulematta letzad hashshulayim, urechavot beemtzaan, uchemin beten rachav bolet mehen beemtzaan mibbachutz:
Baavir. hayenu baavir haolam. laafoke tachat haohel:
Kurekuratah. kemo karkaitah, vehen hashshulayim:

Bokaat veola bokaat veyoredet. vechol kelim shekkeneged hazzayit temeim, ben tachteha ben al gabbah ben betochah, midi dahave akkavveret dilel [mishna 13] hayyoshevet al shuleha. aval shebbatztzedadim shello cheneged hazzayit tehorim:

Vehechavit temea. lo shettehe hechavit atzmah temea, deha hacha vechavit sheenah mekabbelet tuma askinan kidmochach besefa, ella hechavit temea kelomar af kelim shebbetoch hechavit keneged hattuma temeim, mishshum distam chavit piha rachav keshiur kurekuratah, vechevan sheen hefsek ben avir tochah laavir sheal gabbah lemala chutza lah, mittoch sheenah matztzelet chutza lah en matztzelet betochah:
Tachat dafnah mibbachutz tuma vokaat veola bokaat veyoredet. vetame chutz lechavit kol shekkeneged hazzayit:

Vehechavit tehora. hayenu ma shebbetoch hechavit afillu keneged hazzayit. dedafne hechavit boltot baemtza, uchesheyyesh kazzayit tachat haddofen dame dafnah lechavveret shehi mutta al tziddah detochah tahor, lefi sheyyesh hefsek ben avir tochah shekkeneged hazzayit laavir shechutza lah keneged hazzayit:
Betochah vetachat dafnah. kelomar bifnim bachalal dafnah. vekare la tachat dafnah, lefi shehaddofen holech vetzar letzad piha. velaafoke al shuleha hamechuvvan keneged piha:
Im yesh baddefanot poteach tefach. shebbeten hechavit bolet kol kach lachutz sheyyesh sham bemakom echad ad keneged piha shel chavit tefach al tefach berum tefach:
Hakkol tame. shehaohel mevi et hattuma bechol hechavit chutz mikkeneged piha sheen sham ohel, hilkach keneged piha tahor:
Veim lav. deen sham tefach:
Tuma vokaat veola. veen tame ella keneged hazzayit:
Bamme devarim amurim bithora. bechavit sheenah mekabbelet tuma:
Aval im hayta temea. kegon setam chavit shennitzrefa bechivshan shehi mekabbelet tuma:
O gevoha min haaretz tefach o mechussa o chefuya. vaafillu hi tehora:

Vetuma tachteha o vetochah o al gabbah, hakkol tame. dei bat kabbole tuma hi veyoshevet al shuleha vetuma tachteha o vetochah o al gabbah, af al pi sheen keli cheres mittamme miggabbo nitmet kan hechavit atzmah, midi dahave akkelim shebbetochah, meachar sheenah mukkefet tzamid patil, deen keli matztzil afillu al ma shebbetocho ella im dafnot ohalim bemakom sheen hefsek meavir tocho laavir shechutza lo. vehay tachteha hayenu tachat shuleha, delo tane tachat dafnah mibbachutz. venitmet hechavit atzmah, vechevan dechavit atzmah temea hi nitmeu kol kelim shebbetochah afillu shello cheneged hattuma, deaf al gav dekayma lan deen adam vechelim mittammein meavir keli cheres, hacha kol zeman shehazzayit tachteha mittammein mittaam chibburim, meachar dechavit atzmah temea. vechen gevoha min haaretz tefach afillu tehora chazinan tachteha keillu hu male tuma, vaafillu tuma al gabbah. vehasheta kol hane en dinam shave, deim hechavit mekabbelet tuma, ma shebbetochah afillu shello cheneged hattuma tame. vehammaahil al gabbah, keneged hattuma tame, shello cheneged hattuma tahor. aval gevoha min haaretz tefach o mechussa o chefuya al piha, hammaahil al gabbah afillu shello cheneged hattuma tame. veen litmoah, kefuya al piha vetuma al gabbah tatztzil ma shebbetochah kechelim tehorim hammukkafim tzamid patil, deshane hacha delekka meruach:

Mi shehaya chatlo samuch lechotel chavero. kemin gam. uva laasot kotel sheni keneged kotel chavero ad sheyyaase hashshelosha ketalim kemin bet, hare chavero meakkev alav ad sheyyarchik mikkenegdo arba ammot, kede sheyyihye hammakom ben shene hakketalim rachav veyuchelu ladush bo rabbim, shedderisat haregel bakkarka hassamuch lakkotel mechazzeket yesodot hakketalim umaamida otam. vedavka bechotel ginna o bechotel chatzer shebbeir chadasha delo dashu bah rabbim velo nitchazzek hakkarka kol tzarko al yede derisat haregel. aval bechotel chatzer shebbeir yeshana somech veen tzarich leharechik. vechen im lo haya bechotel chavero arba ammot o yoter eno tzarich leharechik, shekkotel shehu pachot mearba ammot eno tzarich chizzuk:

Uvachallonot milmalan umillemattan umikkenegdan arba ammot. hayta lo challon lemala bechatlo uvana chavero kotel keneged hachallon millematta, im nishar merosh hakkotel shebbana ad hachallon pachot mearba ammot baggova, hare ze kofehu lemaet hakkotel, kede shello yaamod al rosh hakkotel veyashkif bead hachallon:
Millemattan. hayta hachallon lematta bakkotel, kofe et chavero lehagebiah hakkotel shebbana kenegdo begova arba ammot min hachallon kede shello yabbit bo:
Umikkeneged. detzarich leharechik hakkotel min hachallon arba ammot kede shello yaafil oro:

Hazzorek mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim. reshut hayyachid hu makom shehukkaf arba mechitztzot gevohot asara tefachim uvenehen arbaa tefachim al arbaa tefachim o yoter, al ken afillu yesh bo kamma milin, im hukkaf ledira, kegon medina shemmukkefet choma vedaltoteha neulot ballayla, umevoot sheyyesh lahen shalosh ketalin velechi beruach reviit, vechen tel gavoah asara verachav arbaa, o charitz shehu amok asara verachav arbaa, vaafillu kelim, kegon sefina umigdal shel etz vechayyotze bahem, im yesh bahem arbaa al arbaa begova asara, kol ellu reshut hayyachid hen. vaavir reshut hayyachid kirshut hayyachid ad larakia. voovi hakketalim shel reshut hayyachid niddon kirshut hayyachid. ureshut harabbim hu kegon hashshevakim veharchovot, hammidbarot vehadderachim hamefullashim lahem, vehu sheyyihye rochav hadderech shesh esre amma velo yihye alav tikra, veikka leman deamar shetztzarich nammi sheyyihyu bokim bahem shishshim ribbo bechol yom kedigle midbar. vaavir reshut harabbim eno kirshut harabbim ella ad asara tefachim, ulemala measara birshut harabbim mekom petor hu. umakom sheen bo arbaa al arbaa vegavoah mishshelosha tefachim ulemala hu mekom petor, afillu kotzim uvarkanim ugelalin birshut harabbim gevohim mishshelosha ulemala veen bahem arbaa al arbaa hare hen mekom petor, vechen makom hammukkaf mechitztzot veen bo arbaa al arbaa, o charitz sheen bo arbaa al arbaa veamko mishshelosha vead hattehom hare ze mekom petor. umakom shehukkaf arba mechitztzot gavhan mishshelosha vead asara veyesh bo arbaa al arbaa o yoter, o tel sheyyesh bo arbaa al arbaa o yoter, gavoah mishshelosha vead asara, o charitz sheyyesh bo arbaa al arbaa, amok mishshelosha vead asara, umavoy satum mishshalosh ruchotav sheen lo lechi o kora beruach reviit, vehayyam, vehabbika, kol ellu karmelit hen. uferush karmelit, kearmelit, kelomar kemo almana sheenah betula velo nesua levaal, kach reshut zo enah lo reshut hayyachid velo reshut harabbim. vaavir karmelit kecharmelit ad asara, umeasara ulemala becharmelit have mekom petor. vehammotzi mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim, o hammachnis mershut harabbim lirshut hayyachid, chayyav chattat. mershut hayyachid lecharmelit, o mershut harabbim lecharmelit, umikkarmelit lishtehen, patur aval asur. mershut hayyachid o mershut harabbim limkom petor o mimmekom petor lishnehen, muttar lechattechilla, veen tzarich lomar mikkarmelit limkom petor, o mimmekom petor lecharmelit, shehu muttar. vehammaavir mittechillat arba ammot lesof arba ammot birshut harabbim, chayyav chattat. becharmelit, patur aval asur. birshut hayyachid uvimkom petor, muttar lechattechilla letaltel ulehaavir bechol harshut kullo, vaafillu hu kamma milin:

Rabbi akiva mechayyev. disvira leh mikki avar hachefetz baavir reshut harabbim betoch asara hare hu keillu nach. verabbanan savre keluta betoch asara baavir reshut harabbim lav kemi shehuncha damya. aval lemala measara shehu mekom petor kulle alma lo felige defatur. vahalacha kachachamim:
Al haaskuppa. shehi karmelit, kegon sheggevoha mishshelosha vead tisha urechava arbaa:

Shello asa melachto bevat echat. lo asa akira mershut hayyachid vahanacha birshut harabbim shehem mekom chiyyuv, devahachi haveya melacha gemura. ella akar mimmekom chiyyuv veheniach bakkarmelit, shehu patur beotah hanacha, vahadar akar la mikkarmelit sheeno mekom chiyyuv veheniach birshut harabbim, venimtza shello naaset akira mimmekom chiyyuv vahanacha bimkom chiyyuv befaam achat:
Askuppa hachitzona. itztabba shellifne petach habbayit letzad reshut harabbim:

Ad sheyyotzi. kelomar ella im ken hotzi barishona kol hakkuppa. velo shanu ella bekuppa melea kishshuin udeluin shehen arukkin vaadayin yesh mehem lifnim, aval melea chardal shehare yesh harebe mimmennu kullo mibbachutz, naasa kemi shehotzi et kol hakkuppa vechayyav:
En baarubba poteach tefach. ha ka mashma lan daafillu befachot mittefach lo amrinan betuma lavud:
Natan et raglo. tahor hannoten, dichsatum dami legabbeh. sheen tuma nichneset leohel velo yotza mimmennu befachot mippoteach tefach:
Im tuma kadma et raglo tame. shehare veet shennatan raglo heehil al hattuma:
Veim raglo kadma et hattuma tahor. shekkodem shebbaa hattuma kevar naasa ohel satum, uveshaa shennichnas bo hattuma en sham baarubba poteach tefach kede shettetze mimmenna hattuma:

Shete raglayim zo al gav zo. shel shene anashim, venatan harishon raglo al pi arubba veregel shel sheni munnach al raglo shel rishon, veachar kach nichnesa tuma vabbayit tachat haarubba, veachar kach hesir harishon et raglo venimtzet regel hashsheni munnachat al pi haarubba, af al pi sheshsheni ze heehil al hattuma keshehesir harishon et raglo, hashsheni tahor, mippene shekkadma raglo shel rishon et hattuma. veen halacha kerabbi shimon velo cherabbi meir:

rashi: Mithallech reshecha. haddevarim sheatta rash mehem yavou lecha bimrutza:
targum: Vetete vetadrechach miskenutach utzerichutach hech gavra tavlara:

Reshit Chokhmah, Gate of Repentance 6:1-: The things that ease the fast for the one fasting are these. The first, and the essential one, is performing the commandment of repentance with joy - and he should think that through this affliction he fulfills a commandment of his Creator, and it is fitting to fulfill it with joy, as it is written (Deuteronomy 28:47), "because you did not serve the LORD your God with joy" - and he should think how many mocking people stand at gambling games and other kinds of play day and night and more, not eating nor drinking, and sleep not coming to them - and this is because of the desire of the external husk that the body loves, for this body, from a putrid drop, loves all things from the husk, as is known.

And so, when he considers the love of his Creator, may He be exalted, who was patient with him over his iniquities and did not repay him according to his deeds, and put it into his heart to repent, in order to lighten his punishment from Gehinnom and other kinds of retribution - certainly he will endure, with a pleasant countenance, this small affliction, so as not to come to the great, endless, boundless suffering.

And especially if he is occupied with Torah with desire and love, and considers the particular aspects of love explained in the Gate of Love, without doubt the suffering of the affliction will be eased for him, for Torah is a remedy for all wounds, as they expounded in Eruvin (54a) on "for they shall be an ornament of grace [levyat chen] to your head" (Proverbs 1:9), in these words: Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi said, one who walks on the road without an escort [levayah] should occupy himself with Torah, as it is said, "for a levyat chen." One who has a headache should occupy himself with Torah, as it is said, "they shall be for your head." One who has a sore throat should occupy himself with Torah, as it is said, "and chains for your neck." One who has pain in his innards should occupy himself with Torah, as it is said (Proverbs 3:8), "it shall be healing to your navel." One who has pain in his bones should occupy himself with Torah, as it is said, "and marrow to your bones." One whose whole body hurts should occupy himself with Torah, as it is said (Proverbs 4:22), "and health to all his flesh." Rabbi Yannai's son said: come and see that the attribute of the Holy One, blessed be He, is not like the attribute of flesh and blood. The attribute of flesh and blood: a person gives his fellow a medicine, good for one thing and harmful for another; but the Holy One, blessed be He, is not so - He gave Torah to Israel, which is a medicine of life for a person's whole body, as it is said, "and health to all his flesh" - to this point.

And the reason for this is that the Torah is bound to His great Name, YHVH, and this Name is the source of life for all existing things - and therefore, since he is bound to the Tree of Life, he shall not fear evil mishaps, and healing depends on it, as it is written (Exodus 15:26), "any of the diseases that I put upon Egypt I will not put upon you, for I, the LORD, am your healer."

And so Rabbi Abba explained in the Zohar (Parashat Korach, page 176a): he opened, "more desirable than gold, than much fine gold" (Psalms 19:11) - how supernal are the words of Torah, how precious are they, desired above, desired by all - because they are the holy Name, and whoever strives in Torah strives in the holy Name and is saved from everything, saved in this world and saved in the World to Come. Come and see, whoever strives in Torah holds fast to the Tree of Life, and since he holds fast to it, he holds fast to everything, as it is written (Proverbs 3:18), "it is a tree of life to those who hold fast to it" - to this point.

And the reason Torah is called "life" and "marrow for the bones" may possibly be understood from what is explained in the Tikkunim (page 17a), in the discourse of Elijah, who said: within is yud-heh, vav-heh, which is the path of Atzilut - it is the irrigation of the tree in its arms and branches, as it irrigates the tree and it grows through that irrigation. And he further says on: and that spring is like the soul to the body, being life to the body - to this point.

And when he occupies himself with Torah in fear and love, and intends the secret of voice and speech, as explained above, which completes the secret of the Name, as explained in the Gate of Holiness - then he is certainly holding fast to the Tree of Life, and shall not fear, as explained in the Tikkunim (page 25b), that Torah without fear and love does not fly upward.

And he should intend, in reading, to unify the Shechinah, as explained in the Gate of Love - and this is "it is a tree of life to those who hold fast to it," which is explained in the Tikkunim as said of the Shechinah, and likewise "length of days is in her right hand." And when he reads with this intention, strength is added to him, as it is written (Isaiah 40:31), "but those who wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength," and likewise (ibid. 40:29), "He gives power to the faint, and to those who have no might He increases strength."

And in the Zohar (Parashat Shelach Lecha, page 160b), concerning the inclination's counsel to a person - telling him that one occupied with Torah needs a strong, healthy body, because it saps a person's strength - he refutes this counsel, and says, "but rebel not against the LORD" (Numbers 14:9) - they must not rebel against the Torah, for the Torah requires neither wealth nor vessels of silver and gold. "Neither fear the people of the land" - for [even] a broken body, if he strives in Torah, will find healing in everything - this is what is written (Proverbs 3:8), "it shall be healing to your navel, and marrow to your bones," and it is written (ibid. 4:22), "and health to all his flesh." And all those accusers proclaim and say, make room for so-and-so, servant of the King - therefore, "fear them not, for they are our bread" - they themselves prepare sustenance every day for those who strive in Torah, as it is said (1 Kings 17:4), "and I have commanded the ravens to feed you there," and it is written (ibid. 17:6), "and the ravens brought him bread and meat in the morning." "Their defense is removed from them" - what is "defense"? This is the repair of harsh judgment - why is it removed? Because "the LORD is with us; fear them not" - all is removed because of Torah. Happy is the portion of those who strive in Torah for its own sake, for they are literally bound to the Holy One, blessed be He, and they are called brothers and companions - this is what is written (Psalms 122:8), "for the sake of my brothers and companions, I will now say, peace be within you" - to this point.

Behold, three virtues in the virtue of Torah: the first, that even one who is weak is healed through the Torah; the second, that his livelihood is provided for him; the third, the subduing of the forces of judgment. And the reason for all this is that the Torah is bound to His Name YHVH - and this is "rebel not against the LORD," explained as referring to the Torah, for Torah and His Name are all one, and therefore "the LORD is with us; fear them not."

Further, know that whenever we see one beginning to repent, that if he fasts consecutive days his strength weakens, and it is possible he will fall ill - this is because he is not performing complete repentance, for the essence of repentance is not the fast, but rather the fast is a step toward acquiring humility. And indeed, if in his fast he sins and does not do the things needed for the fast, his fast is not considered valuable before Him, may He be exalted, and then he is not saved from the mishaps of the world, as it is written (Deuteronomy 31:17), "is it not because our God is not among us that these evils have found us" - for the penitent, while fasting, removes himself from being nourished according to nature, as explained concerning "a man of kindness rewards his own soul" in the Gate of Love (chapter 11); and while he is sinning, kindness departs from him, and he remains under nature, and nature does not support him since he is fasting - it follows that he is bald on this side and that, and therefore the fast harms him and he falls ill.

And along these lines the pious Rabbi Yosef Yavetz, peace be upon him, explained the mishnah concerning "one who is awake at night" (Avot, chapter 3, mishnah 4), in these words: whoever has a fixed thought in his heart, in his free time deliberates on it - and we are obligated to remember the Torah always, and this is the foundation of the Jew whom He chose from among the peoples. He says (Isaiah 46:8), "remember this, and show yourselves men" - like "and the foundations [ushaya] were laid" (Ezra 4:12) - remember the Torah and make the foundation of Judaism in your hearts. Therefore, whoever, in these free hours, does not remember the Torah, is culpable with his soul. And I have already written, in the mishnah of "one who eats much meat," that everything created in this world is entirely a preparation for Torah, like the parable of salt for meat - and therefore whoever indulges too much in them harms himself, but whoever indulges much in Torah does the opposite, for he holds fast to the Tree of Life, since Torah is the sustaining force of the world. And therefore this wise one said, "one who is awake at night" - which is given for the body's rest - and likewise "one who walks alone on the road" - for from the abundance of the body's motion, the fat of his flesh melts, and therefore he turns his heart to idleness, so as not to add to the weakening of his strength - it is not enough that this does not help him, but he is culpable with his soul - for one who cleaves to his Creator, blessed be He, is watched over by Him and He will not abandon him to mishaps, for He neither slumbers nor sleeps; and even if it saps his strength temporarily, of him it is said (Proverbs 11:24), "there is one who scatters, and yet increases." But if he guards himself in those hours and is anxious to save himself through natural means, then the cleaving between him and his Owner departs from him, and at that time his Creator's providence departs from him - and if any evil befalls him, it is only because he turned his thought away from the service of the Name, as it is said, "is it not because our God is not among us that these evils have found us." And they expounded, of blessed memory (Leviticus 19:4), "do not turn to idols" (Shabbat 149a) - do not turn to your own understanding [i.e., don't rely on your own reasoning against Torah]. And Rabbi Yochanan said, what is desecration of the Name? Such as I, who walk four cubits without Torah and without tefillin (Yoma 86a) - and it is fitting to say so, for every person draws himself near to the place of his life and flees from danger, and since Torah is the tree of life, one who distances himself from it cannot escape one of two things: either he is a fool and does not care about life, or he does not believe in the virtue of the perfect Torah, that it gives life to its possessors - and if so, what desecration of the Name is greater than this? The Tanna spoke only of what is fitting for the soul of one walking on the road or awake at night - and even if he does not consider that we are obligated to the Creator, blessed be He, one who could occupy himself with Torah in restful ease, and is idle, his punishment has no end - and to this King David, peace be upon him, said (Psalms 119:97), "O how I love Your Torah! It is my meditation all the day" - to this point.
Reshit Chokhmah, Gate of Repentance 6:13: And therefore a fasting penitent must be careful in all his ways with complete precision, and be careful of the twenty-four things that hinder repentance, and these are: 1) talebearing, 2) slander, 3) an angry person, 4) one with [improper] thoughts. And these four especially are found in most people, and therefore one must be very, very careful of them - and each and every one of these has, in particular, the power to remove the power of the holy soul and cause an impure power to rest in its place, and then "is it not because our God is not among us that these evils have found us" is fulfilled in him.

Further, among the twenty-four things: 5) one who associates with the wicked, 6) one accustomed to a meal that does not suffice its owner [i.e., excessive fasting], 7) one who gazes at forbidden relations, 8) one who shares [in the spoils] with a thief, 9) one who says, "I will sin and then repent" - and included in this iniquity is one who says, "I will sin, and the Day of Atonement will atone" - 10) one who disgraces his teachers, 11) one who causes the many to sin - and included in this iniquity is one who prevents the many from performing a commandment - 12) one who diverts his fellow from the path of a commandment to a matter of transgression, 13) one who uses a poor man's pledge, 14) one who accepts a bribe to pervert justice, 15) one who finds a lost object and does not announce it until he returns it to its owner, 16) one who sees his son going astray and does not protest, 17) one who consumes the plunder of the poor, the needy, orphans, and widows, 18) one who separates himself from the community, 19) one who transgresses the words of the Sages, 20) one who honors himself through his fellow's disgrace, 21) one who suspects the upright, 22) one who hates reproof, 23) one who mocks a commandment, 24) one who curses the community. All these twenty-four things hinder repentance.

And when the penitent is careful not to stumble in these, and not in other transgressions, the power of the supernal soul from the supernal Mother, called "Koach" [power/strength], flows into him. And so it is explained in the Tikkunim (page 113b), that penitents merit a supplementary soul every day, which the rest of the people of Israel merit only on Shabbatot and festivals - in these words: as soon as Israel sinned in the incident of the calf, what is written (Isaiah 50:1)? "And for your transgressions your mother was sent away" - of whom it is said (Proverbs 2:3), "for if you cry after understanding" - she was sent from them and "removed from the earth," and did not descend upon them except on Shabbatot and festivals, and the lower Shechinah remained solitary below and the supernal Shechinah solitary above - and this has already been established, "how does she sit solitary" (Lamentations 1:1) - for previously the supernal Shechinah did not move from them, like the lower Shechinah. Happy are the masters of repentance, for she descends upon them every day, every hour, and every moment - of them it is said (Proverbs 6:22), "when you walk, it shall lead you" - and there is no designated day for them, like for others, upon whom she does not descend except on Shabbatot and festivals; but for the masters of repentance she never departs from them - to this point.

And the soul is called "man's power [koach]," as explained in the Zohar (Parashat Vayishlach, page 174b) on the verse (Proverbs 24:10), "if you faint in the day of adversity, your strength is small" - in these words: another interpretation, "your strength is small" - come and see, at the time a person is idle from Torah and walks in an unfit path, how many adversaries are ready to become his accusers in the day of distress - and even a person's own souls, which are his strength and might, become his adversary, as it is written, "your strength is small," for it becomes narrow [tzar] toward him.

Rabbi Abba said, at the time a person walks in the ways of Torah and all his ways are properly arranged, how many advocates stand up for him, to speak well of him. He opened and said (Job 33:23), "if there be a messenger with him, an interpreter, one among a thousand" - and he further says on: there is a person on the path of truth, and that evil inclination becomes his servant, as it is said, "the vile person is despised... but he serves him" (Proverbs 12:9) - then it ascends and becomes an advocate, and says before the Holy One, blessed be He, this person is meritorious - then the Holy One, blessed be He, says (Job 33:24), "deliver him from going down to the pit," and so on - to this point, relevant here.

We find we learn from this discourse three benefits concerning the matter of repentance. The first, that the soul is called "koach" [power] - besides the plain meaning, that it gives a person power and health, the secret of the matter is that it comes from the place called "Koach," as explained in the Tikkunim (Tikkun 22, page 68a), "set me as a seal" [kachotam] - "koach" "tam" [power, complete] - "Koach" is the supernal Shechinah, "koach mah" from Chochmah, and of this it is said (Numbers 14:17), "and now, let the power of the Lord be great" - to this point. And so he explained in the Tikkunim (ibid., page 68a).

Second, that one who walks the good path has his accuser become his advocate - and so it is also explained in the Zohar (Parashat Toldot, page 144b), on the verse (Proverbs 16:7), "when a man's ways please the LORD, He makes even his enemies to be at peace with him" - and he explains there that "his enemies" is the evil inclination, subdued beneath him like a servant, as it is said, "the vile person is despised... but he serves him."

Third, his saying, "at the time a person walks in the ways of Torah and all his ways are arranged" - for it is not entirely dependent on the occupation with Torah alone, but also on deed, namely the performance of the commandments and occupation with acts of kindness - as they said (Avodah Zarah 17b), one occupied with Torah alone is like one who has no God - as we elaborated in the Introduction.

And so he says in the Zohar (Parashat Toldot, page 144b): come and see how much a person must repair his paths before the Holy One, blessed be He, in order to perform the commandments of Torah. And so too there (Parashat Vayetze, page 152b), that when a person holds fast to the ways of Torah, he is loved below, and becomes a beloved of the Holy One, blessed be He.

Therefore, when the penitent is careful and alert in all that has been mentioned, the power of the supernal repentance rests upon him, and "one who comes to purify himself is assisted" is fulfilled in him (Shabbat 104a), and the fast is generally part of purity, as written in the Gate of Love (chapter 11), for one is refined through the fire of the heart, whereby his fat and blood are diminished.

And if a person does not precede his repentance with the aforementioned conditions, the power of repentance will not rest upon him, even though he desires it - as the pious author of Chovot HaLevavot wrote (end of the Gate of Repentance): and know, my brother, that repentance comes only from our deeds, not from our words, and the Name shall accompany your soul to reach the will of your Creator, for one who hastens toward that good does not attain it, and the fruit of haste is regret. Awaken, my brother, from the sleep of your foolishness, and have compassion on your soul, which is the most honored of the deposits of the Creator with you. Hasten, my brother, and hasten before your fear comes, for you are not secure in life even for one day, and examine your soul with an examination fitting for one like you, weighed with your intellect - and whoever wishes to reach the will of his Creator should enter through the narrow gate through which the enduring pious ones entered - and we all hope for the good, but it reaches only those who hasten toward it, running to it, as our Sages, of blessed memory, said (Avot, chapter 5, mishnah 20), "be bold as a leopard, and light as an eagle," and so on, and David said (Psalms 119:60), "I made haste, and delayed not" - to this point, relevant here.

And so they said in Tanna D'Vei Eliyahu (Zuta, chapter 3), which we copied in the Gate of Fear, from Parashat Ha'azinu, in these words: if a person makes himself righteous to speak truth, an angel is entrusted to him who conducts himself with him in the way of the righteous and speaks truth. If a person makes himself wicked to deceive and lie, an angel is entrusted to him who conducts himself with him in the way of the wicked and deceives and lies. If a person makes himself pious, to endure everything, an angel is entrusted to him who conducts himself with him in the way of the pious and endures everything - as it is said (Jeremiah 17:10), "I, the LORD, search the heart," and so on, and so of David it says (Psalms 18:27), "with the pure You show Yourself pure" - to this point.
Reshit Chokhmah, Gate of Repentance 6:25: Behold, that at first a person must speak truth and be pious, to endure everything - and then, from heaven, they assist him, and entrust to him an angel who conducts himself with him in the way of the righteous and pious. But the attribute of piety, speaking truth, and other good attributes are not fixed in a person until he gives his soul over to them in such a way that they become almost second nature to him - and this is his saying "a person makes himself," meaning that he accustoms himself to this. And so King David, peace be upon him, said (Psalms 84:6), "happy is the man whose strength is in You; in whose heart are the highways" - for just as a highway is a straight path on which everyone is accustomed to walk, so a pious person has a highway trodden in his heart to endure everything and subdue the inclination in his heart.

And the secret of arousal from below is explained in the Zohar (Parashat Lech Lecha, page 77b), in these words: from here we learn that whoever is aroused to purify himself is assisted. Come and see that this is so - for since it is written (Genesis 11:31), "to go to the land of Canaan," immediately, "and the LORD said to Abram, go for yourself [lech lecha]" (ibid. 12:1) - and until he was aroused first, "lech lecha" is not written. Come and see, the supernal matter is not aroused until arousal comes first from below, upon which that supernal matter is released - and the secret of the matter is that the black light does not join with the white light until it [the black light] is aroused first; once it is aroused first, immediately the white light rests upon it - and therefore it is written (Psalms 83:2), "O God, do not be silent; hold not Your peace, and do not be still, O God" - so that the white light never cease from the world; and so (Isaiah 62:6), "those who remind the LORD, take no rest for yourselves" - in order to arouse below, so that the supernal arousal be released - and so, once a person arouses arousal first, then the supernal arousal is aroused - to this point.

And so they proved it also in the Zohar, in Parashat Vayigash (end of page 210): "and the spirit of Jacob revived" and afterward "and Israel said" (Genesis 47:27-28) - see there. And so they proved it there (Parashat Terumah, page 135b), concerning "at the appointed time on our feast day" (Psalms 81:4) - see there.

Further, there (Parashat Lech Lecha, page 88a), in these words: Rabbi Yehuda opened, "I am my beloved's, and his desire is toward me" (Song of Songs 7:11) - this has already been established, that through arousal from below, arousal from above is found, for there is no arousal above until there is arousal below; and supernal blessings are found only where there is substance, not where it is empty. From where do we learn this? From the wife of Ovadiah, to whom Elisha said (2 Kings 4:2), "tell me, what have you in the house?" - for supernal blessings do not rest on an empty table, nor in an empty place - what is written, and so on? And he proved, at the end of the discourse, the matter from the showbread, that the table always had bread on it. And he further says on: come and see what is written, "I am my beloved's, and his desire is toward me" - "I am my beloved's" first, and afterward "and his desire is toward me." "I am my beloved's" - to prepare a place for Him first, and afterward "and his desire is toward me." Another interpretation, "I am my beloved's" - for we have learned that the Shechinah is not found with the wicked; once a person comes to purify himself and draw near to the Holy One, blessed be He, then the Shechinah rests upon him - this is what is written, "I am my beloved's" first, and afterward "and his desire is toward me" - a person comes to purify himself, they purify him - to this point.

And it is necessary that the penitent be assisted - for when he is blemished in his limbs below, as it were he is blemished above, as it is written in the Tikkunim (page 101a), whoever transgresses a commandment is as though he transgressed against the image of the King - when he purifies himself below, he purifies the supernal limb, which is also blemished and in which blessings do not rest. And so they explained in the Zohar (Parashat Lech Lecha, page 87b), in these words: another interpretation, "blotting out your transgressions for My own sake" (Isaiah 43:25) - come and see, the wicked of the world cause a blemish above, for when they sin, mercy and supernal illumination ascend, and the nursing of blessings does not descend below, and this level does not receive the supernal blessings that it nurses below - and therefore, "for My own sake," as explained, so that blessings not be withheld from nursing it - to this point.

And it has already been explained in the Gate of Fear that the reality of the blemish above is because the soul is emanated from above, and sparks of the supernal holiness are clothed within it, for it lives below only through the power of its supernal roots, which flow vitality into it - if so, when a person purifies his soul, he purifies the sparks of the Shechinah and the other aspects in which the blemish was, for they are many, as explained in the Gate of Fear, and all are purified - and therefore he says "they assist him" in the plural, for they all receive purity with him.

And the penitent must consider that all beginnings are hard, as our Rabbis, of blessed memory, expounded in the Mechilta, Parashat Yitro, on the verse (Exodus 19:5), "and now, if you will indeed obey My voice" - in these words: "if you will indeed obey" - now, accept this upon yourselves, for all beginnings are hard. "If you will indeed obey" - if a person hears one commandment, they let him hear many commandments, as it is said, "if you will indeed obey"; if he forgets one commandment, and so on - to this point.

And the reason is that for all things, the husk precedes the fruit, and the husk must be broken - and so it is explained in the Sabba (Parashat Mishpatim, pages 108a-b), on the verse (Psalms 51:20), "do good in Your favor to Zion," in these words: here is a secret - all the works the Holy One, blessed be He, does, first He precedes with the external thing, and afterward the inward brain; but here it is not so. Come and see, all those works the Holy One, blessed be He, does, and the external thing precedes - the brain precedes in thought, but in deed the external thing [precedes] - for every husk is from the Other Side, and the brain is from the brain [i.e., holy source]; and always the Other Side precedes, grows, becomes great, and harbors hatred; once it has grown, they cast it outside (cf. Job 27:17), "he shall prepare it, but the just shall put it on" - he casts it, that husk, and they bless the righteous of the world - to this point.

And from this a person may infer for all the commandments - that all beginnings, such as rising early for the synagogue or rising early to study, and likewise concerning the fast, that the inclination shows a person weakness and heaviness of head - and when a person perseveres in the service, he will see that all its arguments are shaky.

And they elaborated in the Zohar, at the beginning of Parashat Vayeshev (page 179b), on this matter, concerning the inclination's arguments, and he says: come and see, for this reason [the evil inclination] precedes with a person on the day he is born, in order to be trusted by him - for when the good inclination comes, a person cannot trust it, and it seems to him like a burden [imposed on him]. Along these lines we have learned: who is the cunning wicked one? This is the one who submits his claims before the judge first, before his fellow, the master of the case, comes - along the lines of (Proverbs 18:17), "he who pleads his case first seems right," and so on. Along these lines is the cunning wicked one, as it says (Genesis 3:1), "and the serpent was cunning" - and he precedes and begins with the person before his fellow, who is the good inclination, comes; he does him harm before it, and he cannot lift his head, as though he were loading upon his shoulder all the burdens of the world, because of that cunning wicked one who came first with him - and concerning this Solomon said (Ecclesiastes 9:16), "and the poor man's wisdom is despised, and his words are not heard" - because another has preceded him.

And he further says on: and therefore people stumble concerning the World to Come; but that righteous one who fears his Master - how much evil he endures in this world, so as not to trust and not participate with that evil inclination - and the Holy One, blessed be He, saves him from all of it; this is what is written (Psalms 34:20), "many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him out of them all." And because of the length of his words, we have skipped some of it.

Behold, it is not fitting to believe the arguments of one's inclination - and without doubt the inclination says, do not fast lest you weaken and fall ill, and they will tell you, "bring merit and be excused." And its shattering lies within it - for who caused this? Because he was accustomed to eating and drinking, since the cunning wicked one preceded - so let the good inclination come and accustom itself without eating and pleasure, and endure - and this is "many are the afflictions of the righteous," for the righteous endures suffering and pain in order not to believe his inclination, and the Holy One, blessed be He, saves him from all that suffering. And further, how many healthy and strong people, who indulge in pleasure all their days, suddenly fall ill and die; and how many who fast are healthy and strong - for illness and health are only in His hand, may He be exalted.

And from this the penitent should understand not to listen to his inclination - such as concerning immersion, which is contrary to nature, and similarly concerning diminishing his money for charity, and the exertion of his body for the sake of a commandment, and many aspects too numerous to count.
Reshit Chokhmah, Gate of Repentance 6:38: And along these lines they explained in the Midrash (Vayikra Rabbah, parashah 29:7), in these words: Rabbi Levi in the name of Rabbi Chama bar Chanina opened, "thus says the LORD, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: I am the LORD your God, who teaches you to profit" (Isaiah 48:17) - He goads you, as this ox-goad prods this cow. It is called by three names: "malmad" [teacher], "marde'a" [goad], "darban" [prod] - "malmad," because it teaches [melamed] the cow to plow, so that it give life to its owner; "marde'a," because it shows [moreh] knowledge [de'ah] to the cow; "darban," because it shows understanding [binah] to the cow. The Holy One, blessed be He, said: and if for his cow a person makes a goad, for his evil inclination, which takes him out of the life of this world and the next, how much more so! - to this point.

And one who accustoms himself to the pleasures of the world from his youth ends up unable to separate from them, as King Solomon, peace be upon him, said (Proverbs 29:21), "he who pampers his servant from childhood shall have him become a master in the end" - and "his servant" is the evil inclination, along the lines of what they explained in the Zohar (Parashat Toldot, page 144b), "the vile person is despised, but he serves him" (ibid. 12:9). And one who nullifies his desire and his pleasures for the sake of the Creator's will - the masters of judgment and the accusations are nullified from him.

And concerning this the mishnah said (Avot, chapter 2, mishnah 4), "nullify your will before His will, so that He nullify the will of others before your will" - and the intent is this: a person's will and nature are to be drawn after the desires of the world in eating and drinking, and to sleep the whole night, and several other things; but this is not His will, blessed be He, except that we be sanctified, as we say every day twice in the Shema, "and you shall be holy to your God" - for it is impossible for us to be cleaved [to Him] until He is called "your God," except through holiness. And when a person nullifies his will and nature for the sake of His will, blessed be He, the Holy One, blessed be He, nullifies the will of others, which are the external forces drawn from another god called "other gods," whose will is always to arouse judgment and accusation against a person - and since a person nullifies his nature for the sake of the Creator's will, and the world was created in His nature, which is "Elohim," for "ha-teva" [nature] equals "Elohim" [in numerical value], those forces too, called "others," all drawn from judgment, are all nullified, and on the contrary, they are subdued to be like servants under their masters - as we find in the Gemara (Chullin 105b) several accounts of demons submitting to the Sages and serving them.

And it is also possible to allude to what they said in Bereshit Rabbah (67:3), that six things serve a person, three within his power and three not within his power - and we copied his words in the Gate of Holiness, chapter 18. And he says at the end of the discourse, at the time a person is meritorious, the Holy One, blessed be He, makes those that are not within his power act as though they were within his power - the mouth: "yes, and he shall be blessed" (Genesis 27:33); the hand: "and his hand dried up," and so on (1 Kings 13:4) - and this is literally the nullifying of the will of others, which are within their own power, for the sake of your will - this is the aspect of the negative commandment.

And corresponding to the aspect of the positive commandment, he preceded and said, "do His will as your own will" - for just as a person derives satisfaction when his commands are fulfilled, so the Holy One, blessed be He, though He needs none of the lower ones, His will is that we serve Him, so that it be good for us - and this is his saying, "so that He do your will as His own will," for His simple will is to do good and have mercy, as the prophet said (Isaiah 60:10), "for in My wrath I struck you, but in My favor I have had mercy on you." And indeed we must have preparation to receive His goodness, along the lines of what they explained in the Zohar concerning "arousal from below," as they proved from the verse "I am my beloved's," which we copied above.

And the pious Rabbi Yosef Yavetz wrote something close to what we have written concerning "so that He nullify the will of others." And concerning "do His will as your own will," he was precise about why it does not say "do His commandment" - to indicate the aspect of holiness, that His will, blessed be He, is that we be sanctified, along the lines of what Ramban explained (beginning of Parashat Kedoshim), whose words we copied in the Gate of Holiness.

And the things one must do on the day of the fast to ease the suffering are all the things in which "life" is mentioned - and the reason is that since, on the day of the fast, his fat and blood are diminished, the power of vitality within them is melted and diminished, and therefore one must occupy himself with everything the Torah and Prophets call "life," which is a commandment to perform - for through this the soul shines more, and gives, from that illumination, vital strength to the limbs of the body. And moreover, we already find the term "life" [chayut] used for health, along the lines of (Joshua 5:8), "and they stayed in their places in the camp, until they were healed [chayotam]," "and they shall lay it upon the boil, and he shall recover [va-yechi]" (Isaiah 38:21), and likewise (Leviticus 13:16), "raw [chai] flesh."

And the first thing, comprehensive of all the things in which "life" is mentioned in the Torah and Prophets, is repentance - in the Torah, as in (Deuteronomy 33:6), "let Reuben live, and not die" - and they explained in the Zohar (Parashat Vayeshev, page 185b) that because Reuben strove to save Joseph's life, "life" is mentioned concerning him, and also because he repented, in these words: and because he did repentance for that deed - and whoever does repentance, the Holy One, blessed be He, keeps him alive in this world and in the World to Come - to this point.

And in the Book of Ezekiel, "life" is mentioned several times concerning the penitent, especially in this verse (33:15) - it mentions "life" twice: "if the wicked restore the pledge, give again what he had stolen, walk in the statutes of life, without committing iniquity, he shall surely live, he shall not die." And they said in Yoma (86b): Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachmani said in the name of Rabbi Yonatan, great is repentance, for it lengthens a person's days and years, as it is said, "he shall surely live" - to this point. And repentance is in the examination of one's deeds and the abandonment of sin, and the other conditions explained above.

The second thing that carries a warning in which "life" is mentioned is the guarding of the tongue, as it is written (Psalms 34:13), "who is the man who desires life... keep your tongue from evil?" And we have already explained in the Gate of Holiness, in the name of Rashbi, peace be upon him, that "from evil" means from suffering - for one who sins with his tongue, suffering comes upon him, along the lines of what Rashi explained (Avot, chapter 1, mishnah 17), "I have found nothing better for the body than silence."

And it is further explained in the Tikkunim (page 111a), in these words: further, "the sun also rises, and the sun goes down" (Ecclesiastes 1:5) - this is the Holy One, blessed be He, in the place where the Shechinah is with Him, along the lines of (Exodus 20:21), "in every place where I cause My Name to be mentioned" - and Onkelos translates it, "the place where the Shechinah shall rest there."
